CharacterDes.103.3: The agile dual pistols allow Amber to sashay across the battlefield. Enemies who try to get close to her will turn into ashes long before they can reach her perimeter.
CharacterDes.107.3: Tilia will always be charging at the forefront, using her shield to protect everyone. Guess only another Imperial Knight might break through her defense.
CharacterDes.108.3: Kasimira wields a brutal shotgun. She often puts herself in the line of fire in order to get a hit on her enemies. No matter what, her enemy will fall first.
CharacterDes.110.3: Firenze can summon doppelgangers to fight for her on the battlefield. Rumor has it that she does the same in her office, which is how she always manages to stay so graceful.
CharacterDes.111.3: Iris' notebook is filled with magical formulas. Little-trained in close combat, she prefers to use ice to wear down the enemy from a safe distance.
CharacterDes.112.3: Noya uses techniques no one has ever seen, learned from an unknown source. Even skill-casting does not interrupt her long sword's movements.
CharacterDes.113.3: In addition to offering long-term on-site support to her companions, Shimiao is also skilled at handling problems herself. Perhaps this is why she embodies the perfect secretary.
CharacterDes.114.3: Chaton is the sniper of White Cat Troupe. Though fond of close combat, in the end she chose a customized weapon as tall as herself, one that can only be used from a distance.
CharacterDes.115.3: Firefly, who controls transformable armament, is said to be a super weapon secretly developed by Grace Imperium. The firefly-like glow, when gathered in multitude, can become a cannon capable of extreme destruction.
CharacterDes.116.3: Ridge is a United Harvest Forester with a habit of stockpiling food. She has a shovel that can fire energy blasts, and she fights alongside the seed plants she scatters on the field.
CharacterDes.117.3: Jinglin can summon lightning and fill the area around her with golden strikes. Though there is no consensus on the origin of this power, Jinglin herself believes that it was granted to her by the Divine Tree in Cang Wu city.
CharacterDes.118.3: A doctor obsessed with researching strange malady. She wields a scythe, dispenses deadly poisons, and moves through the battlefield with grace.
CharacterDes.119.3: Nanoha is a maid working at Goodwind who is also skilled in "Flower" Ninjutsu. She takes pride in her Sunflower Shuriken, which can hit its target while moving at high speed.
CharacterDes.120.3: The legendary "Devil Teacher" as the students called. Her mysterious laurel bracelet can unleashes unexpected effects in battle.
CharacterDes.123.3: Coco the Firefang is Ann's best friend. Wind is also Ann's friend. With help from these friends, Ann is the fastest Trekker around.
CharacterDes.125.3: The ancient "Frenzy" magic fuels Freesia to keep fighting until utter exhaustion. This is the dark side of the usually graceful girl—one that should be kept from others.
CharacterDes.126.3: Flora goes on tour in Nova to perform her original magic performance. Her fiery butterflies may seem fragile, but they are perfect fire starters that can burn her enemies into ashes.
CharacterDes.127.3: Teresa has extensive experience in wilderness exploration and understands the importance of conserving stamina.
CharacterDes.130.3: Donna, brimming with energy and optimism, is the heart and leader of Post Haste. Her arrows make short work of anything standing in the mail's way.
CharacterDes.132.3: As the leader of the Ashwind Clan, Minova rarely operates alone. Her greatest asset in battle is not her skateboard or baseball bat, but her companions.
CharacterDes.133.3: A powerful trekker who wields Ventus magic, her exceptional judgment is an innate gift that makes her a natural leader.
CharacterDes.134.3: Though somewhat shy, she has formidable strength. It's hard to imagine that her heavy gauntlets are in fact "restraints" for her natural immense power.
CharacterDes.135.3: Mistique is the witch of Scarlet Sights Media. She has two summons that help her strike down her enemies in exchange for their "sustenance": Real news and truth.
CharacterDes.137.3: Eleanor, both a noble lady and a traveler, excels at switching weapons fluidly to unleash varied attacks and confuse her enemies with versatile tactics.
CharacterDes.140.3: Sparkla's Super Action Pie and Rabbit Pie builds can shift into different modes to counter enemies depending on battlefield conditions.
CharacterDes.141.3: Nobody would expect a Xuan Shi to be so timid. Her giant writing brush is a modified flamethrower and also her instrument in drawing powerful talismans.
CharacterDes.142.3: Whether the steel claws she'd scavenged or the left hand imbued with special magic, Cosette uses her weapons to break the chains of fate.
CharacterDes.143.3: Hailing from the frozen land of Norstheim, she is an elite warrior of the Sentinel of Dawn. A master of all weapons, she pays extra attention to cases involving Nocturn Eterna.
CharacterDes.144.3: Chitose is a formidable warrior who sees herself as the blade, with a presence as sharp as steel. Her blade can summon flowing currents, shaping them into water serpents that crash through enemy lines.
CharacterDes.145.3: A mysterious ninja who walks the night, wielding a long umbrella—its ribs as blades, its sleeves concealing deadly edges.
CharacterDes.147.3: Enchanted by the music in the Monolith, the virtuoso bassist dazzles her audience with ease. Not even Stellaroids or monsters can withstand the shockwaves she creates.
CharacterDes.149.3: Gerie brandishes her chain-shovel "Mercy" with reckless abandon on the battlefield, crushing swathes of foes. She sows terror into her opponent's soul before delivering judgment.
CharacterDes.150.3: Cutting through her enemies with her spear of thunder, Laru is a flash darting across the battlefield. Here, her free spirit is out in full force.
CharacterDes.155.3: Shia is the definition of agility. Riding her surfboard alongside Snow Rabbit and Night Rabbit, she unleashes a tidal onslaught that crashes through everything in its path.
CharacterDes.156.3: Nazuna fights with her trusty hand crossbow and her puppet companions at her side. Her out-of-the-box ideas and uncanny luck always bring pleasant surprises to the squad.
CharacterDes.157.3: Karin carries her fishing harpoon and charges in alongside the fierce Boss Shark. Together, they'll raise havoc on the battlefield!
CharacterDes.158.3: Laru, dressed as the Holy Night Messenger, is on a special mission for the Snow Wish Festival. In the chiming bells at midnight, tin soldiers and saluting cannons will bear witness to a shimmering miracle.

CharacterDes.160.3: Rocking a swimsuit chosen by everyone, Willow is finally learning how to kick back and enjoy a work-free vacation.

CharacterSkin.13203.2: The coolness of the desk beneath my arms, the warmth of the sun on my back.The scent of books enchants me, as I drift into a gentle daydream.
CharacterSkin.13204.2: Having practiced a cold expression for the hundred-and-first time, I saw you the moment I turned my head. And so, all my pretenses collapsed, leaving only shyness behind.
CharacterSkin.13303.2: A light breeze, as flowers bloom in the summer air. A gentle touch, like the hand that held the pinwheel with yours.
CharacterSkin.13403.2: Clock in on time? Check. Prep the materials? Check. Work hard, stay focused... Whoa there, how did I mess it up again?
CharacterSkin.13503.2: Indulge in the sweetness of cocoa as a broom zooms across the starlit sky. Leave your worries behind. This is an adventure meant just for you.
CharacterSkin.13504.2: Even a witch who feeds on truth deserves a little break once in a while.Stretching out while enjoying the sunset—what could be more relaxing than this?
CharacterSkin.14103.2: Who says the world in the mirror is mere illusion?The moment she dons the queen's crown, hero and villain trade places. Madness becomes rule, and the spotlight turns her way.—Welcome to the Queen of Hearts' wonderland.

CharGetLines.10301.1:
I'm Amber.
Iris wrote me a proper intro. I'll text it to you later.
CharGetLines.10302.1: We're already friends, so there's no need for a self intro, right?
CharGetLines.10304.1: Lemme give you a hug... Hm? I'm talking to the cat here.
CharGetLines.10305.1:
Woven from flowing flames and adorned with golden clouds—a majestic spirit, fierce and free.
Rawr—
CharGetLines.10306.1: Following the hot sea breeze, I steal a moment from the carnival to catch your eye. It was serene.
CharGetLines.10701.1:
I am Tilia, the Squire of Justice!
From now on, I shall bring righteousness to the people!
CharGetLines.10702.1: We meet again, fellow seeker of justice!
CharGetLines.10703.1: Huh, the Lapis Eagle sounds different, somehow. What in the world?!
CharGetLines.10704.1: I thank you, for bearing witness to my first steps in becoming a hero!
CharGetLines.10705.1: Suit up, transform! My fighting spirit burns hotter than the sun!Clad in the armor of justice, I'll defend every street like a knight—This is my justice!
CharGetLines.10706.1: The sunshine girl is getting ready to cheer you on!Put on your brightest smile and get ready for the next challenge!
CharGetLines.10801.1: I'm Kasimira, commander of 3rd Squad, White Cat Troupe. Sign here on the dotted line, please.
CharGetLines.10802.1: I'm delighted that you'll be staying on with us.
CharGetLines.10803.1: Here's the update to the contract. Make sure you read it.
CharGetLines.10804.1:
I did think about adding another condition to the contract.
I spent ages tried to figure out how to word it.
But now I know friendship isn't something that's built on paperwork.
CharGetLines.11001.1:
I'm Firenze. Let me show you what I can do.
Just don't you dare disappoint me.
CharGetLines.11002.1:
We know each other well enough. No need for formalities.
Tell me why you want me, and maybe I'll go along.
CharGetLines.11003.1: Perhaps it's time to renegotiate our contract. Our partnership would benefit from it.
CharGetLines.11004.1: Now that you've chosen to stay by my side, there's no escaping me.
CharGetLines.11101.1: Nice to meet you, I'm Iris. Uh... If there's anything I can improve on, please don't hesitate to tell me.
CharGetLines.11102.1: I'm back. Here, take this. Please treat my part-time earnings as the guild's emergency fund.
CharGetLines.11103.1: My bag is heavier than most would assume—that's because you should never underestimate the weight of knowledge!
CharGetLines.11104.1: Hey, you can't just give me cookies this amazing and then not give me some more, okay? You better promise!
CharGetLines.11105.1: In the pale winter sunlight, you hold a warm drink as your breath creates a white mist. You, who see yourself as just ordinary, are the one who makes this day special.
CharGetLines.11106.1: Uh... I'll do my best to keep this inflatable steady, but please be careful getting on board.—A-And of course, if you fall into the water, I'll definitely pull you back up!
CharGetLines.11201.1: Let's aim for a Monolith we've never seen before! Come on, Boss, time to move out!
CharGetLines.11202.1: The first meeting is chance, the second is destiny...or something like that. Huh? That doesn't sound like me?
CharGetLines.11204.1: Once Loxy's fixed, let's go see a Monolith... just the two of us.
CharGetLines.11205.1: Sun, sand, and sea—time to slip into your swimsuit!Feel the warm sun on your skin and the gentle kiss of the waves. Summer's calling, just don't forget your sunscreen!
CharGetLines.11301.1: Nice to meet you. I'm Shimiao from the Baize Bureau. From now on, I'll handle all all communications regarding our cooperation with your guild. I look forward to working with you.
CharGetLines.11302.1: Boss! Been a bit, huh? I've got an urgent task for you—I'll fill you in on the way.
CharGetLines.11303.1: Water can take any shape it wants. Which means its potential is limitless!
CharGetLines.11304.1: Hot stew again?! I-I'm not complaining, but I think it's a bit unfair to assume that Loongs love stew ALL the time.
CharGetLines.11305.1: No chili pepper spirits allowed inside Cangwu!T-To protect Cangwu's peace, I, Shimiao, the ma-magical girl of love and justice, demands that you transform back to your original form right now!
CharGetLines.11401.1: So you're the legendary Tyrant? Since you possess the power of darkness, I shall answer your call. Ahem… Prepare yourself! I'll help you climb to the summit of darkness—only to defeat you at your peak! Nya-ha-ha-ha!
CharGetLines.11402.1: Well, looks like our connection has grown stronger. No need to thank me—it's just your power of darkness echoing back at you! Nya-ha-ha-ha!
CharGetLines.11403.1: Power of darkness, blaze unsealed! Nya-ha-ha-ha!
CharGetLines.11404.1: Flawless! Amazing, huh? That is the true power of the Dark Lord! Boss, come on, praise me!
CharGetLines.11501.1: Hm... Are you here to take me back to school? Oh, you're not? Then let's play together!
CharGetLines.11502.1: Play ... just a little longer? Then I'll go home, really.
CharGetLines.11503.1: I'm not just an ordinary kid. So I can protect Tyrant well.
CharGetLines.11601.1: Nice to meet you. I'm Ridge with United Harvest. Hm? Wanna come inside my greenhouse? Uh, well, uh...
CharGetLines.11602.1: Hey, Boss! I grew these veggies in my greenhouse! Will you take them as a sign of our friendship?
CharGetLines.11603.1: I've always wanted my own piece of land. I'd grow so many crops and plants on it as I like!
CharGetLines.11604.1: Wh-Wha?! Wow, this Ⅳy's out of control! Boss! Help me! I'm afraid I won't be able to run away!
CharGetLines.11605.1: The best moment I can think of is having a nap in the cozy warmth of the afternoon. When you wake up, the sunlight dances along the windowsill, and the flowers welcome your awakening.
CharGetLines.11701.1: Welcome! I'm Jinglin, the manager of Jing's Bistro! If you're ever hungry, drop on by!
CharGetLines.11702.1: I've decided—I'll make a special dish just for you! ...No, it's cool. After all, you're one of our regulars!
CharGetLines.11703.1: Jinglin, making a cool debut!Did you get the shot? Ugh, my legs are quivering.
CharGetLines.11704.1: Scientific Mahjong is the path to victory! You agree, right? Hehe, I knew you were my mahjong buddy!
CharGetLines.11801.1: Are you the rumored Boss? Then I should conduct a full-body examination.
CharGetLines.11802.1: There seems to be some fated connection between us, so I'd love for you to stop by next time you're in the area.
CharGetLines.11803.1: My scythe's purring... It seems we're all enjoying ourselves.
CharGetLines.11804.1: When I pet this little one, it gives me a strange sense of calm.
CharGetLines.11901.1: I am Nanoha, one of the maids from Goodwind Homecare. I can help you with your everyday chores.
CharGetLines.11902.1: It's been a while. What would you have me do today?
CharGetLines.11903.1: Let me stay by your side, always. Like a shadow, like a dream...
CharGetLines.11904.1: A special gift just for me? Why, I promise to treasure it forever. Hehe... ♪
CharGetLines.11905.1: The wind sways the clouds as dust dances in sunlight. Only the flowers witness the moments we share.
CharGetLines.12001.1: Hello. My name is Canace, a professor at the Grace Light Academy. You must be the legendary boss I've read about. Hehe. I'm looking forward to spending time with you.
CharGetLines.12002.1: It's a pleasure to meet you again. So... Did you make any new discoveries on your adventures?
CharGetLines.12003.1: I guess I should get serious if I want to live up to your expectations.
CharGetLines.12004.1: As a teacher, it's rare for me to learn from anyone. But it's different with you.
CharGetLines.12005.1: Meticulous thinking, precise calculations, and textbook movements.Sprint, jump, spike... I have everything perfectly planned out, but my body just can't keep up with my mind!Huh? How am I number one in the popularity poll?!
CharGetLines.12301.1: Bossy, I finally got to meet you! C'mon, take Ann on an awesome adventure!
CharGetLines.12302.1: Wahaha! You found me again! Now it's Ann's turn to be "it"!
CharGetLines.12303.1: Ann, Coco, and Bubble have all gotten soooo strong! So, come on, Big Boss! Let's hurry up and get going! Let's beat up those baddies!
CharGetLines.12304.1: Zzz... Ann's gonna stay with everyone forever... Zzz...
CharGetLines.12305.1: Little princess, who fell into a wonderland and got lost in a labyrinth of time, there's no need to hurry for the exit, for the best scenery lies hidden within those seemingly absurd dreams.
CharGetLines.12501.1: Pleased to make your acquaintance. It is an honor to become one of your allies.
CharGetLines.12502.1: Most people enjoy reunions... Do you?
CharGetLines.12503.1: I shall eliminate any who stand in our way.
CharGetLines.12504.1: Perhaps... I've learned to appreciate rainy days.
CharGetLines.12505.1: The Snowish Festival she dreams of is a warm, cozy fire, a glass of sweet wine in hand, her best friends' laughter, and a unique gift just for her—from you.
CharGetLines.12601.1:
Hi there! I'm Flora the magician.
Heard of me, right?
Wanna know the real me?
Hehe, I could tell you... But in magic, does "real" even matter?
CharGetLines.12602.1: Normally, I would never do the same trick twice... Just this one time, okay?
CharGetLines.12603.1: Behold—the stage of wonder begins! I'll show you things you'll never forget!
CharGetLines.12604.1: Okay, enough staring. The show's about to start, so how about some help?
CharGetLines.12701.1: Whoa! There's a new delivery route here! I'm Teresa from Post Haste, by the way. Let me know if you want anything delivered.
CharGetLines.12702.1: Long time no see, Boss! Are you getting the mail all right?
CharGetLines.12703.1: I might even be able to vanquish a legendary dragon now!
CharGetLines.12704.1: You really do see through everything, don't you?
CharGetLines.12705.1: Grab the village's finest sword and set off on Teresa's epic quest! Huh? A shiny gold treasure chest? Let's open it—Whoa! What in the world is this?
CharGetLines.13001.1: Hello! I'm Donna from Post Haste! Rain or snow, I'll make sure your precious letters arrive safely! For reliable and secure deliveries, choose Post Haste!
CharGetLines.13002.1: Why am I here? I just followed Boss. I'm not lost or anything!
CharGetLines.13003.1: Wait. Did I just get even cuter?
CharGetLines.13004.1: Ta-da! This is my super cute transformation!
CharGetLines.13201.1: You don't hafta worry about fightin' when you're with me. The Ashwind Clan's got your back.
CharGetLines.13202.1: Yo, it's been a while. Is it just me or has it gotten easier to chat recently?
CharGetLines.13203.1: C'mon, let's go. I'm tellin' you we'll be fine. There's nothing to fear as long as we're together.
CharGetLines.13204.1: S-Stop staring at me... If you're that curious, why don't you come over here and read with me?
CharGetLines.13205.1: The coolness of the desk beneath my arms, the warmth of the sun on my back.The scent of books enchants me, as I drift into a gentle daydream.
CharGetLines.13206.1: Having practiced a cold expression in the mirror for the hundred-and-first time, I saw you the moment I turned my head. And so, all my pretenses collapsed, leaving only shyness behind.
CharGetLines.13301.1: Hello, I'm Nazuka. I hope I can be of help to you in your journey ahead, and you can count on me. Let's do our best together!
CharGetLines.13302.1:
Hey, how have you been?
... I'm happy to see you, really.
CharGetLines.13304.1: Maybe we can hang out again next time?
CharGetLines.13305.1: A light breeze, as flowers bloom in the summer air. A gentle touch, like the hand that held the pinwheel with yours.
CharGetLines.13401.1:
Hello! I-I'm F-F-Fuyuka!
...Agh! I practiced so much, but I still messed up…
CharGetLines.13402.1: W-We meet again. I hope you rely on the Petal Darlings Guild and myself.
CharGetLines.13403.1: I'll do my very best not to disappoint you!
CharGetLines.13404.1: Ahhh... P-Please don't stare at me like that!
CharGetLines.13405.1: Clock in on time? Check. Prep the materials? Check. Work hard, stay focused... Whoa there, how did I mess it up again?
CharGetLines.13501.1: Found you! You're the infamous Boss everyone's been talking about, aren't you? I'm ingenious ace reporter, Mistique! Ready for an interview?
CharGetLines.13502.1: I'm back for more material! Say cheese! Awesome, love it! Now give me a different look for this next shot!
CharGetLines.13503.1: C'mon, Boss! Let's head out and uncover some new stories!
CharGetLines.13504.1: If I tell you my secrets, you have to tell me yours. Deal?
CharGetLines.13505.1: Indulge in the sweetness of cocoa as a broom zooms across the starlit sky. Leave your worries behind. This is an adventure meant just for you.
CharGetLines.13506.1: Even a witch who feeds on truth deserves a little break once in a while.Stretching out while enjoying the sunset—what could be more relaxing than this?
CharGetLines.13701.1: I want to go on an adventure with you, Mentor, soon! That's right! If you don't mind, could you tell me the story behind the Monolith?
CharGetLines.13702.1: The thing written in "Trekker's Lucky Planner" is true...! If you keep thinking about the person you want to meet again, that wish will surely come true... You and I make the best team after all, Mentor.
CharGetLines.13703.1: Mentor, are you proud of me?
CharGetLines.13704.1: Mentor, hold my hand tightly, please. That's it, just like this... Hehe. Your hand is so warm.
CharGetLines.14001.1: Welcome to Sparkla's mobile workshop... Whoa, cuteness overload! Get over here, Rabbit Pie and Super Action Pie—say hi to our new friend!
CharGetLines.14002.1: So you're ... personally taking the Tyrant Pie's test? Hehe, great news for her inventor!
CharGetLines.14003.1: Charge, Rabbit Pie! Our fairy tale adventure starts now!
CharGetLines.14004.1:
Hehe, since this pose unlocked my inspiration last time, I realized...
Holding this posture boosts blood flow to the brain, sharpens focus, and fuels brainstorming. But if I get too absorbed, will I catch a cold...?
CharGetLines.14101.1:
I am Chixia, a Xuan Shi of the Yunji Studio, and mistress of mysterious arts! And...
Well, other stuff that I forget! Here—take this powerful talisman!
If it doesn't work… I'll make it up to you!
CharGetLines.14102.1:
Ah, you're looking lively, Boss! Very good.
Care to buy another talisman while you're here?
CharGetLines.14103.1: O fire talisman, reveal your power! Manifest the virtue of flame. Banish the evil spirits!
CharGetLines.14104.1: P-Promise me! Right now! Say you'll stay with me forever, and you won't go anywhere!
CharGetLines.14105.1: Who says the world in the mirror is mere illusion?The moment she dons the queen's crown, hero and villain trade places. Madness becomes rule, and the spotlight turns her way.Welcome to the Queen of Hearts' wonderland.
CharGetLines.14201.1: I'm Cosette, Nocturn Eterna's Disposer. And you are... Wait, Boss? Oops... You weren't supposed to see my face…
CharGetLines.14202.1: Uh, what? How did this happen again? I thought I was pretty well hidden…
CharGetLines.14203.1: Underestimating Nocturn Eterna's Disposer can get you hurt.
CharGetLines.14204.1: Aw... Looks like the drink's stuck... Maybe if I give it a shake...?
CharGetLines.14205.1: Summer by the sea is just sunshine, seawater, and sand. Nothing that special…Wait, what?! You're saying there are icy cold drinks you can only get on the island?! Then I'm definitely going too!
CharGetLines.14301.1: Wraith, we're partners today onwards. Just tell me the objective.
CharGetLines.14302.1: Hey, good to see you again. We had great chemistry last time, and I'm excited to team up with you again.
CharGetLines.14304.1:
I am no fool.
I only let my guard down around people I trust.
CharGetLines.14401.1: I am Chitose, a blade forged and tempered on the isle of Windhowl Island. I pledge myself to your service and protection.
CharGetLines.14402.1: I have met you many times in my dreams, but nothing compares to the joy of seeing you here in person.
CharGetLines.14403.1: It seems my blade was too blunt...
CharGetLines.14405.1: A morning glory kept in water... How long before its color fades, before its scent drifts away?
CharGetLines.14501.1: I won't say I want you to trust me on our first meeting. For now, just try to remember my name—"Otoha."
CharGetLines.14502.1: Nice to meet you for the first time. I am... Hehe, of course you remember. That was a joke to lighten the mood.
CharGetLines.14503.1: Night is the perfect time to hide secrets—and for a thorough cleaning.
CharGetLines.14504.1: A disguise with a few "flaws" actually looks more convincing.
CharGetLines.14701.1: Solo artist Caramel here, rocking to the beat of the Monolith! Enjoy the show!
CharGetLines.14702.1: Yay! You've come to hear me play again? Could it be that you've fallen in love with the bass? I'll play whatever you want, so make a request!
CharGetLines.14703.1: Get ready for a bass tornado!
CharGetLines.14704.1: Are you feeling the rhythm? Are you feeling ME?
CharGetLines.14705.1:
Beep boop beep, make way! The show is about to begin!
Just listen—a dreamy, mellow, fluffy, thumpy bass dreamscape!
CharGetLines.14901.1: Nice to meet you. I'm Gerie of Grace Imperium. If you can quench my thirsty heart, I just might show you something "special." But don't make me wait too long!
CharGetLines.14902.1: The only one who can satisfy this desolate heart is... you. Give me all your sweet thrills!
CharGetLines.14903.1: You won't hold Soul Color today? Aw, why're you being so mean?
CharGetLines.14904.1: Hehe... How does it feel to have a grip on someone's soul?
CharGetLines.14905.1: From bitter coffee to blooming roses, I want to share every new experience with you. Let's go on a date when the snow melts?
CharGetLines.15001.1:
I’m Laru from Grace Imperium. Pleasure to meet you.
Alright, formalities done—time to slack off—wait, boss call!
Hello? W-What? O-Of course I'm working…
CharGetLines.15002.1: Wussuuup! I'm back to slack off. Distract my boss if she comes looking for me.
CharGetLines.15003.1: Enough slacking off. Time to get serious.
CharGetLines.15004.1:
I'm so sorry. I'll never do it again. Please give me another chance!
Queen Laru's workplace survival techniques are pretty good, huh?
CharGetLines.15501.1: Nice to meet you. I'm Shia. And from you, heh... I sense a scent that somehow calms my heart.
CharGetLines.15502.1: Ah, hello again! The bond between us must be stronger than a ship's mooring rope! ♪
CharGetLines.15503.1: I'll show you the joy of surfing!
CharGetLines.15504.1: Ah, the night air, the moonlight sparkling on the waves... We'll never forget this moment, will we?
CharGetLines.15601.1: Yaawn... I'm Nazuna with Petal Bloom. I'm not great at working hard, but… I guess I can try a little as long as I'm with you, Boss.
CharGetLines.15602.1:
Hello again, Boss.
Oh, no, no. Please don't worry about me.
Let's both just take it easy.
CharGetLines.15603.1: Swish, swish, swish! Hoo, I feel a little stronger here.
CharGetLines.15604.1: BOO! Hehe, did I scare ya?
CharGetLines.15605.1: Isn't this what life is all about? A slice of opera cake, a cup of black tea. Dreams swell and rise until the teapot starts to sing.
CharGetLines.15701.1: My name is Karin. Just so you know, I'm going to become a legendary seafaring Trekker one day! Don't you dare underestimate me just because I'm small!
CharGetLines.15702.1: You're here again? Well, at least you know who to come to... I suppose I can help you out—just this once more.
CharGetLines.15703.1: I can hear the waves loud and clear!
CharGetLines.15704.1: Stop staring at me. Hurry up and eat! The smoothie is melting away.
CharGetLines.15801.1:
I'm Laru from Grace Imperium. Pleasure to meet you.
... Hey, what's with that look? This is just the standard uniform for the Grace Imperium's Snowish Festival!
CharGetLines.15802.1: We meet again. Hehe... You couldn't forget my treatment?
CharGetLines.15803.1: Gifts raining from the sky... Now that's what I call a surprise!
CharGetLines.15804.1: Mmh... When did I doze off?
CharGetLines.15901.1: What an interesting coincidence to run into you while traveling. By the way... what do you think about this Loong-style outfit?
CharGetLines.15902.1: We meet again. You just can't get my special injections out of your mind, can you?
CharGetLines.15903.1: Hehe... I'll make your feelings soar even higher.
CharGetLines.15904.1: Now it's your turn to heal me... Heh, don't stop your hands.
CharGetLines.16001.1: I don't get to come to the beach with everyone much, so I hope we can make the most of it. Ah, but just so you know... If you do anything risky, you're getting a "gentle warning" from me!
CharGetLines.16002.1: Looks like this beach still needs me around a little longer. Well then, I'll happily keep you all company!
CharGetLines.16003.1: Alright, I'm done talking. Don't blame me when things get a little rough!
CharGetLines.16004.1:
It's about time we headed back... But...
The sunset is so beautiful. Let's stay a little longer.

DatingCharacterEvent.517.1: You find a beautiful mushroom and pop it into your mouth. Then hallucinations overtake you. You feel lost in a forest and start running wildly in every direction.
DatingCharacterEvent.518.1: You find an ordinary-looking mushroom. After tasting it, you find it delicious. Together, you sprinkle on some seasoning and roast it over the fire.
DatingCharacterEvent.519.1: You find an ugly-looking mushroom. It's incredibly bitter but also keeps you wide awake.

DatingCharacterEvent.815.1: You sit together at the docks and lower fishing lines into the sea.
DatingCharacterEvent.816.1: The two of you lie back on the rocking boat, gazing at the Divine Window, trading stories of the day.
DatingCharacterEvent.817.1: You sit together on the boat as moonlight shimmers across the bay.

DatingCharacterEvent.1415.1: Feeling a bit hungry, you and ==DATING_CHARACTER== decide to grab some food from the cafeteria.

DatingCharacterEvent.1417.1: You and ==DATING_CHARACTER== head to the Academy library. Perhaps you'll find something interesting here?
DatingCharacterEvent.1714.1:
Before sunset, you and ==DATING_CHARACTER== quicken your pace toward the outdoor hot spring you booked.
 It sits on a hillside, with a small stream below, and a view of the surrounding forest stretching into the distance.
DatingCharacterEvent.1715.1: You arrive at an indoor hot spring. As soon as you step onto the stone path, a faint scent of sulfur greets you. Once you sink into the water, tiny bubbles cling softly to your skin.
DatingCharacterEvent.1716.1: "Let’s see who’s better!" you tell ==DATING_CHARACTER==. You take your stance, tossing the ball lightly with your left hand and swinging your paddle with your right.
DatingCharacterEvent.1717.1: ==DATING_CHARACTER== takes her position across from you and serves with perfect form. Even though it’s been a while since you last played, you manage to return the ball by instinct.
DatingCharacterEvent.1718.1: You wander into a study—might as well take a look inside. A desk sits tucked into one corner, and the walls there are lined entirely with windows. Beyond them stretches a valley bathed in the fading glow of sunset.
DatingCharacterEvent.1719.1: You stroll aimlessly along a stone path under the setting sun. The glass windows of boutique shops reflect fiery hues of dusk, and even the posters on display seem to glow as if they’ve caught flame.
DatingCharacterEvent.103301.1:
Suddenly, you and Amber hear a cat meowing.

Amber dashes off to search for the source of the sound and quickly finds a kitten.
DatingCharacterEvent.103303.1: You and Amber walk into the student cafeteria, look around and finally find a counter that doesn't require a student card to pay. You both point across the counter at the dishes you want, but the way the cafeteria auntie swings her ladle gives you a bad feeling.
DatingCharacterEvent.107301.1:
The shop employee eagerly points to a poster, explaining a promotion.

Unexpectedly, Tilia leans in to scrutinize the fine print.
DatingCharacterEvent.107302.1: A furtive-looking man pushes past you and walks away briskly, nearly causing you to lose your balance.
DatingCharacterEvent.108301.1:
You and Kasimira reach a cliff.

"There's a shortcut this way," she says.

She extends her hand out to you.
DatingCharacterEvent.108302.1:
You decide to try your luck at the market's game area because every participant gets a chance at a raffle.

At the dart booth, Kasimira grabs 20 darts without any hesitation.
DatingCharacterEvent.108303.1:
You and Kasimira had just changed into yukatas for a relaxing soak when she abruptly blocked your path, her expression turning dead serious.
"Something suspicious just darted past," she warned. "Stay behind me, just in case."
DatingCharacterEvent.110301.1:
"Honestly, I'm pretty surprised," says Firenze, with amused curiosity.
"By what?"
"The place you picked. I thought you'd go for something like the library... Do you see me more as a foodie than a good student?"
DatingCharacterEvent.110302.1:
You've spent the whole day exploring the port with Firenze. As dusk falls, she asks if you want to go fishing. That surprises you.
"Yeah, I know. Fishing is for those with a lot of time on their hands, and I'm always busy," she says, smiling. "But I hear that it builds character. Since we're here, I'd like to try it."
DatingCharacterEvent.111301.1:
The tension eases, and Iris starts to relax a little.

She begins to talk about her recent troubles.
DatingCharacterEvent.111303.1: Entering the library, you notice Iris's steps have become lighter. After so long in the Wilds, she needs the refuge of civilization.
DatingCharacterEvent.112301.1:
You spot a beautiful mushroom and are just about to take a bite when Noya stops you.
"Eating this raw will make you hallucinate."

She then examines the mushroom with a mischievous look.
DatingCharacterEvent.112302.1:
Suddenly, a burst of excitement erupts from the crowd in a distance.

A street performance has begun.

It's a exhibition match of swordsmanship.

Watching the action, Noya looks like she's itching to give it a try herself.
DatingCharacterEvent.113301.1:
The small table is covered with an array of cakes and drinks.

Shimiao stares at them hesitatingly.
DatingCharacterEvent.113302.1:
You decide to try your luck at the market's game area because every participant gets a chance at a raffle.

What you didn't expect was that Shimiao got hooked on the whack-a-mole game booth. She ends up buying game tokens for several rounds.
DatingCharacterEvent.113303.1:
"My recent spicy food training has been a massive success," Shimiao declared, proudly pushing up her glasses. "So, I'm treating myself to a hot spring trip on my day off."
To celebrate her milestone, the two of you decided to change things up and soak for an extra hour.
DatingCharacterEvent.114301.1: You order more desserts. Chaton devours them in quick bites—one, two, three—gone. You wonder how it is that she doesn't find them too sweet.
DatingCharacterEvent.114302.1: At the balloon-shooting booth, Chaton is excited. "Behold, as the great Chaton grants these balloons a merciful release!"
DatingCharacterEvent.115301.1: Firefly knows the library well. She weaves between shelves, even crawling under tables where a corridor is right there. Is that really necessary?
DatingCharacterEvent.115302.1:
Suddenly, a burst of excitement erupts from the crowd in a distance.

A street magic performance has begun.
DatingCharacterEvent.116301.1: You rest against the rock wall. Suddenly, Ridge seems to smell something, and she starts digging at the soil with her shovel.
DatingCharacterEvent.116302.1: You order many more desserts. Ridge doesn't seem to come to the Dessert Shop often, so let her enjoy this chance.
DatingCharacterEvent.116303.1:
"I heard the local hot spring food is incredible!" Ridge exclaimed, excitedly dragging you toward a specialty stall.
"Our bestsellers are the hot spring eggs and the steamed buns," the vendor greeted. "What can I get for you?"
DatingCharacterEvent.117301.1: While waiting for food, Jinglin runs to the kitchen's display window, peeking inside out of curiosity.
DatingCharacterEvent.117302.1:
You and Jinglin stumble upon an area full of mushrooms.

Her eyes widen with excitement as she starts to examine the different shapes and varieties.
DatingCharacterEvent.117303.1: Yukatas on, you and Jinglin bypassed the hot springs. Today's real mission? Cooking your own hot spring eggs.
DatingCharacterEvent.118301.1:
Suddenly, it feels like you've stepped on something hard.

You look down and realize that underneath the vegetation, there lies a skeleton covered in layers of mud and dirt.

Like a predator smelling prey, Coronis immediately moves closer.
DatingCharacterEvent.118303.1: You walk into the library with Coronis. She glances at the map and heads straight for the medical section.
DatingCharacterEvent.119301.1:
The small table is covered with an array of cakes and drinks.

Once the staff brings out the final dessert, Nanoha looks at you with a cheerful smile.

"Actually... I have a surprise prepared just for you."
DatingCharacterEvent.119302.1:
You decide to try your luck at the market's game area because every participant gets a chance at a raffle.

The dart booth catches your eye. Seeing this, Nanoha suggests giving it a try.
DatingCharacterEvent.119303.1: Inside the cafeteria, you and Nanoha noticed that today's cooking elective was in session, so the two of you grabbed a pair of seats by the window and sat down.
DatingCharacterEvent.120301.1:
Carrying torches, you make your way deeper into the cave.

Suddenly, out of the corner of your eye, you catch sight of a wall painting. Excited, you call out to Canace.
DatingCharacterEvent.120303.1: "Getting hungry? Let me take you to the staff cafeteria." Canace notices you're starving.
DatingCharacterEvent.120304.1: The market stalls were overflowing, yet your gaze stayed fixed on Canace. What would someone like her even buy here?
DatingCharacterEvent.123301.1: Ann suddenly comes running. She grabs your hand and pulls you forward, saying she's discovered some mysterious treasure inside a cave.
DatingCharacterEvent.123302.1:
The two of you decide to explore the game area and see what fun activities it has to offer.

Suddenly, Ann is entranced by a ring toss game.
DatingCharacterEvent.123303.1:
"Ann wants to read that one!"
She stood on her tiptoes, pointing to a botany book high up on the shelf.
DatingCharacterEvent.125301.1:
You spot mushrooms growing in cracks along the rock wall.

"These must be top-notch ingredients," you say, handing one to Freesia.

Inside the dim cave, the brightly colored mushroom looks very appetizing.
DatingCharacterEvent.125302.1:
The sweet seems to lift Freesia's spirits, and you notice her starting to relax.
"I knew it... I always feel happy when I'm with you."
DatingCharacterEvent.125303.1: In the Market, Freesia lingered in front of a stall for a long time.
DatingCharacterEvent.126301.1: Flora tells you there's an even better dessert shop nearby, so you hop over. This one feels fancier, and while scanning the menu you notice they are selling celeb collaboration items.
DatingCharacterEvent.126302.1:
Suddenly, a burst of excitement erupts from the crowd in a distance.

A street magic performance has begun.
DatingCharacterEvent.126303.1:
Flora scanned the empty library plaza, then suddenly pulled you into a corner. She picked up a fallen branch and carefully whittled it down.
Before long, it actually looked like a pretty convincing wand.
DatingCharacterEvent.127301.1: You carefully make your way through jagged stalagmites, but one stumble and you end up scraping your knee.
DatingCharacterEvent.127302.1: After exploring the market, Teresa takes out a beautifully wrapped gift. She had secretly picked it out earlier at the market.
DatingCharacterEvent.127303.1:
After finishing the tour, you both headed to the academy cafeteria for lunch.
Good thing you got there early. A massive line snaked around the hall shortly after.
DatingCharacterEvent.130301.1:
As you passed the game stalls at the market, you noticed one of the prizes on display: a cute little teddy bear.

Just then, Donna suddenly leaned closer and asked, "Hey Boss, do you like that one? If you do, I can win it for you!"

Before you could say no, Donna had already picked up the bow and arrows from the stall.

"Just watch. Archery is my specialty!"
DatingCharacterEvent.130302.1:
Beside the library front desk sits a basket stuffed with uncollected letters.

As you two walk by, Donna sighs: "Some of these may never reach the people they were meant for."
DatingCharacterEvent.132301.1:
You lead Minova deeper into the cave. A faint light starts to glow ahead.

A vast expanse of bioluminescent plants appears before you, transforming the dim cave into a dazzling river of stars.
DatingCharacterEvent.132303.1:
Minova leads you into the library, saying she knows where the books you'd like are.

She wanders the shelves with ease, as if she were at home.
DatingCharacterEvent.132304.1: You and Minova stepped into the resort's specialty souvenir shop. The small shop had taken on a hazy glow from the failing light.
DatingCharacterEvent.133301.1:
You and Nazuka were strolling through the Market when you noticed a shady-looking merchant in a dim corner. He was wrapped all in black, and his stall was also covered with a dark cloth.

"He's giving off a very suspicious vibe," Nazuka remarked.
DatingCharacterEvent.133302.1:
You and Nazuka sat together in a small boat, drifting across the water.
"Look, over there!"
A smile appeared on Nazuka's face as she pointed behind you.
You turned to see a waterwheel turning steadily along the riverbank.
DatingCharacterEvent.134301.1: You and Fuyuka bumped into the shopkeeper. "Well, if it isn't Lady Fuyuka! Don't tell me you're on a secret date?" Fuyuka was so flustered she nearly fainted.
DatingCharacterEvent.134302.1:
The cave was growing darker. You could sense Fuyuka's hesitation, so you decided to stop for a while.

"I... I'm not scared..."

"It's fine even if you are," you said with a smile.
DatingCharacterEvent.135301.1: In the innermost part of the cave, Mistique discovers a massive shrine, inside which is a giant projector artifact.
DatingCharacterEvent.135302.1:
Time flies by. It seems you've visited every section you are interested in.

Mistique says there's something she wants to read on her own.

So you part ways for a little while. With your legs feeling sore, you find a chair to rest on. Before you know it, you've drifted off to sleep.
DatingCharacterEvent.135303.1: The Market was holding a time trial race today: no matter what kind of transportation you used, as long as you followed the route through the streets and alleys, the first person to reach the finish line in the Ash District could take any item from the market worth up to 100,000 Dorra for free.
DatingCharacterEvent.137301.1:
Eleanor ordered another slice of cake and a pot of black tea. She took a sip of tea, then a small bite of cake, savoring both with great care before smiling in satisfaction.
"Not bad, yeah?"
"Yes. It tastes a little different from what we have at home, but it has a charm of its own."
DatingCharacterEvent.137302.1:
You join Eleanor in the hot spring, but before long, you can no longer hear her voice or see her anywhere.
It is as though she has vanished into the warm water...
"Is this some kind of ghost story?!" A sudden chill runs through you.
DatingCharacterEvent.140301.1:
A massive crowd is swarming the game booth today. The grand prize is a phonograph the owner dug up from who-knows-where.
"An Artifact that plays records. This one's actually pretty cute, and the colors match your outfit." Sparkla eyes the device with intense interest.
Catching your confused look, she nods calmly. "I already have one in my workshop."
DatingCharacterEvent.140302.1:
"You've got guts, sneaking someone from the NGO into a Grace Imperium library." Sparkla shoots you a covert thumbs-up.
"Well, your wanted poster is literally just a drawing of a rabbit. Nobody's going to recognize you." You nod right back at her.
"It's just a shame Rabbit Pie has to wait outside."
DatingCharacterEvent.141301.1: In the innermost part of the cave, you find the walls covered in murals.
DatingCharacterEvent.141302.1:
Chixia suddenly spots a strange little cake sitting in the dessert shop's display case.

Its lopsided frosting is piled on top, like a crooked pagoda about to collapse at any moment.
DatingCharacterEvent.141303.1:
"Hot springs? Why would a whole bunch of people sit in the water together? And without wearing anything? That's way too weird!"

Chixia clung to the doorway with all her might, refusing to take even a single step into the hot spring town's changing room.
DatingCharacterEvent.142301.1:
You order a slice of durian cake, and when it arrives,

Cosette hesitates, staring at it nervously.

Unfamiliar foods still make her uneasy.
DatingCharacterEvent.142302.1:
The array of goods is dazzling to the eye, and there are some Artifacts that you have never seen before.

Cosette stops in front of a small stall.
DatingCharacterEvent.143301.1:
The streets are overflowing with merchandise, yet nothing seems to stop her in her tracks.
Then you spot a modest sign tucked in an obscure corner: Vintage Shop — Soft Opening.
Figuring it's worth a shot, you drag her along to see what treasures you can dig up.
DatingCharacterEvent.143302.1:
Wraith is usually pretty direct, but today she's acting all mysterious as she drags you into a cavern.

The deeper you go, the chillier it gets, until the sound of running water fills the cave.
DatingCharacterEvent.144301.1: Chitose stands silently at the bow, moonlight spilling over her hair. Does the night coast make her homesick?
DatingCharacterEvent.144302.1: Chitose probably hasn't eaten many desserts like this, so you take the chance to order more.
DatingCharacterEvent.145301.1:
"Hm? They look exactly the same, but the taste ... seems a little different from before." Otoha tried them one by one, frowning even harder.

"Have you been to this shop before?" you asked, curious.
DatingCharacterEvent.145302.1:
You stood by the railing with Otoha, the sea breeze brushing your face. When you turned your head, you saw her gazing out past the coastline into the distance.

You were about to say something, but at the last moment you decided to let the silence flow on with the sea.
DatingCharacterEvent.147301.1: On the wide bay, Caramel sees a perfect "stage."
DatingCharacterEvent.147302.1:
The array of goods is dazzling to the eye, and there are some Artifacts that you have never seen before.

Caramel stops in front of a small stall.
DatingCharacterEvent.147303.1: To celebrate your recent successful performance, you and Caramel decided to grab another treat. But with so many tempting options on the menu, you had no idea what to pick.
DatingCharacterEvent.149301.1: At the far end of the cave, you stumble upon an old abandoned camp. Before you can look closer, Gerie gently covers your eyes.
DatingCharacterEvent.149302.1: A small boat drifts over the dark coastal waters. "Actually, I often come out here alone." Gerie kneels inside the boat. The moonlight drapes her robe in a sacred glow that outshines the stars.

You know the prices here are inflated, but the hopeful look in her eyes doesn't leave you the room to hesitate.

"A gift for you," you say.

She beams with joy and nods at you.

"I want to ... see more..."
DatingCharacterEvent.143301.3:
"It's the legendary Godly Hand! The nippers that leave absolutely no stress marks on plastic models!"

You have no idea what that means, but she's clearly struck gold.

Seeing her this excited—a rare sight indeed—makes the whole trip worth it.
DatingCharacterEvent.143302.3:
"IT'S FREEZING—!!!"

Your fingers go numb the second they touch the water. Then it hits you: Wraith loves the cold. That's why she built a private bath here instead of going to the hot springs.

"So? Pretty nice, right?"

"Brr-b-b... Yeah! It's ... g-great!"

Fighting the bone-deep chill, you splash around to fake some enthusiasm.
DatingCharacterEvent.144301.3: The past always catches up, and changes the upcoming future. But before then, you need to help her to find herself as a person.
DatingCharacterEvent.144302.3:
You suddenly understand and say a little more seriously, "Even a blade needs to be cared for." You slide a piece of cake toward her.

"If it's kept under constant strain, even the finest sword will eventually grow weary, even break."

At last, Chitose sets aside her concern and enjoys the treat together with you.
DatingCharacterEvent.145301.3:
"After that, she developed a sweet tooth as well. But I kept her on a tight leash. A ninja can't afford obvious likes or dislikes—they become weak spots."

You couldn't help but grin. "But you clearly like them, too."

Otoha gently set her teacup back on the saucer with a soft clink, as if covering for her embarrassment. "That's why, from then on, I could only eat them in secrecy."

Then that familiar, sly smile returned to her face. "Which is exactly why... Today I plan to enjoy them properly."
DatingCharacterEvent.145302.3:
You thought of Nishishima where Otoha came from—Windhowl Island, her homeland, how she had crossed the sea to get here, and how she had worn different masks in this unfamiliar world, taking on different roles.
"Still, the sea is beautiful, no matter where you are." As if sensing your mood, Otoha gently rested a hand on your back.
"Thank you for inviting me, Boss. Today's weather is perfect for looking out at the sea."
DatingCharacterEvent.147301.3: Having finished her performance, she bows to you with heartfelt satisfaction.
DatingCharacterEvent.147302.3:
She reaches into her pockets—surprise surprise, she is out of money again. You pay it for her with a resigned chuckle.

"I can pay you back with a free performance, producer!"

She seems determined to repay the favor with her talent.
DatingCharacterEvent.147303.3:
You asked a server and learned about the shop's daily promotion: couples got a free upgrade to the Jumbo Parfait.
To the owner, sharing a parfait was absolute proof you were dating.
You glanced at Caramel, whose face was flushed bright red. Not wanting to waste food, you accepted the misunderstanding, grabbed a spoon, and dug in.
DatingCharacterEvent.149301.3: You hear the sound of a shovel against stone, then silence. After a long while, Gerie softly takes your hand and leads you away from the cave's depths.
DatingCharacterEvent.149302.3:
Her eyes lower; you can almost feel her breath. Her gentle touch at your fingertips quiets you.

It feels as though your senses drift far above the sea, watching two hearts beat in rhythm with the tide.
DatingCharacterEvent.149303.3:
From what Gerie said, you figured that she was trying to dress up as some kind of snow spirit from the legends of Goodwind village.

"Mom, look, that lady is so pretty!"

"Such an elegant vibe... Is she an actress from Flavio?"

Before you could even respond, several passersby nearby were already gossiping about the yukata-clad Gerie.

"Um... This isn't the reaction I was going for...!"
Gerie's confused look made you burst out into laughter.
DatingCharacterEvent.150301.3:
"Or maybe cake-flavored fries? Who says fries have to be salty, anyway?"

Laru dashes off to find a store employee.

Looks like she's serious about getting this fry-flavored cake for you... or maybe cake-flavored fries?
DatingCharacterEvent.150303.3: "In the port, net fishing isn't allowed, which keeps the fish population steady. The fish here are also used to all kinds of sounds coming from the dock, so they won't be easily scared off." Laru explains confidently, and under her personal guidance, you end up with quite a bountiful catch.
DatingCharacterEvent.155301.3: Amid the gentle rocking of the waves, you feel an unusual sense of calm. The starlight dances in Shia’s eyes. She blinks, then looks at you. For the first time, you see how clear and bright her gaze is—as if reflecting the sea and sky.
DatingCharacterEvent.155302.3: The water becomes wider and shallower, so you and Shia stop and decide to take a rest on the bank. She smiles, "The feeling of the underground river is very different from the sea!"
DatingCharacterEvent.156301.3:
You seize the right moment and smack the button with a snap.

"Got it!" Nazuna slaps the claw machine at the same time, and the claw—thrown off by the interference—fails to catch anything, of course.

Nazuna doubles over with laughter, but she gives you all the prizes she won.
DatingCharacterEvent.156302.3:
She sits motionless, so much that you wonder if she's fallen asleep.

Suddenly the float bobs hard. She pulls fast—a small fish wriggles on the line.

"Hehehe~" She waves it in your face. Meanwhile, you haven't caught a thing.
DatingCharacterEvent.156303.3:
"Alright, alright. But if I don't get it, don't blame me..."

"Yay! I trust your amazing luck, Boss!"
Fortunately, you didn't disappoint Nazuna. Watching her lift the plushie up in delight, you couldn't help but smile as well.
DatingCharacterEvent.157301.3:
The great fish suddenly leaps out of the water, giving you a fleeting glimpse of its massive body.
Karin seems to realize something. She drops the fishing rod, runs to the stern, and grabs her parasol, shielding you from the towering wave that crashes up as the giant fish falls back into the sea.
"Are you okay!? Did you get wet!?"
"Not at all. Thank you, Karin~"
"Hmph~ You really should thank me. I only brought this parasol because you didn't put on sunscreen."
"Yes, yes~ We didn't catch the fish, but dinner's on me tonight."
DatingCharacterEvent.157302.3:
You finish bathing first and wait in the lounge for a while before Karin returns as well.
"Mmm~ It really is different from being in the ocean~"
"Welcome ba—hm? Your hair is still kinda wet."
"Huh~? Where?"
Karin suddenly flicks her ears, as if by instinct. When she reaches up to check, however, she finds no wet hair.
"No, still not dry."
The little movement just now was so cute that you want to see it again, but unfortunately, Karin sees right through your plan.
"I know I've dried it properly! I'm going back to my room!"
DatingCharacterEvent.158301.3:
"You know what? We were so busy on Snowish Festival we didn't even take a photo together."

Laru suddenly says.

"Why don't we do it now?"
DatingCharacterEvent.158302.3:
You've been standing in the freezing wind for an hour, yet not a single luminous fish has shown up.

Laru frowns, looking a little bit embarrassed.

"I don't understand. I definitely got the time right ... but where are the fish...?"
DatingCharacterEvent.159301.3:
You trail her through the cave for a while, seeing nothing remotely like a totem.
Just as you open your mouth to ask, she halts.
"Get over here. I can't move this by myself. I need you to help transport it."
You look where she's pointing: a corpse of a boar, completely overgrown with mushrooms.
DatingCharacterEvent.159302.3:
You worry her critique might offend the stall owner, but the middle-aged man's eyes light up with excitement.
"You have a sharp eye! I bet you'll appreciate this one."
He produces a more elaborate doll and pops open its chest, revealing a complete set of internal organs and bones.
Coronis stares at you, eyes burning with desire. Mesmerized by her gaze, you find yourself paying for the doll without a second thought.
DatingCharacterEvent.160301.3:
"There are too many abalones growing here. If the Trekkers find out, some of them will definitely come here at low tide to dig them up. And if they lose track of when the tide comes in, since this place only has one way out, there would be trouble."
"I see. Then we need someone to guard this entrance."
"But before that..." Willow smiled at you. "We can solve part of the problem at the source. Let's dig up some abalones and take them back. We're going to eat well tonight!"
DatingCharacterEvent.160302.3:
Realizing there was not much time left before the fireworks festival began, Willow immediately put the documents down.
"Let's go! Work can wait until after my vacation is over."
"But weren't you going to change clothes? It might get a little chilly out there..."
"It's fine, come on! We're gonna miss it!"

DatingCharacterEvent.103301.7:
You and Amber came across a lost kitten at the Port. It was attracted by the fish smell.

Although you weren't in a position to adopt it, the two of you enjoyed your time spent with the kitten.
DatingCharacterEvent.103303.7:
At the student cafeteria, you and Amber experienced the infamous "ladle technique". Your heartbeats rushed with each swing of the ladle.

Why is it that even in the cafeteria, what you see is never what you get?
DatingCharacterEvent.107301.7:
You and Tilia came across a raffle event at the dessert shop.

Her first instinct, however, was to check if the event was complying with all regulations.

What a diligent and justice-minded will-be knight she is... If only all Imperial Guard Knights were as dedicated as her.
DatingCharacterEvent.107302.7:
While strolling through the market with Tilia, the two of you encountered a thief.

Even though it was her day off, Tilia swiftly apprehended the criminal. Although it cost her a bit of free time, her smile grew even brighter after justice was upheld.
DatingCharacterEvent.108301.7:
While exploring the cave with Kasimira, you came across a broken bridge.

She escorted you across the gap in just a few swift leaps. As she soars with you in her arms, you finally understand why they are called the White Cat Troupe.
DatingCharacterEvent.108302.7:
Kasimira, with her gunfighting skills, made the dart game look effortless.

You thought she was aiming for the grand prize, but it turned out she was genuinely enjoying the thrill of hitting every bullseye.
DatingCharacterEvent.108303.7: Just as you and Kasimira were about to hit the hot springs, you found a baby monkey had beaten you to the water. Deeming it a lucky charm, Kasimira gladly handed over all her snacks to the little guy.
DatingCharacterEvent.110301.7:
Firenze is surprised by your choice.

You may want a little something to eat, yes, but you also sincerely want to learn more about her mysterious past.

Firenze accepts your suggestion and shares with you her school days.
DatingCharacterEvent.110302.7:
Firenze suddenly becomes interested in fishing, saying that it builds character, and asks you to go night fishing.

However, after not catching any fish for a while, she loses her patience and uses some special bait. She's no quitter.

And you, naturally, join her endeavor.
DatingCharacterEvent.111301.7:
You shared desserts with Iris at the shop.

She opened up about her worries and troubles. Luckily, the tasty sweets and your supportive company seemed to lift her spirits.

You've got this, Iris!
DatingCharacterEvent.111303.7: You and Iris went to the library. For her, it must be a place of relaxation. The life she once dreamed of lies hidden just behind that bookshelf. The shelf is large and sturdy, but it also blocks the sunlight streaming in from the window.
DatingCharacterEvent.112301.7:
With Noya's help, you learned about yet another type of dangerous mushroom and how to safely prepare it.

It was unexpectedly delicious treat when roasted—though it did make you feel a bit dizzy.
Maybe Noya's knowledge is not quite complete?
DatingCharacterEvent.112302.7: You watched Noya as she partook in a swordplay match and clinched victory. In the roaring cheers of the crowd, you wonder: Are all Trekkers this skilled in combat?
DatingCharacterEvent.113301.7:
You had a great time with Shimiao at the Dessert Shop. 

At first, she seemed worried about the sweets making her gain weight, but eventually she gave in to her cravings and the allure of the delicious treats.
DatingCharacterEvent.113302.7:
While you were at the market with Shimiao, you visited the whack-a-mole game booth.

Though she wasn't particularly good at it, the sheer force of her hits made you worry about her mental well-being.

Fortunately, after letting off some steam, she seemed to have found a sense of inner peace.
DatingCharacterEvent.113303.7:
You and Shimiao visited the hot spring town to unwind on your day off. Unfortunately, Shimiao overestimated how much heat she can withstand. You had to frantically flag down the proprietress to help drag her out of the water.
Afterward, Shimiao promptly added "hot spring endurance" to her training plan.
DatingCharacterEvent.114301.7: You ate heaps of cake with Chaton. Uh oh, your weekly sugar intake is probably maxed out.
DatingCharacterEvent.114302.7: You and Chaton played the balloon-shooting game at the Market, but today she wasn't feeling it and her aim was off.
DatingCharacterEvent.115301.7: Firefly showed you her secret reading nook in the library. You spent a quiet time reading with her among the shelves.
DatingCharacterEvent.115302.7: You and Firefly watched a magic performance at the market. Since she's too short, you let her sit on your shoulders to enjoy it.
DatingCharacterEvent.116301.7: You and Ridge discovered a delicious giant mushroom deep inside the cave. Could this delicacy be cultivated on a farm? It may require very exact conditions, but you would trust United Harvest's technology.
DatingCharacterEvent.116302.7: Together with Ridge, you ordered way too much at the Dessert Shop. You give her most of the extra. Cakes may be tasty, but they don't last long. Ridge, who loves stockpiling food, probably doesn't eat it often.
DatingCharacterEvent.116303.7:
Drawn in by rumors of amazing local treats, Ridge dragged you over to share a hot spring bun.
The delicious snack ended up awakening her competitive farming spirit. You smiled and cheered her on.
DatingCharacterEvent.117301.7:
When you met up with Jinglin at the dessert shop, she was standing outside the work area glass, observing the dessert preparation process.

Her curiosity about food was admirable.
DatingCharacterEvent.117302.7:
You and Jinglin discovered a great variety of mushrooms inside the cave.

With her extensive knowledge, she quickly identified all the edible mushrooms and packed them up to go... She was elated.
DatingCharacterEvent.117303.7: Jinglin cared far more about boiling eggs than taking a bath. She dragged you along to prep them, and you both spent half an hour glued to that basket.
DatingCharacterEvent.118301.7:
You and Coronis discovered the remains of an unknown creature in the cave.

Driven by her passion for science and medicine, she dug up some specimens and kept them. Death is not the end. It carries infinite hope.
DatingCharacterEvent.118303.7: With Coronis, you read medical journals in the library. Though she's been away from academia for a long time, she keeps up with the latest theories. Theory and practice are like two legs of progress—sometimes one leads, sometimes the other.
DatingCharacterEvent.119301.7:
Nanoha invited you to the dessert shop. Everything felt so familiar, even the staff knew you by sight.

However, this time there was a special surprise waiting for you—she prepared something unique and sweet just for you.
DatingCharacterEvent.119302.7:
Nanoha had no mission to attend to for once, so she invited you to explore the Market with her.

At the dart-throwing booth, you saw a different side of her—calm, confident, and remarkably skilled.
DatingCharacterEvent.119303.7:
During the cooking class, Nanoha took a tray of freshly baked cookies out of the oven Artifact.

As the rich aroma spread through the air, other people began casting envious glances your way.
DatingCharacterEvent.120301.7: You ventured into a cave with Canace in search of clues about an ancient civilization. Your hope for a new discovery, however, was dashed. When you tried to leave the cave, it started to rain. Canace comforted you and shared stories from a time before time.
DatingCharacterEvent.120303.7: Taken by Canace to the faculty cafeteria, you discovered the food there is markedly better than the students' meals. You enjoyed your meal and realized that even the so-called "Devil Teacher" had a caring side.
DatingCharacterEvent.120304.7: At the market, Canace found a cute pair of red glasses. She kept checking her reflection, but when she caught you smiling, she turned her back with a cool reply. The blush in the mirror told you everything.
DatingCharacterEvent.123301.7: You and Ann discovered an abandoned music box inside the cave. She's never seen such a thing before. Ann was eager to know how to make the little box sing again, fiddling with it nonstop until you finally taught her how to wind it.
DatingCharacterEvent.123302.7:
While exploring the market with Ann, you noticed her eyeing a watering can at the ring toss game.

After a few failed attempts, you lifted her up carefully, giving her a higher vantage point. She nailed it on her next try.
DatingCharacterEvent.123303.7: At the academy's open day, you took Ann to check out the library. As she settled down with a book, some students noticed and patiently walked her through the material. Your heart warmed as you quietly watched.
DatingCharacterEvent.125301.7:
While exploring the cave with Freesia, you fell victim to the mysterious "mushroom magic"!

The Freesia in your hallucination was an untouchable divine phantom. Thankfully, in reality, she stayed by your side throughout.
DatingCharacterEvent.125302.7:
Freesia invited you to meet at the Dessert Shop, but you noticed she seemed a bit down.

After hearing her story, your advice helped Freesia resolving the issue. Interpersonal relationships are often not as complicated as we imagine.
DatingCharacterEvent.125303.7: At the Market, Freesia spotted the chips being sold at a stall and couldn't tear herself away, so you bought the snack and gave it to her. You realized that Freesia really liked snacks.
DatingCharacterEvent.126301.7: Flora treated you to a dessert shop. You saw that they sell celebrity collaboration goods, so you ordered one tied to the star you were most familiar with. But the real person sitting across from you had more charm.
DatingCharacterEvent.126302.7: You and Flora watched a street magic performance together. You were lucky to witness this master magician giving aid to the young performer.
DatingCharacterEvent.126303.7: During a quiet moment on campus, you and Flora spontaneously reenacted a classic wand duel from a Stella Drama in a plaza corner. Judging by the applause from a few passing students, you completely nailed it.
DatingCharacterEvent.127301.7:
While exploring the cave with Teresa, you got cut by some gravel. Teresa immediately tended to your wound.

What should have been a painful experience turned out surprisingly gentle thanks to her practiced care.
DatingCharacterEvent.127302.7:
After exploring the market with Teresa, you exchanged gifts. As you had expected, you both ended up getting band-aids for each other.

Life is full of bumps and scrapes, but thankfully we can bandage each and every one of them.
DatingCharacterEvent.127303.7: While grabbing lunch after your academy tour, the food-serving artifact suddenly broke down. Teresa instinctively rushed over to fix it. Caught in a wave of applause, she bashfully hurried back to your side and focused entirely on her meal.
DatingCharacterEvent.130301.7:
You took the teddy bear.

But you didn't tell Donna that the real reason you looked twice was that it looked a little like her.
DatingCharacterEvent.130302.7: You and Donna found a pile of forgotten letters in the library. Messages left behind and buried by time.
DatingCharacterEvent.132301.7:
Together with Minova, you discovered glowing plants in the cave.

You carefully gathered up their sap, and she quickly caught on, marveling at your idea.
DatingCharacterEvent.132303.7:
You explored the library with Minova and she checked out a useful book for you.

And though she tried to hide it, you noticed that she slipped a shoujo manga in there, too.
DatingCharacterEvent.132304.7:
Minova and you spotted an enormous lollipop in the specialty souvenir shop. It was almost as big as Minova's bat. Drawn by your love of lollipops and pure curiosity, the two of you decided to buy one on the spot.

However, when you unwrapped it, you were surprised to find that the giant "lollipop" was actually made up of countless normal-sized lollipops tightly packed together inside a spherical shell.
DatingCharacterEvent.133301.7:
You and Nazuka explored the Market and spotted a shady merchant.

When you both checked his stall and lifted the cover, you found piles of weapons...

However, after closer inspection, they turned out to be nothing more than realistic toys.
DatingCharacterEvent.133302.7:
You and Nazuka took a small boat out on the water. She noticed a waterwheel turning on the distant shore.

She said it was always her favorite sight, but now it held new meaning because you were next to her.

You understood what she meant, and the two of you watched the waterwheel in peaceful silence.
DatingCharacterEvent.134301.7:
You went to the dessert shop with Fuyuka, and the shopkeeper noticed her, so she got roped into being the Manager for a Day.

The two of you walked away with generous pay and delicious cakes. It was tiring, but sweet in every sense.
DatingCharacterEvent.134302.7:
You and Fuyuka ventured into The Cave together. Partway through, she sensed danger ahead and decided to stall for a bit.

Worried that you might think her a coward, she grew uneasy. You saw through it, reassured her, and taught her what courage truly means.

Your words brought her relief and your bond grew a little stronger.
DatingCharacterEvent.135301.7:
While exploring the cave with Mistique, you discovered the remains of an ancient shrine dedicated to a powerful Artifact.

Mistique documented and preserved the site, noting that this was in keeping with the professional ethics of a great Witch.
DatingCharacterEvent.135302.7:
After strolling the library with Mistique, you were exhausted and fell asleep in a chair.

Mistique seized this opportunity to snap a photo of your sleeping face.

Despite all your protests, it seemed unlikely she will ever hand this photo over to you.
DatingCharacterEvent.135303.7: You and Mistique signed up for a time trial race at the Market where any and all forms of transportation were allowed. Although you couldn't ride the broom and compete alongside her, you used the map saved on your phone to guide her instead. In the end, with your flawless groundwork, the two of you easily won the race.
DatingCharacterEvent.137301.7:
Eleanor carefully chose a dessert shop and sampled its offerings to make sure both the cake and black tea were up to her standards.
Afterwards, she became completely hooked on feeding you cake.
DatingCharacterEvent.137302.7:
You and Eleanor were enjoying the hot spring when she suddenly disappeared from sight.
Just as you began to worry that something had happened, Eleanor surfaced wearing a diving mask.
You could only laugh in exasperation. Who else but her would come up with such a wild idea—and have the adventurous spirit to try it?
DatingCharacterEvent.140301.7: You and Sparkla spend all day trying to win the grand prize at a market game booth. Walking away empty-handed, you console each other and vow to get your revenge at the Monolith.
DatingCharacterEvent.140302.7:
You sneak Sparkla into the Grace Imperium's library. She gets completely absorbed in their fairy tale collection, making for a surprisingly fulfilling day.
Afterward, you promise each other to return and read every single story on those shelves together.
DatingCharacterEvent.141301.7:
After marveling at the "masterpiece murals" inside the cave, Chixia begins to dream about one day becoming a mural master.

She promises that when that day comes, she'll gift you with a masterpiece, signed personally by her.
DatingCharacterEvent.141302.7:
In the end, Chixia shared the crooked little cake with you, savoring each bite while lamenting that the world now had one less piece of edible art.

Her cake drawing somehow ended up inside your backpack. You have no idea when she slipped it in.
DatingCharacterEvent.141303.7:
You and Chixia arrived at the hot spring town, only to discover that Chixia, much like a cat, hated soaking in water. Although she eventually agreed to give the hot springs a try, the empty private bath—with nothing but the sound of running water and the echo of the room—somehow unsettled her even more.
In the end, at Chixia's insistence, you had no choice but to go into the private bath with her to "investigate." It turned out that the frightening shadow in the water was nothing more than her own reflection.
DatingCharacterEvent.142301.7:
You and Cosette were enjoying desserts at the dessert shop.

She had never seen such unusual delicacies before.

With your encouragement, she mustered the courage to give them a try.

Judging by her reaction, it was clear she's a fan of sweets.
DatingCharacterEvent.142302.7:
You explored the bustling market with Cosette. It was an unfamiliar environment for her.

She fell in love with a trinket at a stall.

Even though it was a bit overpriced, you bought it for her as a gift.
DatingCharacterEvent.143301.7:
The market goods were plentiful but uninteresting. So you suggested checking out a new vintage shop instead.

The real fun of these places lies in the thrill of the hunt. Judging by the results, you both scored big time.
DatingCharacterEvent.143302.7:
Wraith led you deep into a cavern to show off a private bathhouse she built herself.

Just as you were getting ready to relax, you realized the water temperature was ... nothing like the hot springs you were expecting.
DatingCharacterEvent.144301.7:
Talking with Chitose on a small boat near the coast, you realized you still had a long way to go before becoming a true wielder.

The jade-like blade by her side accompanied her travels, always reflecting back to her a sky veiled in shadows.
DatingCharacterEvent.144302.7:
At the dessert shop with Chitose, she said she didn't deserve such fine treatment, but you got her to see it differently.

"I do not care for such indulgence," she said—yet all afternoon, she had been smiling.
DatingCharacterEvent.145301.7:
A ninja's discipline and a master's stern authority quietly softened in the face of fluffy cream and warm jam.

Their similar tastes and careful pretense eventually became an unspoken understanding.

Someday, they'll be able to sit across from each other and share the sweetness they love most.
DatingCharacterEvent.145302.7:
Perhaps one day she will cross the sea again and return to her homeland.

But neither of you knows whether that day will ever come.
Until then, the best you can do is keep going.
DatingCharacterEvent.147301.7:
Together with Caramel, you discovered a spot at sea that was perfect for a stage.

For once, you enjoyed a complete, uninterrupted concert—one meant just for you. You couldn't help but look forward to the next time...
DatingCharacterEvent.147302.7:
Strolling the market with Caramel, she came across a rare find—an Artifact that functioned as effects pedal.

As she was short on coin, you paid for it, and she promised to repay the favor with a free performance.

You knew she would be willing to play for you whenever, wherever.
DatingCharacterEvent.147303.7: Short on cash, you and Caramel shared a single parfait. The shop owner immediately assumed you were a couple, upgrading your order to a super jumbo parfait as part of today's promotion.
DatingCharacterEvent.149301.7:
You and Gerie discovered the long-forgotten remains of dead adventurers inside the cave.

She laid them to rest with reverence. In the stillness, you felt her quiet faith.
DatingCharacterEvent.149302.7:
While sightseeing on a small boat near the coast with Gerie, you shared a quiet moment underneath the moonlight, breathing in each other's presence.

You exchanged heartfelt prayers; though the waves rolled restlessly in the night, your hearts remained calm.
DatingCharacterEvent.149303.7:
You went to the hot spring town with Gerie. When you two passed by a yukata shop, she suddenly went in and changed into a different outfit. You could tell she was trying to dress up as a spirit from the legend of Goodwind village, but things didn't go the way she expected. Instead of feeling terrified, other people on the scene kept complimenting her on her elegant looks.
You found the whole scene pretty funny and just stood there smiling as she spiraled into confusion.
DatingCharacterEvent.150301.7:
