DictionaryDiagram.40060701.1: Arc of Abundance: Perfect Blind Toss
DictionaryDiagram.40080101.1: Welcome to the Cooling Supply Station
DictionaryDiagram.10010101.2: Trekkers possess unique <color=#0abec5>Elements</color> and <color=#0abec5>combat styles</color>. Encounter more Trekkers and strategically deploy them to tackle diverse challenges.
DictionaryDiagram.10020101.2: Using EXP items cam raise <color=#0abec5>Trekker Level</color>, significantly boosting all base stats.
DictionaryDiagram.10020102.2:
Each Trekker reaches a level cap every <color=#0abec5>10</color> levels.
By consuming specific advancement materials to complete <color=#0abec5>Tier-up</color>, you can boost their stats and <color=#0abec5>increase the level cap</color>.
DictionaryDiagram.10020103.2: Upon reaching <color=#0abec5>Tier 3</color>, Trekkers can unlock their <color=#0abec5>Awakened Appearance</color>, which can be set on the home screen.
DictionaryDiagram.10030101.2:
Each Trekker has different skills that can be categorized as: 
Auto Attack, Active Skill, Support Skill, and Ultimate.
DictionaryDiagram.10030102.2: By consuming skill upgrade materials, you can level up skills to enhance their effectiveness.
DictionaryDiagram.10040102.2: Emblems come with random Affix(es) and their corresponding Trekker tags. Upgrading the emblem to a specific level will unlock the bonus for the Affixes.
DictionaryDiagram.10040103.2: When the emblem's Affixes align with the Trekker's Elements, the bonus provided by the Affixes gain additional boosts.
DictionaryDiagram.10050101.2: Each Trekker has unique Potentials for both Main and Support roles. Participate in Ascension to unlock them. Different Potential combinations for the same Trekker form distinct combat builds.
DictionaryDiagram.10060101.2: Recruiting duplicate Trekkers grants <color=#0abec5>Trekker Soul Keys</color>.These keys allow you to activate <color=#0abec5>Talents</color>, boosting the Trekker's Elements, and unlock visual effects. In addition to recruitment, Soul Keys can also be obtained through other methods.
DictionaryDiagram.10060102.2: Activating <color=#0abec5>Talents</color> allows Trekkers to gain various Element bonuses.When all Talents in the same tier are activated, additional abilities will be unlocked, and the next tier will become available to activate.
DictionaryDiagram.10070101.2: Trekkers gain <color=#0abec5>Affinity</color> over time. Raising Affinity unlocks extra archive entries, voice lines, and personal stories. Completing a storyline grants exclusive <color=#0abec5>Memory Snapshots</color>. Affinity also provides minor Element boosts.
DictionaryDiagram.10070102.2: Each Trekker has unique <color=#0abec5>Affinity Tasks</color>. Completing them grants Affinity. You can also raise Affinity through <color=#0abec5>invitations and gifts</color>, in addition to combat.
DictionaryDiagram.10080101.2: Each Trekker has 3 emblem slots, which unlock at different levels. Once unlocked, emblems can be equipped to enhance the character's abilities.
DictionaryDiagram.10080102.2: Once an Emblem slot is activated, specific materials are required for forging. These materials can be obtained through Emblem Trials.
DictionaryDiagram.10080103.2: The types and unlocking order of emblem slots for each Trekker do not follow a fixed pattern.
DictionaryDiagram.10080104.2: Forging an Emblem grants random affixes. Mid-tier Emblems (unlocked at Trekker Lv. 80) may grant Skill Level bonuses, while high-tier Emblems (unlocked at Trekker Lv. 90) may grant Potential Level bonuses.
DictionaryDiagram.10080105.2: Consume specific materials to Reforge an Emblem, generating a new set of random affixes.
DictionaryDiagram.10080106.2: During Reforging, Lock items can be used to preserve selected affixes. Locked affixes are guaranteed to remain in the next roll. Up to 2 affixes can be locked during Reforge.
DictionaryDiagram.10080107.2: Use Drop of Purity to Temper an Emblem, enhancing specific affixes. Each Emblem can be Tempered up to 2 times. If Tempered affixes are not locked during Reforge, the Emblem will revert. Consumed Drop of Purity will not be refunded.
DictionaryDiagram.20010101.2: Spending Vigor to complete battles allows you to level up your Authorization Level and receive generous supplies!
DictionaryDiagram.20020101.2: Upon completing the Ascension, you can save "Records" and use them to challenge other levels.
DictionaryDiagram.20020102.2: During <color=#0abec5>Ascension</color>, you can select and collect <color=#0abec5>Potentials</color> to enhance Trekkers' abilities. Acquired Potentials will also be saved in your "Records."
DictionaryDiagram.20020103.2: During <color=#0abec5>Ascension</color>, you can collect <color=#0abec5>Musical Notes</color> to gain various Element Bonuses.The Musical Notes will also be saved in your records and can be used for challenges in other game modes.
DictionaryDiagram.20020104.2: Collected Musical Notes can be used to activate the <color=#0abec5>Harmony Skills</color> of equipped Discs, providing buffs for the squad. And the activated Harmony Skills will also be saved in your records and can be used for challenges in other game modes.
DictionaryDiagram.20020105.2: During <color=#0abec5>Ascension</color>, you will encounter random events that offer different reward options once completed.
DictionaryDiagram.20020107.2: You can save records of your adventure after completing the <color=#0abec5>Ascension</color>, which will grant you access for various other activities.Each record includes the composition of Trekkers, their Potentials, and Musical Notes.
DictionaryDiagram.20020201.2: Completing <color=#0abec5>Ascension</color> or finishing <color=#0abec5>Research Plans</color> grants materials for Monolith Research.Invest materials on <color=#0abec5>Research Nodes</color> to earn various bonuses for Ascensions.
DictionaryDiagram.20020202.2: Monolith Research consists of 3 <color=#0abec5>layers</color>. You must complete all the <color=#0abec5>researches</color> of the previous layer before you can proceed to the next layer.
DictionaryDiagram.20020203.2: You need to unlock the current research layer and complete the research of <color=#0abec5>prerequisite nodes</color> before you can begin the corresponding research.
DictionaryDiagram.20030101.2: Upon completing Ascension, you can save a record, which includes the composition of Trekkers and their Runic Discs. You can load a record at any time to sync the stored information of Trekkers and Discs.
DictionaryDiagram.20030102.2: Your records will also preserve activated Trekker Potentials and Musical Notes during Ascension.Once saved, they will no longer change.
DictionaryDiagram.20030201.2: Creates Potential Presets in Trekker Selection.
DictionaryDiagram.20030202.2: In the Potential Preset menu, you can choose a saved preset or create a new one.
DictionaryDiagram.20030203.2: The Potentials and levels selected in a preset will be marked during Ascension.
DictionaryDiagram.20030204.2: You can share and import Preset Codes.
DictionaryDiagram.20080103.2:
In Summit Show, you can manually select Affixes to increase the difficulty.
Pick your Affix and challenge higher-difficulty stages!
DictionaryDiagram.20080201.2:
Select Start Show to begin the Summit Show.
You can select modifiers to adjust the difficulty.
DictionaryDiagram.20080202.2: After completing a successful show, rewards will accumulate based on the highest difficulty completed, for up to 48 hours.
DictionaryDiagram.20080203.2: The three items obtained from accumulated rewards can be used for ranking boost, increasing Fan Contribution and Lilibea's stream popularity!
DictionaryDiagram.20080204.2:
During the event, popularity battles will take place in time.
At daily settlement, if your popularity exceeds the opponent's, you'll earn rewards. Come support her to win!
DictionaryDiagram.20090101.2: Carrying a Disc into the Monolith will provide your squad with stat bonuses corresponding to the Disc.
DictionaryDiagram.20090102.2: When equipped in the main slot, the Disc automatically activates its Melody Skill upon entering the Monolith. This powerful skill greatly enhances your Trekkers' combat capabilities. Its level scales with the Disc's Crescendo Stars — the higher the stars, the stronger the skill.
DictionaryDiagram.20090103.2: If the Disc is equipped in the main slot: The Harmony Skill requires collecting specific types and quantities of Element Musical Notes during Ascension to activate.
DictionaryDiagram.20090104.2: If the Disc is equipped in the support slot: When you enter the Monolith, the Musical Notes corresponding to that specific Disc will be added as initial Musical Notes. These Musical Notes can also be used to activate the Harmony Skill in the main slot.
DictionaryDiagram.20100101.2: The Trekkers you meet and recruit during your journey will be added to your cellphone's Heartlink contact list. Chat sessions will automatically trigger after a certain period or through specific in-game events.
DictionaryDiagram.20100102.2: During the chat sessions you can choose different responses, which will trigger a variety of replies.
DictionaryDiagram.20100103.2: For each contact, all triggered chat sessions are recorded in the list. You can switch between completed and ongoing conversations from here.
DictionaryDiagram.20110101.2: Certain activities in the world, such as Bounty Trials and certain event levels, consume Vigor.You can spend Vigor to increase your Authorization Level.
DictionaryDiagram.20110102.2: Vigor naturally regenerates by 1 every 6 minutes. You can also restore it by using Stellanite Dust or recovery items like Energy Drinks.
DictionaryDiagram.20110103.2: When Vigor is full, 1 Vigor will be stored in the Vigor Reserve every X minutes, up to a maximum of XX. Reserved Vigor can be withdrawn and used at any time.
DictionaryDiagram.20120101.2:
The Arena features different difficulties and elements, requiring Trekkers to start from the lowest level arena.
Completing Arena challenges grants abundant rewards.
DictionaryDiagram.20120102.2:
Arenas with varying elements and difficulties may have specific rulesets.
Adapt your battle strategy and Trekker selection accordingly!
DictionaryDiagram.20130101.2: Cataclysm Survivor has stages with multiple difficulty levels. You can choose which one to challenge.
DictionaryDiagram.20130102.2: Cataclysm Survivor requires two separate squads to take on a challenge. Trekkers cannot be shared between the squads!
DictionaryDiagram.20130103.2: In Cataclysm Survivor, you earn points during combat based on the number of enemies defeated. Reach the seasonal score milestones to claim rewards.
DictionaryDiagram.20130104.2:
Collecting Destiny Cards earns you Cataclysm Survivor Talent Points. These points can be used to unlock nodes in the Cataclysm Survivor Talent Tree.
The Talent Tree provides various bonuses for your future Cataclysm Survivor challenges.
DictionaryDiagram.20130201.2: In Cataclysm Survivor battles, earn EXP to level up your Trekkers. Each level grants a random Destiny Card that boosts attributes for that run. Destiny Card effects carry over between the first and second halves of the battle.
DictionaryDiagram.20130202.2: After Cataclysm Talents are activated, you will receive a powerful Special Destiny Card once you've collected a certain number of cards from the same pack!
DictionaryDiagram.20130203.2: An unknown force is affecting this battle! Pressing and holding Dodge will not activate Dash in Cataclysm Survivor.
DictionaryDiagram.20140101.2: Proving Grounds features multiple bosses for players to challenge weekly, and each boss can be challenged 3 times per week. Challenge attempts are replenished every Monday. You will not earn rewards for taking down bosses if you are out of challenge attempts.
DictionaryDiagram.20140102.2: Each boss drops its own unique materials. As different Trekkers have different development needs, you need to challenge specific bosses to obtain the required development materials.
DictionaryDiagram.20150101.2: Boss Blitz is a periodically refreshed event. Each cycle features two special Blitz missions with unique rules for Trekkers to conquer.
DictionaryDiagram.20150102.2: Each special Blitz mission tracks its own Star count. Your total Stars for the cycle is the sum of the Stars achieved in both missions.
DictionaryDiagram.20150103.2: You can claim Stellante Dusts based on the total Stars you earned in the cycle.
DictionaryDiagram.20150104.2: Deal DMG within the time limit to earn DMG Score proportional to DMG dealt. Execute actions matching the bosses' mechanics to earn Technique Score per successful attempt.
DictionaryDiagram.20150105.2: Earn Stars by reaching specific score thresholds. Your highest Star count per mission is recorded.
DictionaryDiagram.20150106.2: When a Blitz mission is complete and your score is recorded, the Trekkers used in this mission will be locked. Using locked Trekkers in another Blitz mission and recording a new score will clear your score and stars for the previous mission.
DictionaryDiagram.20160101.2: Challenging a boss requires <color=#0abec5>Showdown Decree</color>.This item will be restored to maximum quantity daily during the event.
DictionaryDiagram.20160102.2: Select a boss of any <color=#0abec5>difficulty</color> and begin the challenge.You can engage in practice battles with bosses without consuming Challenge Tickets via <color=#0abec5>Simulation</color>.
DictionaryDiagram.20160201.2: Even if you fail to defeat the boss in battle, you can dispatch a follow-up squad to challenge again.In subsequent battles, the selected records must not include Trekkers who have been deployed before.
DictionaryDiagram.20170101.2: The Operation: Shadow Siege is a new operation system initiated by Iori of the Trekker Association.Track down and hunt each period's target to earn Hunter Medals—a proof of contribution issued by the Association.
DictionaryDiagram.20170102.2: The Trekker Association issues Tracking Permits and Siege Licenses based on each Trekker Guild's Activity level (Ⅴigor consumption). The former is used for tracking requests to gather clues. The latter allows cooperation with other Guilds to complete hunts.
DictionaryDiagram.20170103.2: Consume Tracking Permits to begin tracking that will trigger different outcomes.When tracking progress is full, you can launch a hunt against the target.
DictionaryDiagram.20170104.2: Earn points in Hunts to secure a star rating at settlement.The Hunt concludes once the star limit is reached. A single Siege target requires multiple Hunts to defeat, meaning cooperation between different Guilds is the key to victory!
DictionaryDiagram.20170105.2: Join the Siege to boost your seasonal Siege Level and unlock powerful buffs.Your Siege Level resets when a new bounty season begins.
DictionaryDiagram.30010101.2:
Trekkers automatically attack enemies within their range.
Select the <color=#0abec5>Skill</color> button to cast skills.
Once your Ultimate is charged, select the <color=#0abec5>Ultimate</color> button to cast it.
DictionaryDiagram.30010501.2: The Trekker will perform Auto Attacks when a target enters their Attack Range.
DictionaryDiagram.30010601.2: Select the Main Skill button to cast the Main Skill.
DictionaryDiagram.30010701.2: Any of the <color=#0abec5>Main Trekker's</color> Auto Attacks and Skills against enemies charges the Ultimate cumulatively.
DictionaryDiagram.30010801.2: Select the Dodge button to dodge monsters's attacks. Invulnerable while dodging.
DictionaryDiagram.30010901.2: Hold the Dodge button to dash. The Trekker will not auto attack during while moving.
DictionaryDiagram.30011001.2: Select the Support Skill button to cast the Support Skill.
DictionaryDiagram.30011101.2: Select the support Trekker's Ultimate button to cast the Ultimate.
DictionaryDiagram.30011201.2:
Characters can inflict marks on targets or trigger existing marks for various additional effects.
Each character can trigger up to one mark per second for the same target.
DictionaryDiagram.30011202.2:
As support characters, Support and Versatile characters apply Marks of their element.
A main character who is a Vanguard of the same element can then trigger this Mark.
DictionaryDiagram.30011301.2: When a Trekker attacks a monster, the DMG dealt will vary based on the monster's elemental vulnerability or resistance.
DictionaryDiagram.30011302.2: When a Trekker attacks a monster, the DMG dealt will vary based on the monster's elemental vulnerability or resistance.
DictionaryDiagram.30011401.2: When challenging a level, pay attention to the level's recommended elements!
DictionaryDiagram.30011501.2: When a target has Resilience, its actions cannot be interrupted by external forces. When the target takes DMG, its Resilience is reduced.
DictionaryDiagram.30011601.2: A target with Broken Resilience will be immobilized for a prolonged period and takes additional DMG from Trekkers.
DictionaryDiagram.30011701.2: If a target has been inflicted with a mark, try attacking it with a skill of the same element that can trigger the mark!
DictionaryDiagram.30011801.2: You will receive Musical Notes by completing battle, making purchases in the shop, and encountering random events in the Monolith Walkthrough.
DictionaryDiagram.40010101.2: Areas buried with rare treasures await Trekkers. Explore these areas to uncover these treasures, accumulate points, and earn generous rewards.
DictionaryDiagram.40010102.2: During the event, every 20 Stamina consumed grants 1 Treasure Shovel. A certain number of shovels will be sent to your backpack upon daily log-in.
DictionaryDiagram.40010103.2: Select a tile to hit it with the Treasure Shovel and reduce its Durability. The tile downgrades with durability loss until it is destroyed. Fragile tiles are an exception: they cannot be created by downgrading, and they are destroyed automatically when adjacent tiles are destroyed.
DictionaryDiagram.40010104.2: Buried treasures come in four shapes (see above) and occupy multiple tiles. Pay attention to the parts revealed in the destroyed tiles to collect treasures more efficiently.
DictionaryDiagram.40010105.2: Collected treasures are automatically converted into points. Accumulate points to complete event tasks and claim rewards.
DictionaryDiagram.40010106.2: Each floor contains 3 randomly placed treasures. You will progress to the next floor upon collecting all of them. When you progress to a new floor, 2 random Trekkers will spawn and provide Support Skills. Use these skills wisely to obtain treasures more efficiently.
DictionaryDiagram.40020101.2: Upon entering a match, you will start with a few random Trekker pieces from your preset squad, then gradually obtain the remaining ones over the following waves of monsters. All Trekkers in this mode have redesigned stats, independent of your own roster.
DictionaryDiagram.40020102.2: Monsters advance along a fixed path. Place characters on the slots to defeat them before they reach the finish line. Keep an eye on your defense durability — it represents the maximum number of monsters the end zone can withstand.
DictionaryDiagram.40020103.2: Characters will perform Auto Attacks. When the Skill Charge bar is full and the time is right, characters will cast skills automatically.
DictionaryDiagram.40020201.2:
Defeat monsters or wait to gain EXP over time. Once your EXP bar fills up, it's converted into an Upgrade Point.
Each stage has its own limit on how many Upgrade Points you can earn.
DictionaryDiagram.40020202.2: Tap the character's Upgrade button once you've collected enough Upgrade Points to level her up and enhance her abilities.
DictionaryDiagram.40020203.2: Activate a character's powerful Potentials at Level 4 and Level 6.
DictionaryDiagram.40020301.2: In some matches, you'll have access to special items you've prepared beforehand, each with unique effects in battle. Your item this match is Crunchy Shaved Ice. Use it to freeze monsters in a large area once and slow them down for a prolonged period.
DictionaryDiagram.40020401.2: Teresa creates a water field that gives buffs to nearby friendly units.
DictionaryDiagram.40020402.2: Fuyuka deals massive DMG to close-by targets over time.
DictionaryDiagram.40020403.2: Nazuna's penguin plushie follows the target and then explodes, dealing various debuffs to the target.
DictionaryDiagram.40020501.2: Incoming enemies are instantly defeated if they fall into the water!
DictionaryDiagram.40020502.2:
Coronis' skill covers a wider area, indicated by a blue circle.
She can also drag enemies toward her. Deploy her now to see how it works!
DictionaryDiagram.40020601.2: Coronis can drag enemies into the water, while Nazuka can push them in. Deploy both to try out this strategy!
DictionaryDiagram.40020701.2:
Watch out for Elite enemies! They have higher Weight and cannot be dragged or pushed far.
However, attacks from Ann's summons reduce their Weight, allowing you to move them.
DictionaryDiagram.40020801.2: The special item for this Chess Defense is Large Pep Pep Juice. Use it to instantly recharge the skills of all Trekker pieces within a small radius.
DictionaryDiagram.40020901.2: Firenze summons Shadow Clones to aid in battle.
DictionaryDiagram.40021001.2: Boss enemies have even higher Weight than Elites. You'll need to find additional ways to reduce their Weight if you want to drag or push them!
DictionaryDiagram.40021101.2: Watch out for Bush on the board. Enemy units hidden in Bush are immune to damage.
DictionaryDiagram.40021102.2: Use a Growth Inhibitor to clear Bush from the battlefield.
DictionaryDiagram.40021201.2: Elite enemies are here! They can cast spells to spawn new patches of Bush!
DictionaryDiagram.40021301.2: Boss enemies cast stronger spells than Elites, spawning Bush over massive areas!
DictionaryDiagram.40022001.2: An idle character continuously accumulates Heat. At max Heat, the character becomes Heatstroke and cannot attack or use skills for a short duration.
DictionaryDiagram.40022101.2: Using Canned Stormcloud creates rainfall over an area, significantly reducing the Heat of a character.
DictionaryDiagram.40022102.2: An elite enemy appears! If a character stands inside the heated zone around it, Heat will build up faster.
DictionaryDiagram.40022201.2: Characters on Ablaze deployment slots build up Heat faster. Use Canned Stormcloud to extinguish the fire.
DictionaryDiagram.40022202.2: An elite enemy appears! It shoots fireballs that set deployment slots Ablaze and increase the Heat of characters on those slots.
DictionaryDiagram.40022301.2: A boss enemy appears! It summons full‑screen flame waves and calls down heavenly fire to set deployment slots Ablaze. Be prepared!
DictionaryDiagram.40030101.2:
Select Start Packing to start the game!
Pack as many cookies correctly as possible in a limited time!
DictionaryDiagram.40030201.2:
In the Gentle Brew stage, tap the corresponding cookies below based on the cookie pattern shown on the plate, then place them inside the box. Correct placement earns points and builds progress.
Completing each box yields additional points. Reach the target progress within the time limit to clear the challenge.
DictionaryDiagram.40030301.2: In the High Pouring stage, the placement order of cookies changes. Every new gift box may present with a completely different sequence!
DictionaryDiagram.40030401.2: In the Boiling Beats stage, you need to place cookies at just the right time. Perfect timing awards higher points.
DictionaryDiagram.40030501.2:
In Mastery Mode, you must both follow the placement sequence when placing cookies AND pay attention to the timing.
Multiple incorrect cookie placements or missing the beat can lead to challenge failure!
DictionaryDiagram.40040101.2:
Select the launch button to fire the marble, which will damage any tiles it hits.
Move the launch pad to catch the marble. Each time the marble falls and is destroyed, one life point will be deducted. If all life points are lost, you'll fail the stage.
DictionaryDiagram.40040102.2: Trekker skills automatically recharge. Once fully charged, you can unleash the skill to destroy tiles.
DictionaryDiagram.40040103.2: Destroying tiles earns you stage points. When your points reach the target score, you win.
DictionaryDiagram.40040104.2: Some stages feature field devices. The speed-altering device can change the motions of energy balls that pass through them: The blue devices speed them up; the red devices slow them down. When an explosive device is destroyed by the player's skill or an energy ball, it detonates and destroys nearby destructible objects.
DictionaryDiagram.40040201.2:
Destroying tiles has a chance to drop various items.
Move the launch pad to catch and collect these items.
Items can be either Buffs or Debuffs. Aim for the best, and dodge the rest!
DictionaryDiagram.40040301.2: Some stages contain monsters that will launch bombs at you. Be sure to dodge them! Direct hits to your launch pad will reduce life points.
DictionaryDiagram.40040401.2: Some stages feature ejector pillars that will repel and accelerate any marbles that strike them. There may also be black holes that warp the trajectory of any marbles passing nearby.
DictionaryDiagram.40040402.2: Some stages feature field devices. The Gravity Well alters the motions of energy balls passing through them: The blue devices attract them; the red devices repel them.
DictionaryDiagram.40040501.2: When an energy ball enters the portal, it is instantly transported to the other end.
DictionaryDiagram.40040601.2: After you pick up the Gravity Button, the portal will actively draw in nearby energy balls for a period of time.
DictionaryDiagram.40050101.2: Follow the instructions of Bernina and Virigia to dive into the fun world of Fatebound Stellar Deck!
DictionaryDiagram.40050102.2: Flip the Elemental Cards to make specific hands and win Fate Coins.Achieve the Fate Coin collection goal before your remaining turns run out to win the match!
DictionaryDiagram.40050103.2: You can obtain Fatebound Stellar Cards before each turn starts. Each card grants an additional buff, giving you more advantages.
DictionaryDiagram.40050104.2: You must choose and sign a contract during the match.Fulfilling it grants bonuses, but failing to fulfill a contract 3 times will end the match.
DictionaryDiagram.40050105.2: In Transcendence Mirror matches, all chips obtained will be cleared at the completion of each difficulty.When entering a new difficulty, recruit an Assistant to receive starting chips as your initial capital.
DictionaryDiagram.40060101.2:
In Arc of Abundance, you control a soda cannon to launch Sherlocks into the shopping basket.
Hold and pull the cannon back to adjust the launch speed and angle. Release to launch Sherlock—use the aiming line to guide your shot.
DictionaryDiagram.40060102.2: If Sherlock lands in a shopping basket matching the color of his scarf, you will earn more points.
DictionaryDiagram.40060201.2: When a Sherlock lands in a shopping basket marked with a special icon, you get a chance to select an item.
DictionaryDiagram.40060202.2: Pick your preferred item and clear the stage!
DictionaryDiagram.40060203.2: You can store up to 2 items each game. Each new item acquired will replace the earliest acquired one. If you find a stage challenging, use the items to gain an advantage!
DictionaryDiagram.40060301.2: A new mechanism appears—Blower! Use the power of Ventus to blow Sherlock into the shopping basket!
DictionaryDiagram.40060401.2: A new mechanism appears—Teleport Basin! Use its power to move Sherlock swiftly through shortcuts!
DictionaryDiagram.40060501.2: Sherlock will bounce between obstacles! Use the stage layout wisely and calculate trajectories to launch Sherlock into the shopping basket!
DictionaryDiagram.40060701.2: Welcome to Perfect Blind Toss mode! The shopping basket is initially invisible. Launch a Sherlock to scout the path, then adjust the launch angle and speed based on the trail left behind to achieve a perfect Blind Toss!
DictionaryDiagram.40070101.2: Swing the grapple to grab treasures from the room. Reach the target score before time runs out to complete the challenge.
DictionaryDiagram.40070102.2: Different supplies vary in points and weight. Remember, the shiny ones are usually more valuable.
DictionaryDiagram.40070103.2:
Low-value but heavy briefcases will slow you down. When necessary, use the Explosive Skill to destroy them.
Note: Explosive Skill has limited uses, so time it well!
DictionaryDiagram.40070201.2: This operation spans two rooms. You must reach the target score in the current room to unlock the next.
DictionaryDiagram.40070202.2: Watch out for these bomb traps! They may not only destroy nearby supplies but also potentially trigger chain explosions.
DictionaryDiagram.40070301.2: Mechanical devices roam the room. Sweepers' allegiance is unclear, but drones are dangerous sentries—stay away from them.
DictionaryDiagram.40070302.2: Watch out for patrolling drones! If they detect you, they'll trigger an alarm and drastically reduce your remaining time.
DictionaryDiagram.40070303.2:
Sweepers' behavior are unpredictable. They can be friend or foe.
They often snatch items before you do, but if you catch them, the points still count as yours.
Caution: Sweepers may bump into other objects while moving and slow down your progress.
DictionaryDiagram.40070304.2: The Freeze Field can temporarily immobilize all moving devices in the scene. Timing it right will give you more time to act.
DictionaryDiagram.40070401.2:
Watch out for these Detection Artifacts. If they detect you, they'll trigger an alarm and reduce your remaining time.
Note: Detection Artifact cannot be grabbed.
DictionaryDiagram.40070402.2: Freeze the rotating Detection Artifacts, and your mission will be much easier.
DictionaryDiagram.40070501.2: Mysterious supplies and Special Intel missions that appear during the mission may help you score higher.
DictionaryDiagram.40070502.2:
Grab the supplies on the Special Mission and earn bonus points.
Different missions demand different quantities which yield different bonus points, though single-item missions are often more efficient.
DictionaryDiagram.40070503.2: Mysterious supplies offer powerful effects. Stack and combine their effects, and even a heavy, low-value briefcase can turn into valuable loot.
DictionaryDiagram.40080101.2:
Welcome to the Cooling Supply Station! The summer bash is in full swing, and you'll be running this refreshing little shop, whipping up custom ice cream for every customer.
But keep in mind, a customer's patience melts away as fast as ice cream—don't keep them waiting!
DictionaryDiagram.40080102.2:
Once you open for business, check the order bubbles next to the customers to see what they want.
Tap the toppings to select the right ice cream scoops for their order!
DictionaryDiagram.40080103.2: After picking your ice cream scoops, don't forget the crucial final step: adding the toppings! You need to get both the flavor and the toppings right to successfully complete an order!
DictionaryDiagram.40080104.2:
If you get the flavor or toppings wrong, the customer won't be happy!
But don't panic! Just tap the trash can to toss the mistake, then quickly whip up a fresh one!
DictionaryDiagram.40080201.2:
Is that special customer ... Sherlock?!
Complete its order to earn various Summer Drinks, which you can use to gain powerful boosts!
DictionaryDiagram.40080202.2: Open your bag to view Summer Drinks details.
DictionaryDiagram.40080301.2:
Serve the correct ice cream to fill the progress bar, build combos, and activate Fever Mode. Your score will skyrocket during this time!
Be careful, though—running out of time or messing up an order will break your combo.
DictionaryDiagram.40080401.2:
The summer fun never ends! In Endless Challenge mode, running out of time will cost you HP.
Make smart use of your Summer Drinks, rack up massive combos, and aim for the highest score possible!
DictionaryDiagram.40090101.2:
In Through Hostile Depths, you will match your wits against a mysterious sage, leading the Trekkers under your command—along with powerful allies and former foes—as Chess Pieces to play out the match!
Use Talent Gold to recruit pieces, expand your team, reach the Final Battle, and claim victory!
DictionaryDiagram.40090102.2:
In a match of Through Hostile Depths, the board consists of a maximum 3 Offense slots and 6 Assist slots.
The 3 Offense slots each have unique buffs, and pieces placed here receive the corresponding bonuses.
Pieces deployed in Offense slots face enemies directly in battle, and cast Offense Skills when their Energy is full.
Pieces deployed in Assist slots do not enter the field, but cast Assist Skills when their Energy is full.
DictionaryDiagram.40090103.2: A match is divided into several phases, each composed of multiple nodes. Node types include Encounter, Opportunity, Lord, and Final Battle.
DictionaryDiagram.40090104.2:
Encounter: Combat node. Enemies grow stronger as the match progresses. Only Encounter battles count toward Win/Lose Streaks.
Opportunity: Grants an Opportunity choice with three Challenge difficulties. You may roll the Dice before choosing. If the result meets the requirement, you can claim the reward directly without taking the Challenge.
DictionaryDiagram.40090105.2:
Sanity (SAN) is the key to maintaining your focus during a match. If SAN reaches 0, the match ends immediately.
Losing a battle reduces SAN, while winning restores a small amount.
Remaining SAN at the end of the Final Battle affects your final score.
DictionaryDiagram.40090106.2:
Battles, including Auto Attacks, Offense Skills, and Assist Skills, are fully automatic.
Victory is achieved by defeating all enemies; defeat occurs if all your Offense pieces are defeated.
Each battle has a countdown; once the countdown ends, all healing will be disabled across the field, and both sides will unleash their full firepower to speed up the battle.
DictionaryDiagram.40090107.2:
Each piece has a recruitment cost in the Shop, ranging from 1 to 5.
Higher-cost pieces generally possess more powerful Skills or superior stats, but they also have a lower probability of appearing in the Shop.
DictionaryDiagram.40090108.2:
Having 3 identical pieces automatically combines them into the same piece with a higher star level.
As the star level increases, the piece's stats will greatly improve. Typically, 3★ is the strongest level.
DictionaryDiagram.40090109.2:
Pieces are classified as Offense, Assist, and Balanced.
Pieces can be deployed anywhere on the board, but the abilities or mechanics of Offense pieces only take effect when they're deployed in Offense slots. The same applies to Assist pieces.
Balanced pieces can use their full abilities in any slot.
DictionaryDiagram.40090110.2:
Each piece comes with one or more Trait affixes.
Deploy pieces with matching Traits to activate powerful synergy effects when conditions are met.
The higher the Trait level, the stronger the effect.
DictionaryDiagram.40090111.2: You can use the Track Traits function on specific Traits. In the Shop, pieces associated with tracked Traits will be marked to help you identify them and achieve synergy effects quickly.
DictionaryDiagram.40090112.2: At the beginning of a match, you can choose 1 of 3 Starting Plans. Opportunity nodes may grant additional Blessing choices. Choosing the right Plan or Blessings can provide major bonuses for the match.
DictionaryDiagram.40090113.2:
Talent Gold is the core currency used to recruit pieces, refresh the Shop, and raise the Shop Level.
Node Income = Base Gold + Interest + Win/Lose Streak Bonus + Gold from extra bonuses, special Pieces, or special Traits.
DictionaryDiagram.40090114.2: You can use Talent Gold to recruit desired pieces in the Shop. Spend 2 Gold to refresh the Shop. The Shop automatically refreshes once when entering a new node, unless you have set it to locked.
DictionaryDiagram.40090115.2:
Higher Shop levels increase the probability of recruiting high-cost pieces and expand your deployment limit.
Shop EXP is earned automatically per node or can be purchased with Talent Gold.
DictionaryDiagram.40090116.2:
During deployment, you can view Team Guides for lineup references.
You can use the Apply function on a specific lineup, and the Shop will display recommended pieces that match the lineup.
DictionaryDiagram.40090204.2:
Lord: The final battle of each Phase against a powerful enemy.
Final Battle: The final battle of the match against a powerful boss. Clear it to win.
DictionaryDiagram.90010101.2: Complete daily tasks to earn Tyrant Points for item rewards. Accumulate more Tyrant Points to unlock milestone rewards. Tyrant Points and milestone rewards will reset at 1:00 PM every day.
DictionaryDiagram.90010102.2: In addition to daily tasks, a set number of random special commissions will be available.
DictionaryDiagram.90010103.2: Complete weekly missions to earn Tyrant Points for item rewards. Accumulate more Tyrant Points in a week to unlock milestone rewards. Weekly Tyrant Points and milestone rewards will reset at 1:00 PM every Monday.
DictionaryDiagram.90020101.2: In each chapter, Tyrant Growth tasks are linked to the main objectives of the chapter. Completing them will grant you generous rewards.
DictionaryDiagram.90020102.2: After completing all the tasks in the current chapter, you can claim the chapter rewards and unlock the next chapter.
DictionaryDiagram.90030101.2: Completing Company Goals raises your Grant Tier, unlocking both basic and exclusive rewards. The Start-up Grant will reset its tier and unlocked items after each season. A new round of goals and rewards will then become available.
DictionaryDiagram.90030102.2: The Starter Grant is available by default. Upgrading to the Elite or Royal Grant unlocks bigger rewards, with the Royal Grant coming with exclusive avatars and Appearance.
DictionaryDiagram.90030103.2: Complete daily and weekly Company Goals to earn bonus EXP. You can gain up to 12,000 EXP per week. Once this cap is reached, or the Startup Grant hits max level, no further EXP can be earned from Goals.
DictionaryDiagram.90030104.2: Spend currency to buy Grant Tiers and claim rewards instantly. When Company Goals refresh, unclaimed rewards are auto-collected. At the end of the Startup Grant, remaining rewards are sent to your mailbox, valid for 7 days.

DiscIP.214031.3: The Clash of Blade and Axe
DiscIP.211001.4:
The world outside the window is just starting to lighten.
The girl stirs, only half-wake.
Half-asleep, she senses someone approaching.
"... Trouble...?"
Her hand moves instinctively toward her sword, but then she hears two familiar voices that put her at ease.
"Amazing recovery. She took a really hard hit yesterday... And almost heals overnight."
"... Still, that doesn't mean she should charge in every time."
"Let's go shopping. There are deals on meat and vegetables today. Noya can have a proper meal and recover then."
"You say that, but she'll still be the one doing the cooking, won't she?"
"Well... it's not like any of us can cook as well as she can."

"Click—"
Just before sleep takes her again, she hears the door close softly, the sound carefully muffled.

The morning light leaves patterns upon the mist in the forest.
DiscIP.211002.4:
A gentle breeze drifts by, and another patrol day begins in the countryside just like always.
"What? The Shrubshrews are causing trouble again?"
The birds chirp their complaints to the girl, then take off toward the forest.

"Wait—hold up! I don't have wings, you know!"
She heads out, wind in her face, trying to follow the birds' path.
The afternoon sun washes over the endless wheat fields, wrapping her small figure in warm, golden light.

"Grumble, grumble—"
That's when she remembers that she's already missed her lunch.
"Ugh, this time I'm really going to teach them a lesson!"

Across the fields and over the streams, the little guardian of the forest sets out once again, full of purpose and fire.
DiscIP.211003.4:
The city quiets as dusk settles in, the sky glowing with iridescent light.

"Click—"
A camera shutter snaps somewhere above.
With a flash, the scene is caught and frozen in the lens.
A witch on a broom slips through the clouds, watching for the secrets hidden below.

"Oh? Isn't that the one everyone's been talking about lately? Love that expression~"
"Let's get one from this angle, too~"
"Whoops, guess they saw me. Well, I've already got some interesting shots!"
As night falls, the clever eyes behind the camera sparkle like stars, brightening the darkness above the city.

She looks quite satisfied with her unexpected finds tonight.
"Yep, you're going right on tomorrow's front page..."
DiscIP.211004.4:
Bubbles drift through her dreams, waves as soft as silk brushing the shore,
and every cloud glows with a gentle light.
She picks up her brush, dips it in paint, and sketches the reflections in the water, stroke by stroke.
Each line shimmers and sways with the current, and with every moment, her dreams ripple along with the waves.

—No matter how harsh reality gets, this place is always warm and calm.
As the waves rise and the clouds roll, the shadows in her heart are washed away like colors fading into the water.

The road to freedom really isn't as simple as she imagined.
Now that I've left the safety of my tower, is this the world I've longed to see?


She shakes her head, stands up, and shakes the water from her hands. With new resolve, she heads straight ahead.
—A princess who's left her castle won't be defeated by something this trivial!
DiscIP.211005.4:
"Oh, it's gone."
Without even realizing it, the girl has chased all the way into the heart of the desert.

As the legend has it, the long-haired cat that roams the Wilds can lead Trekkers to a hidden Monolith.
If you lock eyes with one, a secret path will appear.

A gust of sand sweeps by, and the quick little furball is nowhere to be seen.
The girl pauses for a moment, then lightly leaps onto the wind-carved rock behind her.
Dust swirls in the air; the endless sea of sand quietly keeps its secrets.

"Following those faint paw prints the whole way... I'm used to navigating the desert, but something about this place feels different.
Time seems to stand still here. It's like echoes from long ago are drifting on the wind. A strange feeling is welling up inside me..."
A ray of sunlight spills down, and her fingers freeze mid-tap on the keys—
She suddenly looks up and locks onto a pair of sparkling eyes in the distance.
DiscIP.211006.4:
To let go of her heavy thoughts, she opens the door and walks out into the serenity.
On this mist-soaked morning, sunlight filters through the leaves, and shadows flicker at her feet as she moves.

"Sorry I'm late."
The forest's residents are already waiting for her by the stream.
She runs over to join her friends. With each step, the anxious voice inside her becomes quieter.

"Let's take care of each other today, too."
She steps into the cool water, splashing as she likes, joy bubbling up inside her.
Playful creatures, swirling skirts—everyone is bathed in morning light, welcomed by nature.

No matter how chaotic things get in the outside world, this will always be her place to find herself.
DiscIP.211007.4:
"Why are you coming at this hour? We're about to close."
"And you want a temporary residence permit. We only handles long-term permits here."
A weary voice came from behind the glass.
After a brief pause, the employee pushed a booklet through the slot below.
"Here, take this and read it carefully when you get back."
"Seriously... Trekkers are such a bunch of country bumpkins."

Thinking back on yesterday's ordeal, the girl feels a bit annoyed, but there's nothing she can do about it.
Looking down at the city from the rooftop, the view below is as beautiful as ever.
She already knows the city's harsh reality.

Gazing at the city where she's about to make her mark, she finally feels a surge of courage.
"Just wait. One day... I'll amaze everyone in this city."
For once, she lets go of her frustrations and lifts her head high—
letting her hair and cloak dance freely in the breeze.
DiscIP.211008.4:
"Three letters from Emor, five packages from Philae... and twenty-five newspapers!"
She picks up her pen and checks off each item on her list one by one.
"All done. Everything's been delivered and all the fees are settled for today!"

As the sun slowly sinks below the horizon, she wipes the sweat from her brow and gazes off into the distance. 
A dreamy, small smile flickers across her face.

Look closely, and you'll see the answer in those bright eyes—
It's the joy of taking in this view after crossing so many mountain trails,
the pride of a courier who's worked hard all day,
and the boundless hope she has for the future after weathering so many storms.

"Nah, none of that."
"I was just thinking about how I should treat myself after all this running around. I'm exhausted!"
DiscIP.212001.4:
Snuffle—snuffle—
The feast is about to begin—

At the very front walks the brave one, their pointy hat shaped just like an ice cream cone—I bet it'd be perfectly crisp and crunchy.
The crawling magician isn't holding a wand but a lollipop you could crunch in one bite.
And you, long-haired weirdo hiding at the back of the line—I see you!
What's in all those bottles and jars in your pockets? I want to drink every single one!

Snuffle—snuffle—
They're climbing up onto the table—

Snuffle—snuffle—
They've spotted us—

One, two, three! Nobody's taking my bowl!
One, two, three! Don't break my plate!
Ready—ready—
Time to dig in—
DiscIP.212002.4:
"Hoho! Who's on duty today?!"
"I set three big fires yesterday, so I know it's not me!"
"Not... Glopo... Glopo... Gonna take a bath..."
"Snuffle—snuffle—"
"Hoho! Hey, lazy penguin, quit napping! It's gotta be you!"
"Those long-armed, long-legged ones are about to climb up! Get moving!"
"Snuffle—I swapped position with Cursipot—"
"Cursipot' on gate duty, I'm up top—"
"Hoho! Cursipot! Where's Cursipot?"
"That guy's useless, I'll do it myself! I'll burn it all, nice and clean!"
"Snuf—snuffle—fire, fire!!"
"Glopo... can't take... a hot bath..."
"Glopo... gonna melt..."
"Look! This is my blazing firestorm!"
"Hoho! Just go already! Don't get in the way!"
"Snuffle—put out the fire—put out the fire—"
DiscIP.212003.4:
What wonderful music that is.
What an enchanting rhythm.
Once you set foot in my domain, you must dance with me before you can leave.

Come, lose yourself in this grand, eternal, dazzling ball.
Come, surrender your poor, fragile, frozen body.
My drumbeat is your heartbeat.
My applause is your scream.
Why is your face so pale?
Why does sweat pour down your skin?

Come, come, dance with me.
Come, come, let me grant you sleep.
What an irresistible beat.
What a obsessive melody.
Once you set foot in my domain, you must dance with me—never stopping, never coming out from this frenzy.
DiscIP.212005.4:
Get fired up, get ready to move!
The hottest music is born from the fiercest flames!
Can't hear you! Louder!
Show me your passion, your anger, the ambition you're hiding behind those jokes!

That's it, just like that!
Give me your hand. Don't worry, you won't get burned.
As long as you play nice, I'll even let you touch my sharp claws—ever so lightly.
What's that? You think I'm "cute?!"
Hah, that's just because you haven't seen what I look like with my mask off~

Get fired up, get ready to move!
I still can't hear you—louder, let me hear it—!
DiscIP.212006.4:
I hear your summons.
I heed your prayers.
Those who once leaped over the heavenly gate have faded like smoke and cloud.
Those who defiled the throne still cling to the heights above.

You dare to meet my gaze,
You dare to pierce my armored scales.
Who gave you such courage?
Who lent you such strength?

Pitiful are you who have fools as honored guests.
And pitiful are you, the blind masses, who brand heroes as traitors.
Truth is hard to hear, and medicine bitter to taste.
The fate of the world—let it unfold, and watch in silence.
DiscIP.212007.4:
"Chirp chirp, chirp chirp."
"Did you hear? There's going to be a huge party in the forest, chirp chirp!"
"Awo! You almost pecked down my front door, first thing in the morning, just for this?"
"We already knew, awo! We even got invitations, awo!"
"Invitations? How come I didn't get one, chirp chirp?"

"Could it be... I somehow made the Forest Spirit mad without realizing it?"
"Awo?! No way, right? Didn't those Shrubrat leave an apple with the Spirit's name on it at your door?"
"Those Shrubrat must've slacked off again. I'll go tell on them to the Spirit, awo!"
"Apple... I think... I ate it."
"I thought it just fell out of the tree, chirp chirp."
"Dummy! Dummy!"
"You'd better bring extra snacks and bribe those hedgehogs at the door, awo!"
DiscIP.212008.4:
Bubbles, bubbles, swelling bubbles.
Splashes, splashes, endless splashes.

The most delightful time of the day again!
Set the temperature, grab a towel, and don't forget the rubber duck.
Turn on the music, rip open the snacks, twist the faucet wide.
Glug glug, fatigue melts away.
Drip drip, pressure goes poof.

Hot water is magic, strong enough to wash away every care.
The bath cures any and all worry.

In this rare moment of rest,
Glopo can finally put down the weight and title of the Glopo clan.
Even if a fearsome enemy drops from the sky,
they'll have to wait until Glopo finishes this bath.
DiscIP.212009.4:
At the dawn of life, where all desire begins...
I heed the ancient call and command the dice of fate.
Into the depths of the sea, I cast a silver coin.
At the edge of the heavens, I hang a single star.

I am the watcher beyond order, reside within the liminality of time,
listening to the greedy prayers of my faithful.
I sow seeds of fear, devour the power of belief, and abandon even the most devoted.
No one escapes my shifting labyrinth.
The endless repetition wearies me. A game with only one ending brings no joy.

Thus I take up the pen and rewrite the script of fate,
letting dreadful secrets spread through the world:
"Those who step through this door shall never return."
"Those who break this realm shall become unstoppable."
DiscIP.212010.4:
Is it finally my turn to take the stage?
It feels like I've waited forever for this moment; yet somehow, like it only just happened.
The curtain's risen on the final battle, and the chains of the arena clink in anticipation.
This is my stage, and I'll deliver a flawless performance.

Come on, show me everything you've got.
If you think I'm just some minor character, you couldn't be deadly wrong.
I'll catch every tiny crack in your defense.
Even if I'm knocked down, I'll get right back up,
waiting for the next challenger.
Even if I'm mocked, I won't care.
I'm no pitiful thing crying my defeat in the corner.
Who says the spotlight belongs only to the final room?
With me standing guard, this place becomes everyone's end.
DiscIP.213001.4:
The dryer hums steadily.
The girl seems entertained; she bobs her head in sync with the spinning drum.
She's completely caught up in it and flashes a peace sign at her companion's reflection in the glass.
Her fingertips finds another set of fingers, just as warm and soft.
Her companion stands close and mirrors her gesture. But today isn't quite like the others:
A wide shadow falls over her; a soft white cloth drops down, covering her eyes.
"Ruby, no-prize quiz—what do you smell?" Asks a bright, teasing voice.

Hmm? The familiar scent of sunlight, of course.
Wait... A faint trace of fruit drifts past her nose...

Ruby quickly pulls the surprise off her face and locks eyes with her companion.
"Grapefruit? Don't tell me, Sapphire—we actually had enough extra money to get new detergent?"
"Sharp nose, as always."
Sapphire folds the laundry carefully, almost like she's afraid the scent might escape.
"I used my quarterly bonus to get this grapefruit-scented kind. A friend in Sales told me it's a Gold District exclusive."
"I didn't want to use it up too fast, so I mixed just a little into our regular bottle. The scent's fainter now, but if you really sniff..."

They exchange a knowing look. That soft, lingering citrus is just like Lady Firenze's.

"Hehe, I love the smell of grapefruit! Let's work hard next month and stock up on a few more bottles!"
"Yeah!"
DiscIP.213002.4:
The dream called "idol" rings out, bright and chiming.
In this season of change, the girls charge forward with fearless energy.

They're the girl group that sold ten million albums in just a year, and every reporter in the country is desperate to figure out their secret.
For example, how did that reclusive genius composer, who never left her room, end up singing and dancing on stage for a tiny agency?
And that ordinary-looking girl with the long hair—how did she become that good at guitar in just three years? Even for a prodigy, that's a bit much.
Then there's the bombshell fan favorite—rumor has it someone caught her in a school uniform sneaking into campus. Seriously?!
As for the lack of buzz vocalist,
who would've thought it was her who brought the girls all together?

"I don't want to be apart from everyone anymore."

Spring rain softens the world, and a girl's tears call forth a miracle.
Summer casts its shade, flowers proudly bloom in the dark of night.
Autumn leaves blaze red, as the wind from afar waits quietly for the mountains' blessing.
Winter butterflies dance, and an out-of-season duckling coats the world in white.

They've had their highs and lows.
Every note has its own color, but their friendship never wavers.
Seasons may turn, but spring, summer, autumn, and winter remain the same.
DiscIP.213003.4:
"This is it! Our final performance."
"You mean our first."
"But... But if it doesn't go well, we'll have no reason to ever come back."
I curl up in the corner, clutching my guitar as the words stumble out of my mouth.
"If you're not feeling well, it's okay to rest—I can take care of things out there on my own."
"... No. I want to go on. Please, let me be a part of it."
I lift my head sharply, frustration burning in my chest.
But the moment I see her fearless expression, I shrink back again, burying my face even deeper.
"Just give me a little more time... If I try harder, maybe..."

"What you need right now is this!"
She suddenly pulls back the edge of the heavy curtain. Joyful, colorful light floods into our eyes.

And then I remember. That rainy night, walking home under my umbrella.
The street was dark and silent,
which only made the grind of my boring life feel even heavier.

In that moment, a guitar riff cut through the night like lightning.
It was sharp, electric, and intoxicating—
breaking through the rain, shattering the stillness—
That kind of color.

That's it. I'm going to chase after and reach for that color again.

"Let's go! It's our turn!" You grab my hand and pull me toward the light.
Scream, shake, burn!
Turn the longing in your heart into action.
This scorching night won't end!
DiscIP.213004.4:
Night falls, sirens wail.
The infamous Phantom Thief "Twin Moon," is on the move again.
"As the leader of the Special Task Force for the Twin Moon Case... Even if I'm the last one standing, I'll bring them in."
The helmet on her desk catches the glint of city lights bouncing off the skyscrapers.
She gears up and starts the engine—clearly not in the mood.

"Sis, I think there's some weirdo in armor on a motorcycle chasing us!"
"How could a tin can keep up with us? No way—watch this, I'll shout her off our tail."
"I don't think that's a good idea..."
"Hey, loser on the busted bike! You think you can catch us? Dream on! Enjoy the view from behind while you choke on our exhaust!"
"Skateboards don't really have exhaust, sis... Wait! She took off her helmet! I think she's aiming at us!"
"Huh? What is this, a Cliché in Stella drama? No way—"
A loud crash, the clatter of metal—and the two thieves go tumbling.
"Two birds, one stone. Twin Moon is in custody."

"... Since you caught us, I guess we'll reward you by answering three questions."
"Hmph. We are—"
"Save it!"
DiscIP.213005.4:
Good evening, viewers. Up next, today's top story:
"Undercover Scoop! Flavio Idol Backstage Exposé!"
A special report brought to you by our field correspondent, Mistique...

"Hellllo? Anyone here?! My stage outfit only has the top half! Where's the skirt?!"
"Makeup! Who's in charge of makeup? Did you all do your hair yourselves?"
"Ugh, it's so stuffy... and hot... This place is way too tiny!"
The self-proclaimed professional reporter finds herself in a bind. In the cramped and sweltering backstage, her questions evaporate like steam, gone unanswered without a trace.
Everyone around her rushes past—if you take away their puffy skirts and flawless makeup, they'd look no different from the exhausted office workers she sees everywhere else.
"I knew it. Humans are such pitiful creatures. A bunch of burnt-out people put on fake smiles, just to please another bunch who are just as burnt out as they are."
The witch, with her sharp nose for news, suddenly gets an idea. A flurry of clickbait headlines flashes through her mind. This month's "Truth Award" is already as good as hers.

One second before the performance begins, she finally manages, through sheer willpower, to throw together a passable look for the cameras along with a color-matched costume.
The music starts. The curtain rises. The spotlight falls on her.
Cheers and applause echo all around, blurring her thoughts. Suddenly she understands why so many fight so hard to stay on this tiny stage.
"Humans may be pitiful creatures, but... When people carry their burdens together, the warmth and strength they find in each other is absolutely real."
DiscIP.213006.4:
"If you could make anything appear right now by magic, what would you want?"
"A giant treasure chest! No, wait, a map that shows where every treasure in the world is!"
"Some kind of winged vehicle, so delivering letters would be way easier... Maybe I'd call it an "autobird?"
"Hey! Can you guys be a little more realistic?"
Donna doesn't know whether she should laugh or cry. She drops her mallet, stretches her legs, and flops down on the ground.
The afternoon sun spills over her orange hair, making it look like a restless flame, flickering and growing with impatience. Her two teammates rarely follow instructions during their "renovation project"; they always end up doing their own thing, and that little out of scene conversation was just more proof.
Things aren't going well. The tall, blue-haired girl steps forward, shielding Donna from the blazing sun and hoping the tiny bit of shade will help keep their frazzled boss from totally losing it.
The other one curls up like a cat, crouching next to Donna and gently shaking her knee:
"Donna, I-I was just joking. Don't be mad... Ah!"
Teresa barely finishes her apology before Donna ruffles her hair even more, making her head look even more like a bird's nest.
"What, did I scare you two? Hmph, I'm not mad."
Both girls breathe a sigh of relief. The blue-haired one picks up the mallet from the ground, glancing at the mess they've made behind them:
"You two take a break. I'll finish the stairs for these two levels."
"Freesia, did you learn some kind of stamina spell? How come you never get tired?"
"I think that kind of magic does exist, but I don't know it. I'm just used to physical work."
"Waaah... Poor Freesia."
"Freesia, what kind of hard life did you have before this?"
The two girls on the ground hug Freesia's legs from both sides. She has to free her hands and, imitating Donna, gently pats them both on the head.
In that moment, she feels like she's learned a stamina spell after all.
It's just fixing up a train! She can totally do it!

"... By the way, what about you, Donna? What's your answer to that question?"
"Me? I was just thinking, if would be so nice if we had a huge bed, soft as marshmallow, so we could all get a good, comfy nap..."
DiscIP.213007.4:
In the beginning, we were one and the same.
Like paired feathers and entwined branches, we breathed the same air and listened to the same heartbeat.
Then we grew flesh, grew souls, grew horns.
I once thought life would never change, that fate was already decided.
We lived in darkness, in pain, in endless despair.
But you said we shouldn't accept that. You said we should climb upward, break through the barriers, and seek another world.
I didn't know what that other world was like; I was afraid of change, afraid of being torn apart, afraid of seeing you become someone I couldn't recognize.
But I remained your most loyal guardian, your truest companion, always following in your footsteps.

You told me there's a bridge at the edge of the world, spanning the abyss.
It snows all year at the bridge, bitterly cold. But if we cross it, we'll reach the far beyond.
Everything there should belong to us, and the people there would serve our kind.
—Because we were one, once.

The night before we set out, I trailed closely behind you, snowflakes falling into my eyes.
My steps grew lighter, my body nearly floating, and just before I left the ground, I grabbed your wrist.
The snow turned to clouds, wrapping softly around us both. The first wind of the new world brushed our hair; the birds sang together.
"Don't be afraid. We're almost there."
Suddenly, I realized it was only my illusion, a dream I couldn't put into words.
So I returned to reality, stood knee-deep in snow, with only your fade to black silhouette left ahead of me.
I summoned my courage to ask what exodus meant. You stopped, gazing at me from afar:
"If not for waking in the long night, the future could be ever bright."
DiscIP.213008.4:
"Wah—it's so cool in here—"
"Noya, close the window! I haven't finished stapling my ' Commission Handbook' yet, and it's gonna get blown away!"
"The wind is so strong..."
Travel is always full of surprises, and right now, the camper is brimming with both chaos and freedom.
"Okay, okay, I'm closing it!"
Under heavy fire, Noya hugs the steering wheel with one hand while hurriedly rolling up the window with the other, secretly leaving a little crack—she just has to.
"Iris, did you hit Noya on the head with our rice ladle just now?"
"Uh—I, I just grabbed whatever was nearby!"
"Now we're doomed. The god of food will punish us!"
"Our emergency rations will disappear, we won't find anything to eat out in the Wilds, and in the end we'll all starve to death in the camper..."
The terrified girl mumbles on, her imagination painting a grim future. Her voice drops lower and lower, picking up speed until the words blur into an unintelligible chant.
"Noya, pull over." 
"Iris has crashed again."
Amber, now a seasoned pro, steadies Iris by the shoulders in case she collapses. Noya opens the door, and together they help Iris out of the RV.
A cool breeze sweeps by and Iris sneezes hard.
"... I'm okay now."

When she comes back to herself, Iris slumps on the grass, rubbing her eyes. Not far away, Noya seems to be tinkering with something, but Iris can't focus on that. She's too busy reflecting on her meltdown.
It must be because she hasn't been sleeping well lately.
It must be because they haven't gotten any new commissions for two weeks.
It must be because...
Someone presses something warm into her palm. She looks down to find a steaming clay pot.
"Fresh soup! Drink up. You'll feel better after."
Their smiling chef winks at her. Amber peeks around Noya's shoulder, dangling a shiny piece of Tawny Nightingale in front of her:
"Iris, eat this bread. It's good."

Yeah, maybe things aren't so bad after all.
At least for now, she can finally take a real break.
DiscIP.213009.4:
Drip, drip—the sound of rain.
Light footsteps skip over puddles.
Raindrops burst at her toes.

Drip, drip—the melody of rain.
Hand in hand, they run through the rain.
Bubbles swirl in the air.

The rain sounds like music.
Every drop keeps its own secret.
Fluttering skirts look like flowers swaying in the wind.

The rain slowly fades away,
and bright sunlight returns to the sky.
A rainbow appears, rising and falling like their moods.

"The rain stopped right when we got home. I can't tell if that's good or bad."
"I think it's good."
"Eh?"
"Even while running in the rain, you were still smiling so much."
"... Go take a shower! You're soaked. If you don't take a hot shower, you'll catch a cold tomorrow."
DiscIP.213010.4:
I'm not sure when it happened, but I've turned into such a cautious person.
I worry that what I say won't come out right, that people will misunderstand me.
I worry that my solutions won't make anyone happy.
I worry... This outfit I'm wearing is too attention-grabbing.
"Is this dress... A bit too bright?"
She brought me this "Feather Robe" from the city, and it's supposed to be traditional Loong festival attire.
I choose my words carefully, not wanting her to think I don't like it and hurt her feelings.
"I think it looks great on you. Besides, you're on vacation. It's the perfect time to try something new."
"... Okay."
But even with her encouragement, I still feel awkward because I'm used to my usual work clothes.

The whole way there, my steps are awkward and stiff, praying I don't bump into anyone I know.
We pass a bun shop. We aren't even hungry, but the chef's skill is mesmerizing.
With his left hand, he wraps the thin dough around the filling, spinning it effortlessly,
while his right pinches the top closed with even, perfect folds.
I count them quietly: exactly eighteen.
In no time, the whole tray goes into the steamer. She glances at me.
"There's an ancient saying that 'Doing great things is like cooking a small dish.' You can apply the cooking lessons to life. Do you know what's the most important thing?"
I try to ignore how young she looks saying that and focus on the steaming buns.
"...Is it the timing?"
"Nope! It's being happy!"
"Huh?"
"Sure, timing matters, but if the chef isn't happy, how are the customers supposed to feel happy? Right, chef?"
The chef bursts out laughing.

"The most important thing in life is being happy..."
I repeat her words to myself as I spot a shop I haven't visited in ages.
"Hang on, wait for me."
Might as well do something that makes me happy.

"One bubble tea, full sugar, less ice. Thanks."
The steam from the buns fogs up the neon-lit street
while the humid air beads cold drops on my cup.
For now, I let myself put all my worries aside
and start enjoying this minute that's all mine.
DiscIP.213011.4:
The girl lingers in front of the token exchange machine.
"This machine only accepts exchanges for 5,000 or 10,000 tokens"—the bright red message scrolls across the screen over and over.
She glares at those two numbers, gripping the only 1,000-token voucher she has.
Oh well, guess she'll have to pick up a couple more shifts at the convenience store and save up before coming back.
Who knows if that stingy boss of hers will find some new excuse to dock her pay...
She pulls her cap low, slipping away like a general dishonorably retreating from the battlefield without a fight.
Suddenly a hand lands on her shoulder from behind, soft and steady, as if reaching out to the part of her that refuses to give up.

"Cat-ear hat, pigtails... you're Chaton, right? The number two on the arcade rankings?"
It's a voice that she doesn't recognize. It's full of confidence and totally out of place in this noisy arcade.
Maybe she's here to challenge her? Fine. Let's see if she can bluff her way into a free match.
The girl tries her best to look tough, answering in a voice even louder than the stranger's.
"That's me. If you want a match, you're paying."
"Sure. Five rounds, to start."
Seriously?
Surprised, the girl looks up and meets the challenger's gaze. She finds a pair of perfectly calm crimson eyes.
This one's long hair is tied back, and unlike the usual challengers covered in over-the-top studs and spikes, she's just wearing a plain jacket.

"As a rank holder, I will only play against you if you state your name!"
"I'm Kasimira."
Kasimira...
Of course Chaton knows that name. She's seen it above her own on the leaderboard more times than she can count.
Kasimira, the number one.
All her bravado deflates like a pricked balloon.
"Give me a break. The ranked number one came all the way here to stomp on us losers?"
Kasimira doesn't answer. She fishes in her pocket and presses the exchange button.
"I've watched your replays. Your tactics are interesting."
Five tokens appear in Chaton's palm, the crown side facing up like an invitation.
"Want to play a round?"
"Of course."
DiscIP.213012.4:
The bike's dim headlight glides through Ash District, restless and alert,
scanning the streets like a judge at a talent show, eager to spot tonight's next act.

A sudden reflection blinds the rider for a second and she almost loses her balance.
Once the daze passes, she sees them: three girls in school uniform,
innocent-looking but blending into the night as if they belong there.

"Platinum Academy, huh? It's already past curfew. What are you doing under the Waterway this late?"
"Hmph, isn't it obvious? We were just—wait, ah!"
"Time to go home, sis~ Sorry, officer. Our study hall ran late and we have just finished up."

The rider moves to pull out her notepad behind her back,
a small gesture that instantly puts the girls on edge.
"Wow, you all look nervous. Don't tell me your school still does corporal punishment?"
The rider shuts her notebook with a snap, climbs back on her bike, and lets the engine rumble.
"Be smart and don't wander at night. I'll let you off this time."

"Hey—"
The girl's voice, young but clear and loud, makes everyone freeze on the spot.
The rider's hand hovers over the siren switch as she checks her rearview mirror.
"Wear goggles when you ride at night—"
The leader crosses her arms, meaning well, but it just gets under the rider's skin.

"... Tch. Mind your own business."
She revs the throttle and heads off toward Silver District without looking back.

"Whew... She's finally gone. You were so cool! Not scared of her at all!"
"Keep it down, sis. We almost got caught."
"I did laundry, but who knew the fake uniforms would come in handy?"

The girls turn and pull down the cloth cover hanging on the wall—
revealing their latest creation, finished just tonight, a splash of color that belongs only to them under these stars.
DiscIP.213013.4:
The story began in the forest on a moonless night.
Someone who smelled just like her left both me and her behind in this unfamiliar place, and she was just a baby.
The forest's colors changed, pale to deep, over and over again.
And as the seasons turned, she came to look and smell more and more like that woman.

"What are you smelling, Coco?"

I wander over to a little nest made of maple leaves, pretending not to care.
She follows and flops down next to me, gently running her hand through my fur.
Just like that night. Just like back then.

"Is it the maple leaves? Let me try!"
"Yeah! Smells just like the fall season."

The colors of the forest shift once more.
DiscIP.213014.4:
Kaydoke is in her workshop, performing routine maintenance on her tools.
A tender smile spreads across her face as she polishes her "treasures."
The peace is shattered by the arrival of a blonde girl.

"Hey there! Sorry to barge in!"
"... Yo, Tilia. What brings you by?"
"Lapis Eagle's been acting up again. I was hoping you could ... take a look?" she asks, scratching her head sheepishly.
"Again? Let me guess... You pushed it too hard chasing those Ashwind punks, didn't you?"
"Rushing over the rough terrain of the Ash District for way too long?"
"Whoa, spot on! You have your own intel network or something?"
"Hardly. This is the fourth time this week."
"Heh heh..."
"You're hopeless. Bring 'er in."

Kaydoke gets to work, focusing on the Lapis Eagle before her.
After a moment, the blonde girl pipes up.

"So, um..."
"Hm?"
"Since you're taking it apart anyway, could you maybe also..."
"No."
"Huh? I haven't even said anything yet."
"I know exactly what you want. Some kind of glowing, transforming armor, right? Or maybe bolt-on weapons or an extra engine?"
"So that's a no?"
"Of course not. This is a patrol scooter! Look, what happens if you make a little kid wear a full suit of Imperial Guard armor?"
"They'd ... become a little knight?"
"... They'd get crushed by the weight of it, right?"
"Oh! Right! I guess they would."
"It's the same for your scooter."
"Adding all those flashy mods won't improve its performance. It'll just weigh it down."
"I see... Have the other knights really never asked for stuff like that?"
"You think everyone's like you?!"

With the Lapis Eagle fixed, Kaydoke walks Tilia out.

"Thanks, Kay! Oh, this is for you."
"Is this ... taiyaki?"
"Yep! From that new dessert shop.
Their taiyaki is amazing, and I wanted you to try some."
"Oh, thanks. You didn't have to.
Anyway, try to take better care of your Lapis Eagle. If you wreck it again this week, I'm not fixing it."
"Three days! Can we make it three days? I swear I'll make it last longer this time, please, Kay?"
(Sighs)

The boisterous blonde finally leaves.
The paper bag holding the taiyaki rustles in Kaydoke's hand.
"It's already gone cold from the ride over!"
DiscIP.213015.4:
Deep down, Nazuna knows she is filled with regret.
Even someone as lazy and unmotivated as her, who only ever wanted to coast through life...
... has something she desperately wants to protect.

A single missed chance can last a lifetime.
Longing can never bring back what's gone.
Like the falling rain, the wandering birds, the friends who drift away,
and a familiar scent. Everything fades...

After Nazuka decided to leave, Nazuna stepped in to keep her room tidy.
She volunteered for the chore, taking on the persistent work.
For a long time after, Nazuna just couldn't get used to the emptiness.
Every laugh with Kaede, every trip into a Monolith, every meal at home ... it always felt like someone was missing.
Had her friend found new people to rely on? Someone new to treasure?
Nazuna wasn't sure which answer she feared more. "Yes" meant she was alone. "No" meant her friend was.

Whenever Nazuna went to the affairs office or the camp, she would quietly check on the Wandering Birds.
Her friend's guild grew more and more successful. And while Nazuna was genuinely happy for her, each success was a painful reminder of the distance growing between them.
As Nazuka took more jobs out of city, Nazuna lost the heart to join the crowds, choosing instead to hole up at home.

If I just get one more chance, I won't miss it again.
But she is a coward. The truth is a secret she only dared whisper to herself, swallowed by her blankets.

"Where are you?"
"What are you doing...?"
"There's ... not a single trace of your scent left in this room."
DiscIP.213016.4:
"Magnificent! Miss Befana, hold that pose and look right this way!"
—Do you see it? The audience's hungry stare.

"I'll never forget tonight's performance! I'm definitely coming back tomorrow!"
—Do you hear it? The same old cheers.

Fleeting lights flickered.
Heartfelt cries echoed.
She accepted their searing, sincere gazes,
pitying the devotees who had traveled so far to see her.

So what if their love was false?
So what if her bloom was fleeting?
Come, offer yourself as nourishment to the one and only blossom.
In this paradise that welcomes all, there is only intoxication.

She looked up as the rose that never sleeps swayed and shed its petals—an offering, or a sign of decay?
The roar of the crowd faded. Through the curtain, she felt the final warmth seep away.
Only her beating heart reminded her she had not yet become a perfect marionette.

Back then, had she been trapped in the same dream as everyone else—one she never wanted to wake from?
DiscIP.213017.4:
"Two-minute break. Let's take it from the top."
"If you can't keep up, practice on your own time. Don't drag the whole group down."
All eyes in the room fell on Ophir. She looked down, pretending she hadn't heard as she tightened her shoelaces.
It's to be expected, Ophir told herself. A beginner practicing with idol trainees is bound to get called out.

When the Scarlet Sights Media announced an idol competition, Ophir signed up. She never expected that on top of hosting, she'd also have to compete as an idol for a debut spot.
"Viewers are sick of the same old idol competitions. A fresh format is the only way to boost ratings."
"Idol versus idol, idol versus host, host versus host... The competition, the clashes... Just thinking about it gets my heart racing."
She recalled the hunger she saw in the station director's eyes as he spoke—like a shark scenting blood. If she were just starting out, a chill would have run down her spine, and she might have even quit.
But after years in the industry, she is used to its rules: capture the audience's attention, make them smile. That is her job.
No use overthinking it. Skip dinner, find an empty studio, and practice. The years of grinding has taught her to bounce back fast. She glances at the mirror, where the faces around her blur into one.
But the raw pride in their eyes as they stare at their own reflections—that is unmistakable.

She suddenly remembers a question Mistique had asked when they were first paired up.
"Ophir, what's your dream?"
Back then, she had just learned not to wear her heart on her sleeve. She summoned her courage and countered:
"Tell me yours first, and then I'll tell you mine."
A flicker of surprise crossed Mistique's eyes before she wagged a finger, a sly smile on her face.
"Dreams are for ordinary people. A witch like me can achieve anything she desires."
True, I am ordinary, Ophir thinks. But I refuse to stay that way.
It is that refusal—that fire—that keeps her going.
She is going to become the greatest host in Flavio. No matter how long it takes.
DiscIP.213018.4:
Her favorite soda is sold only on certain holidays.
Today is the day Cosette has been waiting for—her special soda run.

The store is overflowing with every kind of drink imaginable.
New yogurt flavors are in. Strawberry sounds too sweet, and multigrain ... would that be chewy? As for original, she hasn't touched it in ages.
Cosette wavers in front of the cooler before grabbing one of each flavor.
The juice selection offers nothing new. She is tired of the usual options, but then she remembers a trick she'd seen at a café: adding sparkling water to juice.
Maybe I'll give that a try?
She places two bottles of juice and sparkling water into her basket.
The basket begins to feel heavy.

A new product lines the left shelf. The sign proclaims it is a rare find from a Monolith—a powder that dissolves in water to become a delicious drink!
Should I try it?
She's never tried anything like it. She picks up a box labeled "Instant Coffee" and places it in her basket. It's so expensive—three times the normal price!
I'd cry if it tastes bad...

At last, she reaches the soda cooler, home to what she's been looking forward to all holiday: melon soda!
Made with melons from the south, an exclusive summer fruit, its sweet fragrance danced on the bubbles. One sip is all it takes to taste the essence of summer.
Three bottles? That won't be nearly enough. Half a dozen? Six, one a day, will last until next weekend...
But will they still have this flavor next weekend? If she buys too many, they may expire before she could drink them all...

Cosette dithers in front of the cooler before finally adding five bottles to her basket. It's already so heavy; any more and she won't be able to carry it.
She doesn't know if melon soda will be back next holiday, but even if it isn't, there will always be other flavors.
Cosette knows that come next holiday, a new soda will be waiting for her.
DiscIP.213019.4:
Some patients would lie to their physician habitually.
"I've followed your orders, Doctor. Haven't touched a drop in two months."
