Item.1.3: Issued by Deepsea Finance, this currency circulates throughout Nova Continent ... but only within cities.If you're alone in the Wilds, all the Dorra you carry might as well be scrap paper.
Item.2.3: This shard vibrates with the power of Stellnanite Veins, exhibiting purity yet bearing the hallmarks of human craftsmanship.Though not as pristine as natural crystals, it holds immense value.
Item.3.3: A condensed mass imbued with the power of Stellnanite Vein, both hard and clear.For centuries, it has been revered as the material for crafting Soul Stones, carrying immense value.
Item.4.3: A condensed mass imbued with the power of Stellnanite Vein, both hard and clear.For centuries, it has been revered as the material for crafting Soul Stones, carrying immense value.
Item.11.3: A coin that gleams with starlight, exclusive to the Monolith.Spend it while you can; you can't bring it out anyway.
Item.12.3: Obtained at the end of the exploration journey, this commemorative ticket stub symbolizes the honor of scaling the heights.Yet, for many Trekkers, a clear head and safe return are far more cherished than any accolades.
Item.20.3: Taking on commissions and completing quests becomes doubly hard without enthusiasm.Don't forget to pep up your Trekkers before embarking on your journey!
Item.21.3: The Throne system requires a certain amount of EXP. Increase your Authorization Level to unlock more features.
Item.22.3: As you explore the Monolith and beyond, the Startup Grant will amplify your progress, making every step count double.
Item.23.3: A testament to every distant voyage,where each stack's thickness whispers tales of delightful encounters.
Item.24.3: A testament to extraordinary journeys,where each miracle represents relentless pursuit.
Item.25.3: Bestowed by the Trekker Association, it's a testament to your prowess in Trekker Duel.Rumor has it that it can unlock hidden options in the Shop.
Item.28.3: A hunting bounty posted by the Trekker Association.Be sure to gauge your strength before taking on the hunt.
Item.29.3: Once you have obtained the "Key to the Monolith Stairs," you can use the pass to go straight to the top and snag the ultimate "Record"... Yeah, like luck ever works that way.You still have to face every single twist and turn. This just saves you a bit of the boring slog.
Item.30.3: Once you have obtained the "Key to the Monolith Stairs," you can use the pass to go straight to the top and snag the ultimate "Record"... Yeah, like luck ever works that way.You still have to face every single twist and turn. This just saves you a bit of the boring slog.
Item.31.3: A medal awarded to Trekkers who actively fight in the defense front.With enough badges, you can exchange them at the Association for generous rewards.—Perhaps this is the kind of currency that truly holds weight in a Trekker's circles.
Item.34.3: A magic crystal bearing a low, lamenting hymn, overflowing with resentment and unease.
Item.35.3: A magic crystal containing an intense, soaring melody, bearing joy and celebration.
Item.37.3: A Guild medal of appreciation for pioneer Trekkers—those who always answer the hunt or lead the first wave of investigation.
Item.38.3: Submit target intelligence to officially initiate an Operation: Shadow Siege.
Item.39.3: Allows participation in ongoing siege operations initiated by other Guilds.
Item.40.3: An exquisitely carved gold coin said to be a token that allows one to seek assistance from the Tyrant.
Item.51.3: Normally, the Monolith always appears pristine when you step in. So these cracks and flakes seem oddly out of place. Yet even these seemingly worthless bits of debris have become prized "research material" among scholars. And with that came fees and commissions.
Item.103.3: Listen closely, and you might just catch the faint sound of a meowing cat.
Item.107.3: Pure and flawless, that's the heartfelt yearning of the "Guardian of Justice."
Item.108.3: The flames are still blazing, scorchingly hot.
Item.110.3: Perched atop the world's gaze, she surveys all beneath her, like a monarch overlooking her realm.In her tender grasp, her fingers trace the familiar, worn contours of an old chair.
Item.111.3: It's a serene dreamscape, a blissful day when all work is finished.
Item.112.3: It feels like standing atop a mountain peak, yet also adrift in the vastness of the ocean.A cooling breeze caresses my face, and before me lies an unending expanse of horizon.
Item.113.3: Beneath the cicada-filled tree in the afternoon academy, she finally relaxes in her dreams, shedding all her tensions.
Item.114.3: The legendary story of the dark power will continue to write itself.But she no longer hesitates, nor does she stop.
Item.115.3: Though keeping company with monsters and Stellaroids has its charm, as you step out of the Monolith and the forest, it may be the dawn-lit town and academy that beckon as your final destination.
Item.116.3: Driven by evasion and fear, she built a wall of despair in her heart.Yet, she subtly crafted tiny flaws, longing for someone to break through and reach her.
Item.117.3: It's another bustling business day with long lines of customers.Let's start by making that little goal a reality.
Item.118.3: The specimen room in the clinic is steadily filling up,but unfortunately, she still hasn't found the one that captures her heart the most.
Item.119.3: The room is filled with cakes that exude a rich milk aroma.The maid dances gracefully among the cups and plates, lost in her own world.
Item.120.3: Having cast aside their surnames, embraced their past, and charted their future,these heroes have long learned to brave the wind without a single complaint.
Item.123.3: Across the golden fields, two tiny figures are running.She is chasing the setting sun.
Item.125.3: Raindrops dance on her hair and splash at her feet.She strides forward through mud and blossoms, venturing bravely into the distance.
Item.126.3: Fueled by vengeance and ignited by passion,the blazing phoenix breaks free from its shackles, spreading its wings to soar into the vast wilderness and skies of freedom.
Item.127.3: On the day the maiden left, the earthy aroma after a light drizzle lingered vividly in her memory.She made a mark on the map, anticipating the wonderful surprises she would bring back upon her return.
Item.130.3: Time may erase the inscribed marks, but the love and blessings that remain silently shield and guide her on her journey.
Item.132.3: Strangers are the desks, the classroom, the uniform.Yet, your familiar smile is comforting.
Item.133.3: That young girl always wants to carry the weight of the world on her shoulders alone.Never yielding, never settling.
Item.134.3: To protect her friends, she cradles the most invaluable treasure with utmost care.It bears the name of courage.
Item.135.3: Breaking News! Here comes the impartial, brave, fearless legendary witch again!Today's headline... Her Secrets!
Item.137.3: Take flight and soar toward a new world of freedom.
Item.140.3: The person who created it had just one thing in mind—make it cuter!
Item.141.3: Give Chixia a brush and a bottle of ink—and let her bring her Xuanshi world to life.
Item.142.3: The past has sunk into the earth like fallen rain, feeding new sprouts that reach for the sun.From here on out, she will start a new life.
Item.143.3: Through the dust and howling winds, she awaits you ahead.
Item.144.3: The resolute flash of her blade spoke volumes.
Item.145.3: As they brushed past each other, she didn't sense the familiar presence.She had laid her former self to rest with her own hands.
Item.147.3: Spotlights and glowsticks paint a dreamscape. You, my shining star, please keep going.
Item.149.3: Between survival and annihilation, that grace alone must remain inviolable.
Item.150.3: Always working hard at half-assing it.Slacking off is a lifetime commitment.
Item.155.3: Piercing the sea mist and crashing through the waves, a familiar scent will guide you home.
Item.156.3: She only let her childish side show around those she trusts most.
Item.157.3: Among all the natural rhythms of the world, your voice alone stands clear.
Item.158.3: Guard the children's innocent wishes as a spirit.
Item.159.3: She wanders alone on the foreign streets.
Item.160.3: Sun, sand, and surf—this is the vacation she truly deserves.

Item.10303.3: Woven from flowing flames and adorned with golden clouds—a majestic spirit, fierce and free.Rawr—
Item.10304.3: Following the hot sea breeze, I steal a moment from the carnival to catch your eye. It was serene.
Item.10703.3: Suit up, transform! My fighting spirit burns hotter than the sun!Clad in the armor of justice, I'll defend every street like a knight—This is my justice!
Item.10704.3: The sunshine girl is getting ready to cheer you on!Put on your brightest smile and get ready for the next challenge!
Item.11103.3: In the pale winter sunlight, you hold a warm drink as your breath creates a white mist. You, who see yourself as just ordinary, are the one who makes this day special.
Item.11104.3: Uh... I'll do my best to keep this inflatable steady, but please be careful getting on board.—A-And of course, if you fall into the water, I'll definitely pull you back up!
Item.11203.3: Sun, sand, and sea—time to slip into your swimsuit!Feel the warm sun on your skin and the gentle kiss of the waves. Summer's calling, just don't forget your sunscreen!
Item.11303.3: No chili pepper spirits allowed inside Cangwu!T-To protect Cangwu's peace, I, Shimiao, the ma-magical girl of love and justice, demands that you transform back to your original form right now!
Item.11603.3: The best moment I can think of is having a nap in the cozy warmth of the afternoon. When you wake up, the sunlight dances along the windowsill, and the flowers welcome your awakening.
Item.11903.3: The wind sways the clouds as dust dances in sunlight. Only the flowers witness the moments we share.
Item.12003.3: Meticulous thinking, precise calculations, and textbook movements.Sprint, jump, spike... I have everything perfectly planned out, but my body just can't keep up with my mind!Huh? How am I number one in the popularity poll?!
Item.12303.3: O little princess, who tumbled into a wonderland and got lost in a labyrinth of time, do not be quick to seek a way out. For the best views lie buried within dreams that seem absurd.
Item.12503.3: The Snowish Festival she dreams of is a warm, cozy fire, a glass of sweet wine in hand, her best friends' laughter, and a unique gift just for her—from you.
Item.12703.3: Grab the village's finest sword and set off on Teresa's epic quest! Huh? A shiny gold treasure chest? Let's open it—Whoa! What in the world is this?
Item.13203.3: The coolness of the desk beneath my arms, the warmth of the sun on my back.The scent of books enchants me, as I drift into a gentle daydream.
Item.13204.3: The harsh mask that I practiced wearing endlessly shattered the moment I turned and saw you, revealing only the shyness underneath.
Item.13303.3: A light breeze, as flowers bloom in the summer air. A gentle touch, like the hand that held the pinwheel with yours.
Item.13403.3: Clock in on time? Check. Prep the materials? Check. Work hard, stay focused... Whoa there, how did I mess it up again?
Item.13503.3: Indulge in the sweetness of cocoa as a broom zooms across the starlit sky. Leave your worries behind. This is an adventure meant just for you.
Item.13504.3: Even a witch who feeds on truth deserves a little break once in a while.Stretching out while enjoying the sunset—what could be more relaxing than this?
Item.14103.3: Who says the world in the mirror is mere illusion?The moment she dons the queen's crown, hero and villain trade places. Madness becomes rule, and the spotlight turns her way.—Welcome to the Queen of Hearts' wonderland.
Item.14203.3: Summer by the sea is just sunshine, seawater, and sand. Nothing that special…Wait, what?! You're saying there are icy cold drinks you can only get on the island?! Then I'm definitely going too!
Item.14403.3: A morning glory kept in water... How long before its color fades, before its scent drifts away?
Item.14703.3:
Beep boop beep, make way! The show is about to begin!
Just listen—a dreamy, mellow, fluffy, thumpy bass dreamscape!
Item.14903.3: From bitter coffee to blooming roses, I want to share every new experience with you. Let's go on a date when the snow melts?
Item.15603.3: Isn't this what life is all about? A slice of opera cake, a cup of black tea. Dreams swell and rise until the teapot starts to sing.
Item.20003.3: A fang hunted from the beasts that haunt the forest.It's covered with eerie vines that seem to pulsate with a life of their own,whispering the protests of the forest.
Item.20013.3: Nestled deep in the forest, is it the flower... or the fruit of a mysterious parasitic plant?Countless blood-like mouths like these lure prey into their traps...
Item.20023.3: A core collected from the remnants of the Colossus.Indeed...it seems to know you; you are its chosen target.
Item.20043.3: The fully bloomed flower of "Lithe Beauty."It emits a strange, demoralizing scent of darkness and anxiety.
Item.20053.3: An accessory crafted from the tail feathers of the Emerald Blade.As a symbol of your triumph over the boss, wearing it may bring you more commission opportunities.
Item.20063.3: A hidden reef paradise atop the Hexhorn Whale's head.The sea giant's very body becomes a sanctuary where creatures live out their long lives in the winding maze, day after day, year after year.
Item.20071.3: An old hat with torn fringes. It still carries dust that has risen from eerie dance moves.
Item.20072.3: An elaborate bowler.In the spotlight, it is a reflection of the master's ever-shifting grace.
Item.20073.3: A top hat decorated with ornament.When the spotlight fades, its frenzy retreats like a receding tide.
Item.20081.3: Mortal, this is the reward from great Count of the Duloos. You should show gratitude for his generosity.
Item.20082.3: I, the great Count of the Duloos, now grant you the treasure, a jar of vintage wine. Praise me for my generosity, mortal!
Item.20083.3: Kneel down, mortal! Here is a gift from the great Count of the Duloos! Accept this supreme honor with gratitude and awe.
Item.20091.3: The unburned wick of Evernight Emberflies. It is so faint that it seems like it can never be ignited again.
Item.20092.3: The essence of Evernight Emberflies. It was once brightly lit.
Item.20093.3: The core of Evernight Emberflies. It refuses to close its eyes, and every crack is a sign of recurring frenzies.
Item.20997.3: A random basic material used for Trekker tier-up.
Item.21003.3: In some parts, this mighty beast is known as the "Forest Lord." Legends say it's more than just a force of destruction: It's nature incarnate, a true king whose soul is bound to the forest it rules.
Item.21013.3: Cunning and spooky, it sets traps and shifts its form endlessly... Only the truly fearless can overcome its twisted evil and harness the power at its core.
Item.21023.3: Its tall, imposing form was meant to stand in that mysterious and regal chamber.Whether it was the master's mistake to leave, or its own for following, no longer seems to matter with the passing of time.
Item.21043.3: It wasn't born of nature. Beneath its lovely facade runs poison, driven by the ruthless ambition of corporate schemers.
Item.21053.3: It was forced to dwell within this delicate cage, its wild nature howling and thrashing beneath the mask.
Item.21063.3: A colossal shadow lurking beneath the deep sea. Each time it surfaces, it brings surging waves and the awe-inspiring force of nature.
Item.21071.3: Grasp the lingering aura on this eerie breath. You can still feel the force of the eerie power within, a call from another dimension.
Item.21072.3: The lingering soul holds the purest essence of spirit. As you grasp it, the image of uncanny phantom step rises once more in your mind.
Item.21073.3: It enjoys the frenzied stage, bowing just in preparation for embracing more impassioned beats.
Item.21081.3: The great Count is unbeatable. It just fights to test the strength of the mortal and mercifully rewards them with treasure.
Item.21082.3: The great Count fights beyond the cause of victory. It just fools with reckless mortals to spend afternoon tea time and generously shares with them its cellaring.
Item.21083.3: The great Count won't bear disgrace!The count pretends to be sleeping to let the mortal win, and the dropped fragment is its generous gift to the mortal for their perseverance.
Item.21091.3: Grasp the lingering aura on this faint light. You can still feel its obsession with ever-glowing.
Item.21092.3: The lingering soul holds the purest essence of spirit. As you grasp it, the image of touching glow rises once more in your mind. The stunning light is both a sword and a cage.
Item.21093.3: It indulges in the night and shuns the day.It just hopes to have its own valuable time and freedom.
Item.30001.3: A beginner's guide tailored for novice Trekkers.Even though it's just a few pages long, reading it will always be beneficial.
Item.30002.3: A journal filled with handy tips for Trekkers.Read through a couple, and you'll avoid making mistakes your seniors made.
Item.30003.3: Each page is packed with reflections and lessons learned.Its weight signifies not only the memories of the journey, but also the wisdom accumulated.
Item.30004.3: Absorbing knowledge without comprehension is futile; even the finest books deserve repeated perusals.A true Trekker has every line of their books etched in their memory.
Item.31002.3: A testament to your victory over a mysterious and powerful boss."Exactly! If you don't work hard, how can I enjoy this fine wine?"
Item.31007.3: Proof of having defeated a mysterious and powerful boss."You've got to be kidding me. I bet this belongs to someone else!"
Item.32000.3: For Trekkers, wisdom, skill and experience are more important than strength and magic.—One can always learn something by playing chess with the more experienced.
Item.32001.3: Tap the buttons to the rhythm of the music—a game anyone can pick up. It's a fun and effortless way to improve one's coordination, making it a hit among Trekkers.
Item.32002.3: Step up your game with this challenging hardcore rhythm game. Most people struggle to keep up with so many notes.But, true virtuosos glide through with seamless elegance.
Item.32003.3: Enter the realm of "Boss's Tune," a music game series that pushes the limits. Only those with lightning-fast reflexes or perhaps an extra pair of hands dare to take up the challenge. Could this be the next step in human evolution?!
Item.32011.3: Dodge bullets and blast your enemies to smithereens. This game features simple rules, but it significantly sharpens your reflexes.Trekkers often joke about these games, calling them "Little Butterflies."
Item.32012.3: As the saying goes, "A little goes a long way," and "Barrage" is a testament to this. It evolves its gameplay purely through escalating difficulty. While ordinary players are still struggling for "survival," geniuses are already shooting for "high scores."
Item.32013.3: For all those previous shooter games, Trekkers would always boast, "It's nothing special..." But then "Demon Bee" showed up.Oh boy, is it a beast! Not a single soul has managed to clear the game without using continues or losing a life.Could this be the ultimate test of skill?
Item.32021.3: Punch! Kick! Rising Dragon Strike! Knock your enemies off the stage!This Kung Fu game serves as both a battleground for Trekkers to hone their combat skills and a fantastic outlet for stress relief.
Item.32022.3: To the masters, "fighting" is the "art of outflanking." In other words, patience often leads to victory—cultivating this hunter's mindset is crucial for protecting Trekkers.
Item.32023.3: Mindless attacks won't secure a win. Take the game "Phantom" as an example; there's an opponent who can seamlessly block 15 punches in the blink of an eye.If you can break through his defense, your combat skills will truly be unparalleled.
Item.33001.3: Each time a Monolith is explored, Wishing Eggs will appear along with Wishing Boxes and can be used to wish for common Artifacts.In addition to selling Artifacts to the people of the cities for money, Trekkers sometimes save some "leftovers" for themselves.
Item.33011.3: A marvelous Artifact that ignites with just a flick. It's a truly handy tool for Trekkers journeying through the Wilds.Strictly prohibited in dense forests!
Item.33012.3: Equipped with directional nozzles, this Artifact boasts enhanced capacity and firepower, making it perfect for heating food.Even in the Wilds, you can whip up delicious grilled meat patties that taste just like mom's!
Item.33013.3: With super-charged firepower and capacity, it can even serve as a weapon to fend off wild beasts.Be warned, it's banned from all forms of transportation in Nova's cities due to its hazardous nature. Yet, it remains a highly sought-after treasure among Trekkers, chefs, and acrobats!
Item.33021.3: The unveiling of camera Artifact marks another groundbreaking moment in the arts and media landscape.Some believe capturing a photo steals a part of one's soul, making it a niche hobby.
Item.33022.3: When the Reflective Photo Capturer first emerged, painters cried foul, fearing job loss. But soon, some embraced the change, adopting the title of "Photographist" and carving out a new field.
Item.33023.3: The ultimate dream Artifact for Photographists.With this, you can capture any fleeting moment from afar, preserving it forever on film...Still, maybe it's this fleeting nature that gives life its meaning.
Item.33031.3: One of the most popular daily Artifacts in the Shop, and a must-have for many female Trekkers.Before this handy device, Novians would rely on magical spells or simply sitting in warm places to dry their wet hair.
Item.33032.3: An upgraded hair dryer with precise temperature and speed settings, minimizing hair damage.Just like savoring a glass of fine red wine after a gourmet meal, using this after a refreshing bath takes your relaxation to the next level.
Item.33033.3: An extremely expensive daily Artifact, exclusive to the boudoirs of aristocrats and legendary stars.Though boasting powerful functions, the owners often prefer to flaunt it as a status symbol rather than putting it to actual use.
Item.33041.3: A simple blowing device, compact and easy to carry, but don't expect too much when it comes to its cooling effect.
Item.33042.3: A cooling artifact that really makes a splash, but its size and weight make it less portable.However, it's a potent weapon against the heat and irritability.
Item.33043.3: An Artifact that is hailed as the ultimate savior against scorching heat,It not only rescues any Novian from the deadly grip of blazing summers but also boasts a pivoting function, spreading its benevolent coolness far and wide.
Item.33051.3: Push the button, and it'll radiate a warm, inspiring burst of colored light. Perfect for live performances to ignite the atmosphere!You're my top pick!
Item.33052.3: Even though not a superstar yet, this raw gem already shines so brightly... Is this what it feels like to grow together?—You over there, and you over here—I see you all!
Item.33053.3: Even if you've become a megastar, I'll be in the stands, waving the glow stick for you with all my heart once more!In the instant our eyes meet, that's when magic happens.
Item.33061.3: It's said that placing it beside your bed will summon stars to your dreams.Did these twinkles traverse the night sky just for us?
Item.33062.3: Display a moon at home to keep you company.This mysterious ruler of the night, whose secrets have remained hidden for millennia,Is both the mirror of the day and a reflection of our souls.
Item.33063.3: Scholars have yet to fathom the universe,So the Starry Tyrant grants wisdom from beyond this world,Crystallizing truth into tangible shapes.
Item.33071.3: Escape the scorching heat of summer with a delightful bowl of refreshing crushed ice!
Item.33072.3: Wandering the streets on a lazy afternoon, I passed by an ice cream shop with inviting chill, dreaming of sharing a sweet treat with you on my next visit.
Item.33073.3: I've finally asked you out. The "Buy One, Get One Half Off" deal was just my excuse.My favorite flavor? Same as yours!
Item.33081.3: This uniquely shaped tea bowl is said to attract purring mystical beasts when placed at your doorstep. The more delicious the food inside, the more cracks will appear on its surface—greedy beasts often knock it over in their haste.
Item.33082.3: A treasured heirloom passed down through generations, delicately crafted with intricate designs of azure blossoms on its pristine white glaze. Whenever esteemed guests visit, the enthusiastic Loong retrieves it from the wooden cabinet to brew a cup of warm tea.
Item.33083.3: This kettle pulses with enigmatic energy. It looks like It's made of glass, but It's actually crafted from a special material, making it robust enough to withstand any harsh environment. Whether it holds a life-saving antidote or a mesmerizing poison is entirely up to the whim of its maker.

Item.130009.3: Well, guess I'll be lost for a good while again.
Item.130010.3: Whatever you say, it's still a Shrubshrew.
Item.130011.3: What's wrong with living in a fantasy world?!
Item.199008.3:
Tilia Appearance (2D):
This Is My Justice!
Item.199014.3:
Caramel's exclusive appearance:
Mellow Bass Echo
Item.199016.3:
Teresa Appearance (2D):
Rookie Hero Reporting In
Item.199018.3:
Ridge Appearance (2D):
Repose in the Ever-Warm Shade
Item.199021.3:
Ann's exclusive appearance:
Princess of the Wondrous Wilds
Item.199023.3:
Shimiao's exclusive appearance:
Feeling Spicy? Take the Heat!
Item.199025.3:
Cosette Appearance (2D):
A Taste of Summer All to Herself
Item.199027.3:
Canace Appearance (2D):
The Formula for Victory
Item.211001.3:
Standing in the wilderness, a gentle breeze caresses.
Another day blooms anew.
Item.211002.3:
A golden sea, brimming with the joy of harvest.
Make sure to eat well and take care of yourself!
Item.211003.3:
A tiny broom soaring with grand dreams.
The cloud-hidden scenery awaits tomorrow's discovery.
Item.211004.3:
A princess revered by all, a hero returning with honors.
Dreams are blind to status; your harvest grows with every step you take.
Item.211005.3:
The sand sea engulfs the horizon, obscuring the journey's end.
It's time to pause and catch your breath.
Item.211006.3:
A sparkling spring kisses your skirt hem, stopping you in your tracks.
Quench your thirst first, then brace yourself for the thorny path ahead.
Item.211007.3:
Shimmering stars light up the night sky.
Brave maidens, it's time to embark on your journey!
Item.211008.3:
Gentle starlight, farewell to today.
The bell rings to close today's business!
Item.212001.3:
I can't wait!
I'm desperate to savor my favorite iced black tea, sweetened with sugar, topped with creamy foam, infused with tangerine slices, sprinkled with chocolate crumbs, and blended with pineapple and mango juice!
Item.212002.3:
Spinning around in circles, vying for the chairs.
Only those who grab a chair get to sit down.
Wait, aren't we playing "Freeze Dance"?
Item.212003.3:
To Whom It May Concern,
With admiration for your outstanding dance skills,
you are warmly invited to this never-ending dance party.
Item.212005.3:
Pump up the jam, and keep the dance floor thumpin'!
Let the volume shatter the skies, let our passion ignite the clouds!
My adrenaline has skyrocketed to its absolute limit!
Item.212006.3:
At the dawn of creation,
shattered beliefs hovered above the horizon, casting its glow over the world.
Humans leaped over mountains, gazing boldly at the gods.
And then, heaven and earth split, the light dimmed, and days merged into an endless flow.
Item.212007.3:
The wind awakens all creatures and paints the forest with a splash of vibrant colors, whispering the news of the party to every corner of the woods and caves:
The grand celebration of the forest and its elves is about to begin!
Item.212008.3:
Keep the joyful moments for yourself.
Embrace it as a break—immerse yourself in this refreshing, fleeting joy.
Item.212009.3:
Its grudge still rages within, burning fiercely.
"——! ——————!!"
Alas, it's hard to comprehend its sorrowful cries.
Item.212010.3:
Once the war horn sounds, there's no going back.
Fight! Fight until the bitter end!
Item.213001.3:
"Isn't a laundry room for washing clothes?"
"Aren't oranges just for eating?"
"What are we doing here?"
"Stop chatting and look at the camera..."
"This is the hottest photo trend right now!"
Item.213002.3:
In spring and summer's embrace, petals dance in the air;
in autumn and winter's chill, rain drizzles relentlessly.
The scenes mirrored in your eyes
fluctuate with the changing seasons,
how am I supposed to understand them?
Item.213003.3:
On the stage enveloped by cheers, they shine brightly as they play their final melody.
The tumultuous emotions ignite the notes, consuming this night with fiery passion.
Item.213005.3:
Bammm! The cells are splitting!
Gurgleee! The brains are boiling!
Sliced right from the top,
one me multiplies into a thousand—how do you find the true me?
Item.213006.3:
Sinking into the cozy embrace of my soft bed, I find myself utterly unwilling to stir.
If we drift off together, will our dreams intertwine?
Item.213007.3:
Golden birds flap their wings, splitting the dreamscape as soft as clouds.
In the cracks where memories weave, we will eventually meet the ones we long to see.
Item.213008.3: The scenery along the journey is a gift we should appreciate. Let's take it slow, bring some snacks, and enjoy this bright, sunny break—it'll surely add a joyful chapter to our memories.
Item.213009.3: Warm raindrops trickle down from head to toe, sliding down every inch of my skin. Ah—choo! It's not a cold, just the soap bubbles tickling me again.
Item.213010.3:
The whirling harbor breeze,
The hot air from the steaming baskets...
As you lean in close, your breath merges with.
The neon-hued vapors, blurring my vision.
Item.213011.3: Beyond the veil of silence and solemnity, is there another side of you that I haven't yet discovered? Electronic-distorted notes peel away the mundane facade, revealing a tender gaze under the neon glow that beckons me toward you.
Item.213012.3:
With the earth as our stage and the starry sky as our backdrop,
Listen up, universe—this is our moment to shine!
Item.213013.3:
Dart through fields of wheat and play in maple forests, pausing where the seasons meet.
Oh, sun-kissed child, hide away, before the pains of growing up can find you.
Item.213014.3:
Tighten the screws, apply the grease.
Behind every great knight is an even greater blacksmith.
Safe travels—and don't ride too fast!
Item.213015.3:
I smile often, yet true happiness is a rare guest.
For that scent, once vibrant, now fades and drifts further away.
Yet, whenever I reach for it, there's a stinging pain in my heart...
Item.213016.3:
You've tasted the sweet forbidden fruit,
now you're the goddess of art.
Stand as the sole, ever-blooming rose in this pond of love and desire.
Sing, dance, shine, and repeat.
Keep going till the strings break, never stop.
Item.213017.3:
Summer wraps up in a blur of sweat, yet there's still time to touch up for the next show.
In the corner of a winter celebration, I score the last ice cream cone before closing.
No matter how life is divided between work and leisure,
I'm still me, whole and unchanged.
Item.213018.3:
On this eagerly anticipated day,
Standing before the dazzling shelves,
Which beverage holds the most anticipated flavor?
If you're torn between decisions,
Then take them all with you!
Item.213019.3:
Shimmering like fragile bubbles, they are dreams woven from pure imagination.
As these dreams burst and their shimmer fades, they uncover the purest truth,
whispering it all in silence.
Item.213020.3:
The moment wood splinters flew, a ravenous hunger burst through the door.
"No—get away from my emergency food stash! Aaaaah!"
Item.213021.3:
Mirrors never tell lies;
they beckon you in and bid you farewell.
Your fate is inscribed on a particle of drifting dust,
while divine prophecy mirrors itself in my gaze.
Item.213022.3:
Here lies the gateway to the Inferno.
It leads straight to the abyss of sin.
I wait by the riverbank, illuminating your sorrowful journey ahead,
blessing you to plunge into my eternal love.
Item.213023.3:
You skillfully push open the door,
And her pristine wings bring solace to your aching heart.
Together, you share a serene silence, a peaceful bond just between the two of you.
You know that her silence is her ultimate compassion towards you.
And your visit is the sole redemption she can ever hope for.
Item.213024.3:
"Hey, regular! Good to see ya! Your usual?"
"Huh? This seat's for toddlers only?"
"Eh, rules are made to be broken, right? Nobody's watching anyway!"
"Zoning out is adult paradise!"

Perfect vacation goals right here!
Resting on the register, she savors a dream, tart and sweet.
Item.213025.3:
O little bunny,
close your eyes and drift to sleep,
I'll cradle you in the arms of the night;

O little bunny,
rest your head and dream sweetly,
I promise you the sweetest treat of all.
Item.213026.3:
"La-la-la—welcome home, Master! ♥"
"Whether it's the weariness in your heart or the misfortune at your side,"
"I will personally help you sweep all that nasty trash away!"
"Let me turn my energy into your magic! ♥"
"Heaven's cutest maid, Beatrixa, at your service! ♥"

With a clear, lively voice and an impossibly cute demeanor,
she gave her all every day
to deliver healing and hope to her fans across the Nova Continent.
Item.214001.3:
Humans are born alone.
Only in the heat of battle do we truly feel alive.
Huh? Cool guys don't look at explosions? Fine, I heard you—
Item.214002.3:
Like flower petals, your departing form dissolves,
Beneath starlit nights, our vows still warm my palm,
These perfumed days bring thoughts of you, despite my own will.
Item.214003.3:
Upward, upward, ever upward.
Through twelve heavens I soar, your gaze still following.
Not gravity's bond, but a homeward stellar road.
Item.214004.3:
Look who's here—two little soft kittens on my knee?
Afternoon tea time stretches far.
Sleep soundly. Let purple wisteria shade your beautiful dreams.
Item.214005.3:
The blossoms drift in rainy haze,
That flowered in bright sunny days.
A rainbow's gleam within my hand—
Could such beauty ever stay?
Item.214006.3:
The witch stands proud, head held high,
Granting honey, venom, and love divine.
You who failed to choose your princess right,
Embrace this cruel pleasure, and dance with me tonight?
Item.214007.3:
They set the rules of right and wrong,
but if you loathe these bindings, rise as a midnight knight.
Even if bloodied and broken, we're staying true to who we are!
To those arrogant jerks:
"See this mighty fist?"
"After the clock strikes twelve, this is our domain!"
Item.214008.3:
Why chase that distant rainbow on the horizon,
when you can hold these colorful balloons right here?
Soaring through clear skies on the roller coaster ride.
Listen!
The echoes of pure joy just made their way to you!
Item.214009.3:
Only one day of food left. Our wallets are empty. The Oasis's Grace is running low...
We've staked everything on this Monolith commission...
—Still, when it's time for the group photo, don't forget to smile!
Item.214010.3:
We beseech Thee, have mercy; heed our plea.
Goddess, do the cries of mortals reach Thine ears?
...
—Each word finds Me, finds Us all.
We shall guide humanity towards its glorious destiny.
Item.214011.3:
Before looking back at the start, what seemed the end was just
the start of a new chapter.
Are you happy as you've always dreamed you'd be?
Let's meet again tomorrow.
Item.214012.3:
On United Harvest's grand design, Philae stands as just a single point.
From here, I shall draw a perfect circle, claiming the entire Nova.
—Follow me. Pledge loyalty. March ever onward.
Item.214013.3:
"First, we need a ship, then courage, and lastly, faith."
The adventurer pinned the map
While whitecaps rage from point to point
Wild waters crash and beckon towards mysteries
She waits for kindred souls to sail.
Item.214014.3:
We trekked, picked, and laughed with our friends,
sharing sweet fruit that burst with juice in our mouths.
Item.214015.3:
Deer call softly in the grove, wild grass their sweet feast.
A maiden rests in afternoon shade, where sunbeams dance and weave.
Like wind through time the moments flow, "Click"—a memory to keep.
Item.214016.3:
As dawn arrives to greet the day, the last petal falls.
I search through time's unending flow, for traces lost so long ago.
As sun and moon their cycles keep, and time flows like a river deep,
Through your gaze, forever bright, I'll bloom eternal in your sight.
Item.214017.3:
Like a human life, fireworks bloom, flourish, and fade—
brief yet brilliant, leaving their unique mark across the night sky.
It's much like a Trekker's endless quest to climb the Monolith,
all for that one day when they might finally hold the stars in their hands...
Item.214018.3:
With guilt my heart was heavy worn, to heal the bridge that had been torn.
Thought friendship's door was closed for good,
Till here we sit, just as we should.
New décor graces these old walls, new packages the sweet food calls.
One drink runs hot, one drink runs cold,
Same taste remains from days of old.
Item.214019.3:
Kasimira, are you ready?
This is round 37 and our final match for today.

Too bad, just one shot shy.
If that shot had landed, you'd have had me beat.
Chaton, your hand wavered at the critical moment.

Just the thought of besting you gets my adrenaline pumping!
Let's do it again!

Rack the gun, we've got the next commission to prep for.

—Looks like Chaton's challenge isn't over yet.
Item.214020.3:
"Uneventful days aren't worth recording."
"Dull little things aren't worth recording."
"Repetitive work isn't worth recording."
But...are they truly worthless?
A teammate's reminder before you head out, the wrong turn you took, the smiles and thanks you received...
These ordinary fragments of memory condense into tiny points of light.
Even if the paper turns yellow with time, the brilliance of each day will never be forgotten.
Item.214021.3:
Friends, companions...whatever the name, they all embody the same group of souls united by fate. They converge when the threads of fate intertwine, and disperse when they unwind.
What we can do is cherish every fleeting moment of this reunion, laughing and playing with all our hearts, and etching those precious memories deep into our hearts.
And as the hour of parting draws near, we cling to the hope of a future encounter, anticipating the day we shall meet again.
Item.214022.3:
Behold, something looms in the dark.
Listen closely, do you hear those footsteps echoing?
Odd, a sudden shiver runs down my spine.

A faulty projector, an unknown film reel, and eerie visuals flickering...
A Trekker's camp at midnight, an uninvited guest, and an unexpected visitor.
"Meow—"
The silence envelops all. You close the door, but it has already slipped inside.
Item.214023.3:
We had to take a day off now and then.
Escape the gang fights and the daily grind,
step out under a clear sky, and spray paint a rainbow of our own across it.
Item.214024.3:
A rope
dangled from a sunlit ledge,
dropping into the long-forgotten ruins.
The girl grabbed it
and rappelled down.
"Hah, just some treasure?
Watch me haul it up!"
Item.214026.3:
Damp hair clung to her back.
Her clothes were a mess, yet the air was stiflingly still.
Carrying a heavy heart, even the falling petals seemed to weigh her down.
As the rain fell endlessly, your silhouette began to blur.
Item.214027.3:
Brush and ink are her weapons.
On the stretched rice paper,
She weaves her magic, each brushstroke dancing in unconventional places.
This is her realm, a world of enchantment solely under her command.
Item.214028.3:
A petal without a name or number
drifts into the silent garden,
carrying a blush of crimson and a vision of pure white,
settling into a golden specimen, alongside a vanished dream.
Item.214029.3:
The Meow God said my treasure would appear in my favorite place.
So I searched every amusement park in the Monoliths.
And finally... right here, I nabbed this tiny, squishy little thing!
Item.214030.3:
The girl burst in with the afternoon sun,
bringing with her the aroma of snacks.
Fries? Grilled fish? Or a loaf of fluffy, warm bread?
You got to grab something
to enjoy this stolen moment of peace.
Item.214031.3:
An alarm blared as blade met axe.
The cage shattered, and she plunged into the abyss.
Through the crimson rain, she met your eyes.
Item.214032.3:
Facts captured.
Photos printed.
Story broadcast.
Welcome to the witches' Dream Factory of ☆Truth!
Item.214033.3:
Ah, welcome to my ball, my dear patient.
Listen, the music is playing. Come, dance with my collection among these phantom bubbles.
Item.214036.3:
Body bound, soul eroded,
even pain masquerades as a mire of salvation.
The fallen priestess still wanders
on a pilgrimage with no answers and no end,
awaiting a righteous one to grant her release.
Item.214037.3:
The children of the Ash District tell a legend:
when despair grips the world and tears loved ones apart,
a green-haired heroine called the "Lord of the Prize Claw" and her brave companions
will lead everyone to catch the last glimmer of hope and reunite with their families.
Item.214038.3:
Floating on a thousand crests,
a translucent, shimmering thing.
Escaping the searing summer heat,
drifting along with the migrating fish.
Item.214039.3:
I long for the sea breeze to linger, for the waves to remain.
I pray for the sunset to stretch endlessly, for the starlight to never fade.
I wish to share with you alone—a summer that belongs to us.
Item.214040.3:
To protect your companions, to summon the courage and become your best self,
strike your fist at the colossal enemy,
and clear the path to a future full of hope.
Item.214041.3:
A sleigh full of gifts
guided by the messenger
heading toward the sunrise and its destination
except—
shouldn't reindeer be pulling it?!
Item.214042.3:
Midnight bells chime to welcome the Springseek Festival
as fireworks set the night sky ablaze.
Amid the revelry, the crowd wishes
that there is joy and peace for the days and years ahead.
Item.214043.3:
Beneath the soil steeped in conspiracy and intrigue,
Watchful, calculating gazes interweave.
Something is struggling to break through the earth.
Item.214044.3:
The drawn curtains create a cozy, warm retreat.
Her smile is tender,
but the syringe in her hand glints chillingly.
"Don't be afraid. It will be over before you know it."
Item.214045.3: A fierce wind sends petals swirling through the sky as paper umbrellas snap shut Look—within the sea of blossoms, before the formation of parasols A slender figure dances gracefullyIs it real… or just a fleeting dream?
Item.214046.3: Think of it as nothing more than a marvelous Stella Drama.When we return our present, our trusted friends are still here with us.Leave the dark Monolith behind. The winter night will pass.And look: spring's warm sunlight will shine once more upon this city that once thrived.
Item.214047.3: Sharpen the crease, press firm the wax,Longing turns to ink upon the page.A sudden gust sweeps the words away,Leaving a thousand thoughts ... lighter than the air.
Item.214048.3:
The winter wind carries prayers from afarThe messenger arrives with blessings and gifts
Stepping into view as the midnight bells ringThis Snowish Festival gift is for you, who never lost your childish wonder
Item.214049.3: Dispel the haze and race toward the stars beyond; Ring the bell of beginnings and set our adventure in motion. Love and hope await along the way—and for this journey… thank you for being here.
Item.214050.3: Countless toasts exchanged, endless lofty talks—visions and dreams only seem real in this fleeting moment.Yet beyond the light, on the moon's hidden side,shadows long for a world where dreams can truly exist.
Item.214051.3: As flowers and water embrace the earth, as stars revolve in search of one another,all things in this world lean on each other—so let me share your solitude as well.In the dark depths of space, let me light the starlight that guides you home.
Item.214052.3: Gears lock into place, sparking a universe of wild imagination.The rabbit unrolls her inspiration list while tweezers and wrenches cobble together absurd inventions.The girl's pen skips across the blueprints.And beneath an adorable shell, a dangerous new weapon comes to life.
Item.214053.3: Whether after a nerve-wracking, narrow escape from death,or a candid, grudge‑shattering conversation,there is always a joyful, open‑hearted gathering, where people share a meal together, finally letting go of the past.Looking at everything around her, she suddenly realizes this very moment is what is most worth cherishing.
Item.214054.3: A little paradise that's ours alone,running with her through the dim lamplight.Don't be afraid of stumbling—I'll hold your hand tight,until we make it to the end together.
Item.214055.3:
Sunlight filters through the clear water,
warming the ocean with a gentle glow.
A girl gazes up at the shimmering light—
what lies beyond those ripples?
Item.214056.3:
Broken patterns of light drift across her hair,
as she steps into a flowing stream.
The forest wind follows the sound of insects,
whispering that midsummer has quietly arrived.
Item.214057.3:
The sea reaches for you with gentle waves.
Every sound joins the celebration in perfect harmony.
With friends by your side and the breeze beneath you,
sail toward summer, toward the sea beyond the horizon.
Item.214058.3:
One by one, we count the seasons gone by,
laying yesterday's sorrows to rest.
O summer memories, poured out with every burst of laughter,
may you never be carried away by the tides of time.
Item.214059.3:
The caged bird sings, its feathers shimmering in the sunlight.
It pauses, holding back its excitement.
Despite the cage, its hope for tomorrow endures.
One day, it will spread its wings and soar toward its dreams and freedom.
Item.214060.3:
Her heart is pounding.
The cheers from the crowd, the shutter sound of photo capturers,
and the lights illuminating the hall and sparkling like stars.
For the first time, people are here for her, looking at her with approval.
This is the most glorious moment of her life.

Item.223022.3: Here lies the gateway to the Inferno.It leads straight to the abyss of sin.I wait by the riverbank, illuminating your sorrowful journey ahead,blessing you to plunge into my eternal love.
Item.223023.3: You skillfully push open the door,And her pristine wings bring solace to your aching heart.Together, you share a serene silence, a peaceful bond just between the two of you.You know that her silence is her ultimate compassion towards you.And your visit is the sole redemption she can ever hope for.
Item.223024.3: "Hey, regular! Good to see ya! Your usual?""Huh? This seat's for toddlers only?""Eh, rules are made to be broken, right? Nobody's watching anyway!""Zoning out is adult paradise!"Perfect vacation goals right here!Resting on the register, she savors a dream, tart and sweet.
Item.223025.3: O little bunny,close your eyes and drift to sleep,I'll cradle you in the arms of the night;O little bunny,rest your head and dream sweetly,I promise you the sweetest treat of all.
Item.223026.3: "La-la-la—welcome home, Master! ♥""Whether it's the weariness in your heart or the misfortune at your side,""I will personally help you sweep all that nasty trash away!""Let me turn my energy into your magic! ♥""Heaven's cutest maid, Beatrixa, at your service! ♥"With a clear, lively voice and an impossibly cute demeanor,she gave her all every dayto deliver healing and hope to her fans across the Nova Continent.
Item.224001.3: Humans are born alone.Only in the heat of battle do we truly feel alive.Huh? Cool guys don't look at explosions? Fine, I heard you—
Item.224002.3: Like flower petals, your departing form dissolves,Beneath starlit nights, our vows still warm my palm,These perfumed days bring thoughts of you, despite my own will.
Item.224003.3: Upward, upward, ever upward.Through twelve heavens I soar, your gaze still following.Not gravity's bond, but a homeward stellar road.
Item.224004.3: Look who's here—two little soft kittens on my knee?Afternoon tea time stretches far.Sleep soundly. Let purple wisteria shade your beautiful dreams.
Item.224005.3: The blossoms drift in rainy haze,That flowered in bright sunny days.A rainbow's gleam within my hand—Could such beauty ever stay?
Item.224006.3: The witch stands proud, head held high,Granting honey, venom, and love divine.You who failed to choose your princess right,Embrace this cruel pleasure, and dance with me tonight?
Item.224007.3: They set the rules of right and wrong,but if you loathe these bindings, rise as a midnight knight.Even if bloodied and broken, we're staying true to who we are!To those arrogant jerks:"See this mighty fist?""After the clock strikes twelve, this is our domain!"
Item.224008.3: Why chase that distant rainbow on the horizon,when you can hold these colorful balloons right in your hand?Soaring through clear skies on the roller coaster ride.Listen!The echoes of pure joy just made their way to you!
Item.224009.3: Only one day of food left. Our wallets are empty. The Oasis's Grace is running low...We've staked everything on this Monolith commission...—Still, when it's time for the group photo, don't forget to smile!
Item.224010.3: We beseech Thee, have mercy; heed our plea.Goddess, do the cries of mortals reach Thine ears?...—Each word finds Me, finds Us all.We shall guide humanity towards its glorious destiny.
Item.224011.3: Before looking back at the start, what seemed the end was justthe start of a new chapter.Are you happy as you've always dreamed you'd be?Let's meet again tomorrow.
Item.224012.3: On United Harvest's grand design, Philae stands as just a single point.From here, I shall draw a perfect circle, claiming the entire Nova.—Follow me. Pledge loyalty. March ever onward.
Item.224013.3: "First, we need a ship, then courage, and lastly, faith."The adventurer pinned the mapWhile whitecaps rage from point to pointWild waters crash and beckon towards mysteriesShe waits for kindred souls to sail.
Item.224014.3: We trekked, picked, and laughed with our friends,sharing sweet fruit that burst with juice in our mouths.
Item.224015.3: Deer call softly in the grove, wild grass their sweet feast.A maiden rests in afternoon shade, where sunbeams dance and weave.Like wind through time the moments flow, "Click"—a memory to keep.
Item.224016.3: As dawn arrives to greet the day, the last petal falls.I search through time's unending flow, for traces lost so long ago.As sun and moon their cycles keep, and time flows like a river deep,Through your gaze, forever bright, I'll bloom eternal in your sight.
Item.224017.3: Like a human life, fireworks bloom, flourish, and fade—brief yet brilliant, leaving their unique mark across the night sky.It's much like a Trekker's endless quest to climb the Monolith,all for that one day when they might finally hold the stars in their hands...
Item.224018.3: With guilt my heart was heavy worn, to heal the bridge that had been torn.Thought friendship's door was closed for good,Till here we sit, just as we should.New décor graces these old walls, new packages the sweet food calls.One drink runs hot, one drink runs cold,Same taste remains from days of old.
Item.224019.3: Kasimira, are you ready?This is round 37 and our final match for today.Too bad, just one shot shy.If that shot had landed, you'd have had me beat.Chaton, your hand wavered at the critical moment.Just the thought of besting you gets my adrenaline pumping!Let's do it again!Rack the gun, we've got the next commission to prep for.—Looks like Chaton's challenge isn't over yet.
Item.224020.3: "Uneventful days aren't worth recording.""Dull little things aren't worth recording.""Repetitive work isn't worth recording."But ... are they truly worthless?A teammate's reminder before you head out, the wrong turn you took, the smiles and thanks you received...These ordinary fragments of memory condense into tiny points of light.Even if the paper turns yellow with time, the brilliance of each day will never be forgotten.
Item.224021.3: Friends, companions ... whatever the name, they all embody the same group of souls united by fate. They converge when the threads of fate intertwine, and disperse when they unwind.What we can do is cherish every fleeting moment of this reunion, laughing and playing with all our hearts, and etching those precious memories deep into our hearts.And as the hour of parting draws near, we cling to the hope of a future encounter, anticipating the day we shall meet again.
Item.224022.3: Behold, something looms in the dark.Listen closely, do you hear those footsteps echoing?Odd, a sudden shiver runs down my spine.A faulty projector, an unknown film reel, and eerie visuals flickering...A Trekker's camp at midnight, an uninvited guest, and an unexpected visitor."Meow—"The silence envelops all. You close the door, but it has already slipped inside.
Item.224023.3: We had to take a day off now and then.Escape the gang fights and the daily grind,step out under a clear sky, and spray paint a rainbow of our own across it.
Item.224024.3: A ropedangled from a sunlit ledge,dropping into the long-forgotten ruins.The girl grabbed itand rappelled down."Hah, just some treasure?Watch me haul it up!"
Item.224026.3: Damp hair clung to her back.Her clothes were a mess, yet the air was stiflingly still.Carrying a heavy heart, even the falling petals seemed to weigh her down.As the rain fell endlessly, your silhouette began to blur.
Item.224027.3: Brush and ink are her weapons.On the stretched rice paper,She weaves her magic, each brushstroke dancing in unconventional places.This is her realm, a world of enchantment solely under her command.
Item.224028.3: A petal without a name or numberdrifts into the silent garden,carrying a blush of crimson and a vision of pure white,settling into a golden specimen, alongside a vanished dream.
Item.224029.3: The Meow God said my treasure would appear in my favorite place.So I searched every amusement park in the Monoliths.And finally ... right here, I nabbed this tiny, squishy little thing!
Item.224030.3: The girl burst in with the afternoon sun,bringing with her the aroma of snacks.Fries? Grilled fish? Or a loaf of fluffy, warm bread?You had to grab somethingto enjoy this stolen moment of peace.
Item.224031.3: An alarm blared as blade met axe.The cage shattered, and she plunged into the abyss.Through the crimson rain, she met your eyes.
Item.224032.3: Facts captured.Photos printed.Story broadcast.Welcome to the witches' Truth ☆ Dream Factory!
Item.224033.3: Ah, welcome to my ball, my dear patient.Listen, the music is playing. Come, dance with my collection among these phantom bubbles.
Item.224036.3: Body bound, soul eroded,even pain masquerades as a mire of salvation.The fallen priestess still wanderson a pilgrimage with no answers and no end,awaiting a righteous one to grant her release.
Item.224037.3: The children of the Ash District tell a legend:when despair grips the world and tears loved ones apart,a green-haired heroine called the "Lord of the Prize Claw" and her brave companionswill lead everyone to catch the last glimmer of hope and reunite with their families.
Item.224038.3: Floating on a thousand crests,a translucent, shimmering thing.Escaping the searing summer heat,drifting along with the migrating fish.
Item.224039.3: I long for the sea breeze to linger, for the waves to remain.I pray for the sunset to stretch endlessly, for the starlight to never fade.I wish to share with you alone—a summer that belongs to us.
Item.224040.3: To protect your companions, to summon the courage and become your best self,strike your fist at the colossal enemy,and clear the path to a future full of hope.
Item.224041.3: A sleigh full of giftsguided by the messengerheading toward the sunrise and its destinationexcept—shouldn't reindeer be pulling it?!
Item.224042.3: Midnight bells chime to welcome the Springseek Festivalas fireworks set the night sky ablaze.Amid the revelry, the crowd wishesthat there is joy and peace for the days and years ahead.
Item.224043.3: Beneath soil steeped in conspiracy and intrigue,Watchful, calculating gazes interweave.Something is struggling to break through the earth.
Item.224044.3: The drawn curtains create a cozy, warm retreat.Her smile is tender,but the syringe in her hand glints chillingly."Don't be afraid. It will be over before you know it."
Item.224045.3: A fierce wind sends petals swirling through the sky as paper umbrellas snap shut Look—within the sea of blossoms, before the formation of parasols A slender figure dances gracefullyIs it real… or just a fleeting dream?
Item.224046.3: Think of it as nothing more than a marvelous Stella Drama.When we return our present, our trusted friends are still here with us.Leave the dark Monolith behind. The winter night will pass.And look: spring's warm sunlight will shine once more upon this city that once thrived.
Item.224047.3: Sharpen the crease, press firm the wax,Longing turns to ink upon the page.A sudden gust sweeps the words away,Leaving a thousand thoughts ... lighter than the air.
Item.224048.3: The winter wind carries prayers from afarThe messenger arrives with blessings and giftsstepping into view as the midnight bells ringThis Snowish Festival gift is for you, who never lost your childish wonder
Item.224049.3: Dispel the haze and race toward the stars beyond; Ring the bell of beginnings and set our adventure in motion. Love and hope await along the way—and for this journey… thank you for being here.
Item.224050.3: Countless toasts exchanged, endless lofty talks—visions and dreams only seem real in this fleeting moment.Yet beyond the light, on the moon's hidden side,shadows long for a world where dreams can truly exist.
Item.224051.3: As flowers and water embrace the earth, as stars revolve in search of one another,all things in this world lean on each other—so let me share your solitude as well.In the dark depths of space, let me light the starlight that guides you home.
Item.224052.3: Gears lock into place, sparking a universe of wild imagination.The rabbit unrolls her inspiration list while tweezers and wrenches cobble together absurd inventions.The girl's pen skips across the blueprints.And beneath an adorable shell, a dangerous new weapon comes to life.
Item.224053.3: Whether after a nerve-wracking, narrow escape from death,or a candid, grudge‑shattering conversation,there is always a joyful, open‑hearted gathering, where people share a meal together, finally letting go of the past.Looking at everything around her, she suddenly realizes this very moment is what is most worth cherishing.
Item.224054.3: A little paradise that's ours alone,running with her through the dim lamplight.Don't be afraid of stumbling—I'll hold your hand tight,until we make it to the end together.
Item.224055.3: Sunlight filters through the clear water,warming the ocean with a gentle glow.A girl gazes up at the shimmering light—what lies beyond those ripples?
Item.224056.3: Broken patterns of light drift across her hair,as she steps into a flowing stream.The forest wind follows the sound of insects,whispering that midsummer has quietly arrived.
Item.224057.3: The sea reaches for you with gentle waves.Every sound joins the celebration in perfect harmony.With friends by your side and the breeze beneath you,sail toward summer, toward the sea beyond the horizon.
Item.224058.3: One by one, we count the seasons gone by,laying yesterday's sorrows to rest.O summer memories, poured out with every burst of laughter,may you never be carried away by the tides of time.
Item.224059.3: The caged bird sings, its feathers shimmering in the sunlight.It pauses, holding back its excitement.Despite the cage, its hope for tomorrow endures.One day, it will spread its wings and soar toward its dreams and freedom.
Item.224060.3: Her heart is pounding.The cheers from the crowd, the shutter sound of photo capturers,and the lights illuminating the hall and sparkling like stars.For the first time, people are here for her, looking at her with approval.This is the most glorious moment of her life.
JointDrillAffix.10001.2: The boss gains an Echo Codex that dissipates after taking a certain number of hits. When the boss casts certain skills, the Echo Codex casts similar skills.
JointDrillAffix.10002.2: The boss gains a Record Codex that dissipates after taking a certain number of hits but revives after some time. When the boss casts certain skills, the Record Codex records similar skills and casts them later.
JointDrillAffix.10003.2: The boss initially has high DMG Resistance. Each Echo Codex or Record Codex removed lowers the boss's DMG Resistance.
JointDrillAffix.10004.2: Each time a friendly unit deals DMG to the boss, increases the boss's DMG Taken for a short period.
JointDrillAffix.10005.2: The boss summons multiple Echo Codices to continuously channel energy. The fewer Echo Codices remaining when the channeling ends, the weaker the attacks from the boss.
JointDrillAffix.10006.2: The boss summons the Record Codices on the battlefield and absorbs them. The more Record Codices absorbed, the stronger the boss's attacks will become.
JointDrillAffix.10007.2: The boss gains an Echo Codex that takes much less Auto Attack DMG. When the boss casts certain skills, the Echo Codex casts similar skills.
JointDrillAffix.10008.2: The boss gains a Record Codex that takes much less Auto Attack DMG and revives after some time. When the boss casts certain skills, the Record Codex records similar skills and casts them later.
JointDrillAffix.10009.2: After a friendly unit deals damage to the boss a certain number of times, it increases the damage the boss takes for a short period.
JointDrillAffix.10010.2: When a friendly unit is on yellow or blue tiles, this unit's DMG to same-color bosses is greatly reduced.
JointDrillAffix.10011.2: When a friendly unit is on yellow or blue tiles, this unit's DMG to opposite-color bosses is significantly increased.
JointDrillAffix.10012.2: Certain boss skills can change the color of specific tiles on the board.
JointDrillAffix.10013.2: Upon the defeat of either boss, the battle permanently enters the second phase. Players will face the remaining boss alone on a newly manifested chessboard.
JointDrillAffix.10014.2: In the second phase, prioritize neutralizing the Flaming Lanterns. Their explosions will color massive tiles across the board.
JointDrillAffix.10015.2: In the first phase, the boss summons extra Flaming Lanterns.
JointDrillAffix.10016.2: Chess Piece: Mortar fires projectiles directly at the target. Chess Piece: Knight targets an enemy Soldier and performs a leaping trample attack.
JointDrillAffix.10017.2: Chess Piece: Mortar fires parabolic projectiles at the target. Chess Piece: Knight scans all tiles within a "knight's move" (L-shaped) range, selects the tile closest to the target, and performs a leaping trample attack.
JointDrillAffix.10031.2:
In Phase 1, Coppelius fights while Olympia periodically moves to the arena's edge to support Coppelius and unleash AoE attacks.
In Phase 2, Coppelius leaves the field, and you face Olympia alone.
JointDrillAffix.10032.2:
Arcane Puppets generate arcane beams that channel arcane energy into the boss enemy. If uninterrupted long enough, the boss enemy gains an Arcane Barrier.
The Main Trekker can block the beams to stop the charge and gain buffs.
Defeating Arcane Puppets grants your squad a temporary buff.
JointDrillAffix.10033.2: Olympia absorbs nearby Free-Floating Cores, detonating them to deal AoE DMG. Absorbing enough grants her an Arcane Barrier. If the Main Trekker touches a Core first, they absorb it instead and gain a temporary buff.
JointDrillAffix.10034.2: Royal Guard Puppets attack as commanded by the boss enemy and cannot be targeted.
JointDrillAffix.10035.2: Olympia creates damaging zones around the arena and repeatedly casts Arcane Collapse, knocking the Main Trekker back in set directions.
JointDrillAffix.10036.2: Royal Guard Puppets become more dangerous and unleash slashes that deal continuous DMG.
JointDrillAffix.10037.2: Olympia continuously absorbs free-floating arcane energy from the field to charge herself, steadily increasing her arcane energy.
JointDrillAffix.10038.2: After gaining enough arcane energy, Olympia grants an Arcane Barrier to herself or Coppelius.
JointDrillControl.510001.2: She wears fear as her etiquette and feeds despair with paranoia.In her repertoire, she performs the most ancient of nightmare.
JointDrillControl.510002.2: She wears fear as her etiquette and feeds despair with paranoia.In her repertoire, she performs the most ancient of nightmare.
JointDrillControl.510003.2: Chariots trample the world, roaring a victory ode for the perished.In the countless wars she relives, only madness remains eternal.
JointDrillControl.510004.2: She wears fear as her etiquette and feeds despair with paranoia.In her repertoire, she performs the most ancient of nightmare.
JointDrillControl.510005.2: Chariots trample the world, roaring a victory ode for the perished.In the countless wars she relives, only madness remains eternal.
JointDrillControl.510006.2: Chariots trample the world, roaring a victory ode for the perished.In the countless wars she relives, only madness remains eternal.
JointDrillControl.510007.2: Submit your soul and body wholly to her...To the great Olympia!
JointDrillControl.510001.3:
During A Finale Echoing, you get 3 challenge attempts per day. You can choose any unlocked difficulty, and rewards include tokens and ranking points.

Each challenge phase lets you deploy multiple squads across several rounds, but Trekkers cannot be used in more than one squad.

Winning grants points based on difficulty and battle time. Even if time runs out or all attempts are used, you'll still earn points.

Accumulate points throughout the event to claim Mission Rewards.

MallMonthlyCard.monthlyCard.small.2:
[Everbright Wishes: Stardust Details]

1. Purchase to immediately receive 600 Stellanite Lumina and activate a 30-day duration.

2. While active, logging in each day grants 150 Stellanite Dust and 1 Bottled Vigor Soda.

3. If your remaining duration is 180 days or less, purchasing again will extend the time cumulatively.

4. The maximum duration is 210 days. If you already have more than 180 days left, you cannot purchase again.

5. Missed daily rewards will not be compensated.
MallMonthlyCard.monthlyCard.strength.2:
[Everbright Wishes: Ascent Details]

1. Purchase to immediately receive 300 Stellanite Lumina and activate a 30-day duration.

2. While active, logging in each day grants 5 Canned Vigor Soda and 2 Monolith Stairs Pass.

3. If your remaining duration is 180 days or less, purchasing again will extend the time cumulatively.

4. The maximum duration is 210 days. If you already have more than 180 days left, you cannot purchase again.

5. Missed daily rewards will not be compensated.

MonsterManual.5060146.2: He takes great pride in his impeccable fashion sense;He won't tolerate anything "ugly";He'll create a brand-new face for every "client."Forbidden Beauty—rebirth awaits you.
MonsterManual.5080100.2: The perpetually drowsy Sherlock, flaunting its wealth as it wanders the streets. Should you steer clear of it... Or chase after it?
MonsterManual.7000105.2: She wears fear as her etiquette and feeds despair with paranoia.In her repertoire, she performs the most ancient of nightmare.
MonsterManual.7002136.2:
In the bizarre yet exciting digital worlds, she reigns supreme as the invincible Boss.
<color=#ec6d21>※Combat Capabilities</color>Rapid Fire: In Assault Mode, Chaton rapidly fires a barrage of bullets at the target.Dark Bullet: In Sniper Mode, Chaton fires a high-powered energy round after aiming.Laser Beam: In Sniper Mode, Chaton continuously fires a high-powered laser beam after aiming.Kitty Bullets: Chaton fires a massive flurry of kitty bullets in all directions.Eye of the Demon Lord: Chaton summons the Eye of the Demon Lord to unleash a volley of homing missiles that relentlessly track targets.
MonsterManual.7002246.2:
Those who are lost in the past do not fear death. As the ninja sword grazes your throat, all she seeks is the warmth of your touch.
<color=#ec6d21>※Combat Skills</color>Sunflower Dance: hurls a massive shuriken to deal DMG.Scattered Gale: performs a backflip and throws numerous kunai to deal DMG.Shrouded Moon: moves at extreme speed, dealing DMG to targets along her zigzag path.Shadow Dance: Leaf Barrier: summons clones, then unleashes massive shurikens whirlwinding around each clone.Shadow Dance: Wither: summons clones and vanishes into smoke, creating a large-area dealing DMG.
MonsterManual.7003156.2:
Torn between the desire for true companionship and the urge to wield weapons of destruction—that is Firefly's choice. Those she defeats, and those who defeat her, are destined to become her closest allies. That's the promise…
<color=#ec6d21>※Abilities: </color>Firefly: Flash — Fires drones that deal damage to enemies hit. Firefly: Spin — Forms drones into a returning boomerang, damaging enemies along its path. Firefly: Meteor — Creates a circular field on the ground that contracts and explodes. Cosmic Symphony— Bombards the battlefield at high frequency. Omni-Blade: Dashes along a set path, dealing massive damage to enemies in its path. All Fired Up — Gains 5 Heat when Skills or attacks hit. At 100 Heat, enters All Fired Up: skills consume Heat to enhance their effects, exits when Heat is depleted and heat generation is significantly increased afterward.
MonsterManual.7200105.2: She tears across the endless battlefield,reveling in the searing heat of combat.It isn't madness that drives her, but pure, unadulterated desire.As long as the war rages, her roar will never die.
MonsterManual.7200205.2: Crushed by the endless battlefieldand scorched by the fires of war.Her desire became her undoing, leading her straight into despair.Now she screams on forever, fueling the very war that destroyed her.
MonsterManual.7201105.2: The pursuit of perfection never ceases, no matter the cost in painful sacrifice.Holy, exalted puppets dance gracefully upon the magician's strings...
MonsterManual.7201205.2: The pursuit of perfection never ceases, no matter the cost in painful sacrifice.Holy, exalted puppets dance gracefully upon the magician's strings...
MonsterManual.9912101.2: Is that all you've got? Harder!
